notes.title: Wishing You a Harmonious Season!
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/U1wYpo0.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]We are now entering the season of harmony, where citizens of Elrios gather around as we feast upon this year’s feats. Gather around and sing songs of praises for our unsung heroes, the [b]Harmony Festiva[/b]l will start this week![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/h229T1M.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Now we ain’t forgetting the[b] Item Mall Updates[/b] for the week...[/p][p] [/p][p]Behold, the[b] Blooming Hour Costume[/b]! Such as “timely” piece coming out in a season we will ever so cherish.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/WNI4WWX.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We hope that you’re just as excited as we are for all the festivities that are about to come. We’re for sure ready with [i]tent[/i]s and [i]a bonfire[/i] completely set up near the venue. See y’all there.[/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p]

notes.title: Eye Spy, A Victory Ever So Nigh.
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ZeglHH5.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]How’s the accessory grind going y’all? We hope such newfound power has been a joy to collect and acquire![/p][p] [/p][p]As this fun summer comes to a close, it seems the feats of our recent conquest in the demon realm have become such an epic tale for future generations in Elrios to enjoy! Shouldn’t there be some kind of celebration with [i]a week ever so peaceful?[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]As curious as I am about what the future holds, don’t you also feel the same about this week’s [b]Item Mall[/b] content?[/p][p] [/p][p]Let [b]Lithia[/b] wear the [b]Eligos Eye[/b] with pride. [i]As you continue to emerge ever so victorious, let greed flow. Show it---No... [/i][b]FLAUNT IT![/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/hPJw0rT.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]This stylish eye will be here only for a limited time, so don’t hesitate to grab it for a fearsome upgrade![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: The Spirit Lord Awaits! Are You Worthy Enough to Face the Challenge?
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/nlDVZwP.jpeg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]The entrance to the Temple of the Spirit Lord has been found! Gather your party, restock and check your gear as the next challenge is just ahead. Prove yourself through the tribulations that await you inside, show your worth to the Spirit Lord by defeating the [b]Three-Headed Guardian [/b]and be rewarded with [b]unique accessories[/b]! The [b]Spirit Lord’s Temple[/b] accepts all who enter, it’s coming back out alive that adventurers may find trouble with.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ZPhhsSm.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We are throwing y’all a bone with this[b] Boost Event[/b] for the [b]+11 Submergence of Abyss Weapon[/b]! For those having trouble keeping up, this will give you that helpful nudge forward to obtain just the right weapon needed for the trials of the Temple.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/AmmyCME.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Let’s take the opportunity during our restocking to head into the[b] Item Mall[/b]![/p][p] [/p][p]The call of the sea is irresistible, be it for a simple sailor enjoying the [b]Blue Ocean[/b] or a plundering pirate sitting on a [b]Pile of Treasure[/b], both will head to the seas once more.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/nPclDfG.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Embarking on a journey beyond the horizon calls for an [b]Ensemble [/b]to lift the spirits of the crew! Harken to the songs of the band and take those first steps with renewed vigor![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/84q0tm7.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Dive into the depths and see the majestic corals and sea life, take this moment and feel the calming currents, let the [b]Ocean Dance[/b] with you.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/jJsrhn5.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]A few Ice Burners have returned! Will you side with the righteous [b]Velder Academy Knights[/b]? Or perhaps join the shadows of the [b]Horde of Darkness[/b], the demonic [b]Eligos[/b], or even become an avatar of [b]Thanatos[/b]?[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/1BINKbE.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Lithia returns with a few cats in tow! Time to [b]Tickle [/b]and [b]Snuggle [/b]them and make them [b]Meow[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/g3XcyVN.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]These are just available for a short time! Grab them as soon as you can![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Experience the Dichotomy of Fire and Water!
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/CXpLr6w.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]A few secrets in Atma’Ram have just been discovered! New dungeons await brave people to delve deep into them and uncover the wonders within. Brave through the elements of both the [b]Magma Breath[/b] and [b]Aqua Whistle[/b] dungeons, and you’ll surface with [b]Magic Stones [/b]unique to Atma’Ram![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/VQO7nCR.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]But that’s not all! With more adventurers expected to stay within Atma’Ram due to the dungeons, the lovely denizens have decided to open up fishing restrictions in the region! Get a chance to catch luxurious fish that can strengthen you further![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/olu9SEA.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]New supplies during extended visits are a must! So, let’s head to the[b] Item Mall[/b]![/p][p] [/p][p]With how the weather is in Atma’Ram, notable for its Hot Springs, you need to beat the heat with a wardrobe that fits in with the culture! Take the Summer Horizon costume and grab the sunglasses for those days the sun can’t stop staring![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ElyakM8.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Need some company on your trip? Why not bring a pet! A plethora of choices have made their return, enjoy the abundance of fluffy, friendly, and just oh so adorable companions to make your day brighter than before.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/cjzkqME.jpeg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/s4441em.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Remember to pack well and be ready for the adventures ahead![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: An After School Slice of Life!
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/HP0vFJh.jpeg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]The [b]Senpai, Carry Me in Raid [/b]and [b]Chance for Class Change [/b]Events are in full swing! We can only ask our illustrious Senpais to help out those in need, and for our Kouhais to not hesitate in asking for help. Take the time in the coming weeks to grow even stronger![/p][p] [/p][p]Don't forget to pass by the [b]Item Mall [/b]for a return of your favorite stocks![/p][p] [/p][p]Take this time to update your wardrobe, wander around the city in style in a [b]Street Skater [/b]motif or go for a posh style with [b]Elite Tailor[/b]. Get a new set of pajamas to ensure a [b]Sweet Dream [/b]and be recharged for your day as an[b] Honor Student [/b]at [b]Velder Academy[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ajG2iv9.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Then add some flair to your style with some [b]Custom Eyes[/b], with a whole bunch of them returning![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/jguIrqw.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Alongside these, we are adding [b]Seraphim Eyes [/b]for [b]Lithia[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/nXBAhvN.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p]

notes.title: That One Time My Senpai Carried Me in Raid After I Changed Classes
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Hj7jiwo.jpeg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]I hope your adventuring has been seeing a lot of success with all the events that have been happening lately! Having a little bit of trouble with Raid Dungeons? Worry not! [b]Senpai, Carry Me in Raid! Event[/b] is back with an improved number of rewards for both Senpais and Kouhais![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/qizTAft.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Rendezvous where the stars align and let them guide you to a new path! Finally, this is your [b]Chance for a Change.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/A7uRGbu.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]That’s not all, check our [b]Item Mall[/b] out for what’s new this week![/p][p] [/p][p]Suit up with your biggest and brightest equipment as [b]Exascale Character Change Ticket[/b] will be added to the Item Mall permanently. That’s not all, as you’ll get to experience it for free at the limited [b]Chance for a Change Event[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/5Kof8iu.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]A bunch of reorders have come this week. Anyone looking to complete these past [b]Ice Burner Reorders[/b] are in for a treat![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/jd3RLvY.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Anyone looking for a change of style? A limited [b]Reorder for Hair Color Palette[/b] is here! Get to experience past hues like [b]Nocturn Aurora, Sugar Rush, and Violet Mood [/b]once again![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/VPXsCRg.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Enjoy these events, and more, as in-game festivities continue![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p]

notes.title: A Trip Like No Other
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/MYlXmSZ.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]I know y'all are hard at work getting stronger especially with the help of the [b]Quick Start[/b], [b]+11 Submergence of Abyss Weapon[/b], and [b]Combat Power Boost [/b]Events! So, just make sure to take a break from all the grind and maybe take a trip.[/p][p] [/p][p]We have a plethora of wonderful locales that y’all can visit! Check out the [b]Item Mall [/b]for a quick preview![/p][p] [/p][p]The tropics are a must on a globe-trotting trip! A wonderful [b]Summer Getaway[/b] on the horizon! Get to [b]Walk on the Beach[/b] and enjoy the [b]Night Sky[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Qz34E3L.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Then head off to a fun party with [b]Lumin [/b]and [b]Nox[/b], and a few [b]Soda Bears[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/OQahH04.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Afterwards, why not attend Lithia’s World Tour! Dance to her beats and get taken through various genres of [b]Rising Festa[/b], [b]Parametric Ambiance[/b], and [b]Metal Core Carnival[/b]![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/pweADGD.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Make sure to stay for the encore![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/n2TKRoN.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]So, enjoy the sights and the music, then head back into the fray better than ever![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p]

notes.title: A Growth to Remember
notes.notes:
[p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/zoIi57e.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p]As the heat sets in, the journey continues to get increasingly intense. Start the week with a huge leap to either start your adventure or grow your roster![/p][p]Call your friends and try out the [b]Quick Start Event[/b]. Phoru will be there to guide you throughout the process. It’s your super extra mega paved road to [b]Master Class with just 5 quests[/b], and it gets even better from there![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Epyvajq.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Remember Hyper Punch? It’s not highlighted because it isn't here. But it definitely isn’t a bummer as an even easier push to get your combat power to over [b]10 million[/b] has arrived, let the party continue with the [b]Combat Power Boost Event.[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/G5lP51W.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Ready your arms and prepare for battle! I heard Cobo will supply us with an updated roster of equipment. A [b]+11 Submergence of Abyss Weapon Provision Event is [/b]on the way, where we can get one of the best weapons ever, for 60 days... until you convert it to Permanent![/p][p][b][img src="https://i.imgur.com/G7nFg9l.jpeg"][/img]
[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Ariel also has a little gift for you, go talk to her and see what’s up for [b]2025 Summer Special EP Shop.[/b][/p][p][b][img src="https://i.imgur.com/VJmZMQ0.jpeg"][/img][/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]But what’s in stock at the[b] Item Mall [/b]this week?[/p][p] [/p][p]Feel the summer breeze as it reminds you of the olden days. Remember the waves as it hits your toes, the sun as it sets with its golden glow, remember the past as it stays ever so present. Wear your [b]Happy Summer Memory[/b] for a themed trip to the past![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Lceyu4l.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Now of course, our magical miner isn't going to end this blog without a mall item addition of her own! Anyone waiting for the [b]Mini Pool Custom Motion for Lithia[/b] can rejoice![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/wA2wJtj.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]May the blessings of El be with you in this season of prosperity![/p][p] [/p][p]That’s it for now, folks.[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p]

notes.title: A Night of Contemplation
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/hpu39SC.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Heya adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]We hope you've been enjoying yourselves in the new [b]Demon Realm’s Spirit Haven Hot Spring. [/b]You can relax and go fishing if you haven't been there yet, but there's also the [b]Rise, Demon Realm Hot Springs[/b] Mini game to give you a nice little side story! Make sure to play daily for rewards and get yourself a new high score![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/CZqlbzl.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The [b]Item Mall[/b] is getting some new goodies as well this week that you won't want to miss out on![/p][p]There have been hearing rumors that a group of masked figures have been roaming around at night, singing songs of lost ones and a dark inevitability. What could it be? It might be related to the new [b]Ice Burner[/b] coming out, so welcome [b]Erebus Elegy [/b]to the Item Mall![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/0HNZaVE.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]If you're looking for a blast of the past, then maybe you want some [b]Reorder Shop[/b] outfits instead! We got three sets coming back for a limited time so now's the time to finish your collection![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/exqqK57.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Beat the summer heat with the [b]Surf's Up[/b] costume, become a member of a new [b]Idol Band[/b] and put on a performance, or take on any and all demons who stand in your way with the [b]Devil Hunter[/b] set![/p][p] [/p][p]That's all for now folks~[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p]

notes.title: A Golden Glow Getaway
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/t2HoKCY.jpeg"][/img][/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p]This summer heat has been no easy feat, but rumor has it, our next journey will be thrilling! Time to gear up as we continue exploring Elrios and beyond! The word on the street is that the Cobo Company is stirring things up again with Pamphlets about a [i]“[b]Summer Update Prelude Event[/b]”[/i] popping up everywhere![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/sGOGTrK.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Sometimes a well-earned vacation is good for some R&R!  But where should we go? Perhaps to the [b]Demon Realm’s Spirit Haven Hot Spring[/b]? Our souls are already halfway there so maybe it’s time we all took a well-deserved break![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/UmwOKQx.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]If you're planning on training and getting stronger, then the [b]Elrios Pass Season 11[/b] and new season of [b]Ann's Growth Support Pass[/b] will be arriving this week! Make sure to grab the rewards once they’re here as they will help a lot with your journey.[/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/HXST1cn.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]But with a new Hot Spring Location coming, we need to update our look so we can fit right in! Time to check out what the [b]Item Mall[/b] has to offer![/p][p] [/p][p]The [b]Crimson Duke[/b] costume suit and accessories will be a perfect fit for the Demon Realm. Show off your regality before taking a nice dip![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/sRKWDRr.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We also have the [b]Reorder Shop[/b] available for some Ice Burner sets! If you haven't finished your [b]Rosa Lethe[/b], [b]Aurora Mustika[/b], [b]Gold Falcon[/b], and [b]Nasod Battle Suit MK2 [/b]sets, then now's the time to do so![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/LRrLIrM.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]That's all for now folks~[/p][p]See y’all in-game![/p]

notes.title: Content Creator Program - July Update
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/czINVlg.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Hello Adventurers![/p][p]We are excited to be back with another edition of our monthly GM blog series, which covers all of the latest content from the Content Creator Program.[/p][p]As a reminder, anyone is able to apply to the program if they have interest in creating guides. Head to the [url="https://elsword.koggames.com/community/content-creator-program/"]official website here[/url] to apply.[/p][p]June was another thrilling month for our creators. Players can check out all 12 of the guides that range from solo raids to individual character paths.[/p][p] [/p][p]Tenebrous armor is an important part of gearing up your characters. NextActRena published a new guide that covers everything you need to know, from shadow effects to reforging and more. NextActRena continues to push out new content regularly to help players through their adventures. notes.title: Let's Switch Strategies, Senpai. Storm the Raid at Once!
notes.notes: [p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/rk7YAqd.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Heya Adventurers![/p][p] [/p][p]A week with clear skies is ahead of us. A good day to conquer Raid Dungeons! 3 events are coming this week as [b]Chef Devil[/b] and [b]Maid Cafe [/b]events continue.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Class Change Event [/b]will be here to help you in analyzing the battlefield so you can change tactics and get the upper hand![/p][p] [/p][p]On top of that, [b]Ariel’s Adventure Support Operation Event[/b] will commence to support your journey! Once you feel strong enough to challenge the big bad, gather your Kohais for a more rewarding clear with the [b]Senpai Raid Support Operation Event![/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/MICRt15.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]So much fun to have! Now to the Item Mall Updates~[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Whether it be that you’ll be the star or watch the stars, we’ve got the item just for you![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Theater Snack Party [/b]will be in the Item Mall for a limited time as we celebrate critiques and lovers alike. These fun accessories will keep you in a cinephile mood![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/BGNPGVq.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]ELSTAR 2[/b] is also coming back on stage with everything that’s been released so far in their franchise! Experience these stars shine once more as the encore arrives![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/ZPpAAGk.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Eager to burn legendary relics? [b]Agent Nous, Apostolos, Holy Unicorn, and Dark Shadow [/b]are back for our new batch of Ice Burner Reorders![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/JM8SZIl.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]If you’re like me who will miss the breeze spring brings, we have the [b]Spring Minuet [/b]costume suit for Lithia to bring the remnants of this season with us![/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/w76RQpV.jpeg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Have a fun rest of the week, y’all! See you in-game.[/p][p]That’s all for now folks~[/p]

notes.title: Time to Show Off Your Masterful Techniques, Chef!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KH11nkH.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

Sharpen your knives! As y’all will be going against each other in a head-to-head food competition! Toss food into your opponent’s side to score! Here’s a little teaser for y’all~!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2fFlI45.gif[/img]


Don’t forget to work on the rest of the running events. They only have a couple of weeks left before they are over!



Time to head over to the [b]Item Mall[/b] to see what’s new!


Lithia has expanded her repertoire once again! It’s no surprise she is now part of a Choir and that she can kick some butts! Look~ she’s showing some of her [b]Taekwondo [/b]right now!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HJKnDZu.gif[/img]


Can’t leave the rest of the cast behind! The [b]Kinetic Animal Costume[/b] has been released with wild reception! Take your street cred to the top and be the king (or queen) of this concrete jungle!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S9zF41e.jpeg[/img]


With the costume comes a [b]Custom Motion[/b] that definitely just vibes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3F42HNa.gif[/img]


Better rush to the [b]Item Mall[/b] before they hightail it right out~!

That’s all for now, folks~

notes.title: No Need for an Aid? Here Comes Solo Raid!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RFVFP47.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

The gods and goddesses of Elrios seem to have answered our prayers as life just got easier. Continue your journey with an improved quality of life! Between [b]Solo Raid Mode[/b]’s addition, additional [b]Buff and Difficulty Improvements, Prof. Pho’s Guide Revamp, Title Count Reduction, and Reforge Burden Reduction[/b], it seems this update will have ya’ll beaming with anticipation!


[b]Here’s a sneak peak of events that will be coming together with the QoL!
[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sZFrA8w.jpeg[/img]

Not just that, mind you! Who says we forgot about the Item Mall Updates?


Introducing the speedy, the adorable, the UNBREAKABLE... [b]Dinorex[/b]! This cute giant has joined our roster of summonable mounts. Worry not, your new green companion won’t bite (unless extremely necessary)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iocNrxX.jpeg[/img]



Reorders have been coming in hot! Non-stop updates on this end with both [b]Costumes [/b]and [b]Ice Burners[/b] having had returning fits. See these visuals for more details!


Get to tell your own story with [b]Red Hood Girl, Ferocious Wolf, Messenger of Love[/b], and [b]Remote Chairman[/b] Costumes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wj3igZ1.jpeg[/img]



Upgrade both power and style with the returning gems! [b]Ocean Pearl, Sacred Knights, Salvator Denif[/b], and [b]Glacial Ice Burners[/b] are back at the Item Mall for a limited time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DQoFz2N.jpeg[/img]


With all these updates going around, our magical miner would like to help you calm down! Relish the beauty of spring with [b]Lithia’s Blooming Spring Afternoon Custom Sit Motion[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BiCQDKR.gif[/img]


With all these updates, time’s definitely a wastin’. What are you waiting for? Grab ‘em while they’re here!

That’s all for now, folks~

notes.title: Happy 14th Anniversary!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Movsps7.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

Another year has passed, and I can surely say that even I had fun bringing you updates every week! May our journey be never-ending, Elpeeps. I hope y'all are having fun with the events that we have prepared for the anniversary! This is our thanks for your unending love and support for the game.

With all that was said, what if I tell you that there’s still more content coming this week?


Yes, there definitely is more! All you need to do is to look up at the stars and it will guide you to your next journey. The [b]Constellation of El Search Party and the Demon Realm Event[/b] is an exciting event that will consist of story chapters unlockable every 2 weeks. With it are prizes consisting of El House Furniture, Character Accessories, and Consumables!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rJEnArt.jpeg[/img]


Now on to the Item Mall Updates!

Our Seasonal Relic Burner is getting an update. Rumors of a wandering bard have scattered around Elrios. Sightings have described them to be wearing the legendary [b]Vita Fontana[/b] Ice Burner Costume. Here’s a more detailed illustration:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p7V9DN6.jpeg[/img]


Looking for an attire that you’d like to wear for a simple house party? The Item Mall have also been blessed with the gorgeous looking [b]Be My Guest[/b] costume, available for all characters!

All of these are only available for a limited time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lPRLwEG.jpeg[/img]


That’s all for now, folks~

But before this blog ends, I’d like to greet everyone another Happy Anniversary. May we see y’all in-game!

notes.title: A Short Rest Before the Big Event
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/leKRUv0.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

Just checking to see if y’all have taken another look at our Anniversary page. No? Well then, you may have missed a crucial reveal! Go ahead, I’ll give you a moment...

Or not! I can just tell you! We revealed our in-game Anniversary events just a few days ago! Our Anniversary Ice Burner! 3rd Class Promotion Costume! All with a Burning Event that is sure to entice you to enjoy the day to the fullest!

I’ll stop there, but with those events heading our way real soon, we need a little break before getting back into the action. So, take this week and clean up shop, best be ready for a grand ol’ time over the weekend!

This time it’s a highlight of fresh stock of returning favorites into the [b]Item Mall[/b] with the [b]Costume Suit Reorder Shop[/b]!

Channel your inner temple guardian spirit with these [b]Pet Costumes[/b], each with their own fox spirit!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/26XJk50.jpeg[/img]


Or just let loose and pay no-one any mind with the [b]Curious Fox[/b], [b]Flamingoooo[/b] and [b]Orange Puppy[/b] Costume Suits!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gCjLqLv.jpeg[/img]


They’ll be gone before you even know it! Grab them before then!


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Let the Celebrations Begin!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6RKyBQ2.jpeg[/img]

Hi everyone!

Already feeling the fun our upcoming anniversary is bringing? Don’t miss out on all the community events that we’ve prepared ahead of the celebration!


[b]Elrios Maid Cafe[/b] are looking for adventurers that would like to become part-time workers! Are you interested? We assure you that you’ll be handsomely paid with [b]New Costumes[/b] and [b]Custom Motions[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QKpq3em.jpeg[/img]


Another chance for a change. Get a free chance to change classes weekly with our upcoming [b]Class Change Event[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CEKxJPi.jpeg[/img]


And now the [b]Item Mall[/b] updates!

Lithia has once again updated her wardrobe! Dress your Magical Miner with the cutest fits. [b]Orange Puppy[/b] and [b]Flamingoooo [/b] Costume Suits will be available at the Item Mall for a limited time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KFjnSwp.jpeg[/img]


In-line with the release of Flos Magica Ice Burner for Lithia, the Magica Eye cosmetic will also be added in the Item Mall for a limited time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/F5FRT9p.jpeg[/img]


A dazzling combination of returning Ice Burners are arriving! Create your own story with the magical Flos Magica, the steampunk Dreaming Automata, the majestic Royal Maid, and the legendary Evil Tracer 1 can be acquired once again for a limited time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7089ddl.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DP0qRRE.jpeg[/img]


And finally! Our sugar-coated friend is here to assist you. Introducing Poyong! Your sweet pudding companion (not food). You can adopt (not eat) Poyong at the Item Mall for a limited time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gi7clb7.jpeg[/img]


See you at the upcoming anniversary celebration!


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gqnr1ML.jpeg[/img]


Heya adventurers!

Had a good rest last week? Good! Cause the prelude to our Anniversary has started! We have a pre-registration event going that can yield you some wonderful merch! Then a bunch of fun events lined up for all of ya, we’ll start off with things that you can enjoy as a community! That means a PVP Tournament, and an Art Contest, so make sure to sign up and limber up your competitive muscles or artistic brains! Afterwards, why not leave an awe-inspiring message for the rest to see!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S0GLEFw.jpeg[/img]


We’ll keep the [b]Item Mall[/b] stocked up for this occasion as well!

It’s an all for one, one for all kind of season! Show your unity and defend honor together with the [b]Musketeer Costumes[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oLLTABG.jpeg[/img]


Next up, we are painting a spectacle! We are updating the [b]Costume Reorder Shop[/b] with new entries, enjoy the bright colors of [b]Blossom Bird, Colorful Bloom,[/b] and [b]Circus costumes[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sc5wR4U.jpeg[/img]


And lastly, a fresh set of outfits just for [b]Lithia[/b]! Go trending and be the talk of the netizens with the [b]After School Cat[/b]! Be photogenic and have a fan page made just for your [b]Dear Little Bird[/b] or even be turning heads at an away game with the [b]High Teen Cheerleader[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LcV3ZrL.jpeg[/img]

Go get them before they are taken off the shelves!



That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The Grind for Gold Continues!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zZ8959p.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

With last week’s April Fools’ Event concluding, a very chill week is ahead of us, but Prof. Pho ain’t just going to let you relax just yet! [b]Prof. Pho's Attendance Event[/b] is back with more useful items for you to acquire! This will definitely be useful with all the new content we recently had!




We know how much you’ve been grinding through your most desired weapon. To help you, Cobo has prepared something special with the [b]Doom Aporia Raid Consumable Support Event[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uvZ59a5.jpeg[/img]



[b]Check out our Item Mall Updates!
[/b]
This week is a joy for all the creatives out there looking for a change in their style! Raise your fashion points with dazzling [b]Patch On Denim[/b] Costumes available at the Item Mall for a limited time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KLEKPOs.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5VlF9b2.jpeg[/img]



That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Will the Prophecy Be Fulfilled?
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LaJCokH.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

A thrilling conclusion awaits as we reach the 4th Raid Dungeon Update for Doom Aporia. Raid the [b]Wilting Tower[/b] to acquire the most coveted item in this update! Anybody craving the newest [b]Undead Dragon’s Will - Mortal Weapon[/b]?


Back-to-back events will also launch coinciding with the latest Raid Update. Starting with the [b]Elrios Pass Season 10[/b]! Equip yourself with the best enhancements as you brave extreme battles. This season will also include limited cosmetics, so don’t miss ‘em!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kRq4ewl.jpeg[/img]

Following this, the [b]Cobo Company[/b] is also making moves with their [b]Support Event[/b]! Receive useful items as you proceed through the rest of your el-xhilarating journey!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fh5m54Q.jpeg[/img]


Now to the Item Mall Updates!

This week, Reorder Shop has also received new updates as returning Ice Burners rotate. Don the Protector’s gear with [b]Nox Venator, Aether Nobilitas, Salvatore Solace,[/b] and [b]Velder Imperial Guard [/b]entering the rotation!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4iRdz8N.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/z9RUEAs.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8FXZzmQ.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GU5NAFx.jpeg[/img]

For a limited time, these Relic Burners will also have a [b]1+1 Package Promo[/b] each. Get a Bonus Relic Burner once you buy the package (10 per account)! Complete ‘em while they’re here. Good luck ya’ll!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Take a Short Break from Adventuring with an Item Mall Extravaganza!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VNk5ZuI.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

Doing well with the new dungeons, I hope? Y’all just be sure to make the best out of all these events and be ready for what’s to come! It’s still jam-packed from our previous updates so we ain’t gonna add more things to worry about.

But instead, we’ll just add a few more to the [b]Item Mall![/b]

We are changing up the theme for the [b]Costume Reorder Shop[/b]! It’s time for an alpine expedition! On a casual visit? Try out our [b]Chic Leopard[/b] and [b]Winter Polar[/b] designs, or if you are feeling more native, then rep the locals with the [b]Arctic Travel[/b] and [b]Alps[/b] designs instead!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jWai0C1.jpeg[/img]

Then we have lovely new costumes for Lithia! Let your emotions flow out with the [b]Blossom Bird[/b] costume and accompanying motion!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dcd5kxZ.gif[/img]

Or perhaps you are the time to beautifully laze like a [b]Butterfly [/b]in a [b]Garden[/b]? Maybe, you wish to take an active role with your peers and become a [b]Messenger of Love[/b] for them?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NyVfbgk.jpeg[/img]

No matter what you pick, you’ll have to dress the part, and these costumes will impress any and all! So, nab all of them now at the [b]Item Mall[/b] before they are gone~

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: To Serpentium... and Beyond!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lmSiAYk.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

Anyone looking for a party? I surely do! Rally to Serpentium and discover wonders beyond the Sky Fortress. Sharpen your blades and wear your best accessories. Guaranteed that once you conquer, you’ll come out stronger!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Tbubnvk.jpeg[/img]


We’re with you through this journey, the Cobo team will make sure to provide temporary enhancements through the [b]Doom Aporia Events[/b]!

And now... onto the [b]Item Mall updates[/b]!

The Item Mall additions are as plenty as our game updates this week!


Dreaming of your very own wonderland? Marvel in wondrous furniture additions with [b]Magic School Dormitory[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/69JbJrF.gif[/img]


Cozy up with adorable fits through the [b]Daily Short Padded Coat[/b] costume, available for all characters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HVzo08e.jpeg[/img]


Our magical miner is on her journey to inspire or be inspired! Find solace through music and relaxation with the [b]Elrios Beat (Lithia)[/b] and [b]Terrarium Chair (Lithia) Custom Motions[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/peIxG35.gif[/img]


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Heya adventurers!

You have a week left before the [b]Class Change Even[/b]t ends. Make sure that those cubes have already been put to good use, or they’ll expire on their own. I highly suggest using this event to be on your desired path as you accomplish the [b]Force Skill Update Complete Event[/b]!

[/b]

notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/H33Bzw9.jpeg[/img]
Heya adventurers!

Plenty of events remain as we continue with the Winter Event Celebration! Here’s to hoping ya’ll are enjoying the new [b][Mod] Force Skills[/b] added last week. How’s your progress with the new [b]Abyssal Presence[/b] Ice Burners? I sincerely hope the new revamp helps; I personally enjoy that shiny new[b] Ice Burner Inventory[/b]!


This week, cute new fits will be added at the [b]Item Mall[/b]!

Up for a slumber party? Our Magical Miner is ready! You won’t want to miss the cutest [b]Animal Pajama for Lithia[/b], nor do you not want to baa~ baa~ buy this cutesy [b]Little Lamb Costume Suit for Lithia[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f9k4y24.jpeg[/img]

Anyone requested for another batch of reshuffle with our beloved idols? See the team wear their alternate costumes, from another group! Takes a lot to imagine, but you don’t need to, because it’s here!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/amakG72.jpeg[/img]

Look! They even learned the dances from the other group’s 2nd Song!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PP2fut5.gif[/img]

Don’t miss out as these are limited edition items that will not be here for long!


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Content Creator Program Announcement
notes.notes:
[url=https://tinyurl.com/33x8tsys][img]https://i.imgur.com/WCvp93e.jpeg[/img][/url]

Hello, adventurers!

We are excited to announce the launch of our official Content Creator Program! Our program is an opportunity for players to create educational videos and collaborate with the Elsword team and like minded individuals.

We are looking for creative individuals who have a passion for sharing their Elsword knowledge through creating video content. Whether you are experienced with production or are eager to learn, we want to hear from you!

Head to [url=https://tinyurl.com/33x8tsys]https://tinyurl.com/33x8tsys[/url] for further information and apply today!

notes.title: It’s Time to Gaze Back at the Abyss!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q4xyMFj.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

Its another week of events! Well, just a few additions since we know y’all are still working on the rest that I might add are also just a few weeks away from ending! So, get to it! But we felt y’all just needed a few more. The [b]Abyssal Presence Ice Burner[/b] is here along with some [b]Magmelia Firework[/b] packages! Still need more? Good for you! We have the Fill Up Happiness Event as well that will surely get your attention this week!


Now let’s check some wonderful updates to our [b]Item Mall![/b]

I know y’all are curious about the new [b]Ice Burner[/b], so here is a preview of [b]Abyssal Presence[/b] and its custom eye [b]Abyss Eyes[/b] just for all y’all!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oYxmBPt.jpeg[/img]


We also have a bunch of new Custom Motions for Lithia! Already missing the winter? Relive the season with [b]Make a Snuggly Snowman[/b] and [b]Snowy Swan Lake[/b]. But don’t forget to embrace the coming spring with a trip to [b]Elrios Park[/b] and go on the [b]Carousel[/b], then take a break with an [b]Afternoon Picnic[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2VqZ1vV.gif[/img]


All of these are only available for a limited time, so make sure to snag them up quickly!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: It’s Time to Light the Skies with FIREWORKS!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMQqoIc.jpeg[/img]

Another week, another set of events! Let’s continue increasing your power for the year with an [b]Enhancement Event![/b] Then celebrate the Lunar New Year Event along with our [b]Magmelia Fireworks Event[/b]! A bunch of event quests to be hand and a chance to get the coveted Empire Reign and Ocean Pearl Ice Burners! Here’s a quick peek at these illustrious rewards!

Next, we have a bunch of [b]Goodies [/b]for Lithia coming to the [b]Item Mall[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1l1iEyK.jpeg[/img]

It’s time to dress up and make a statement, be it against your enemies with the [b]Opponent of Evil[/b], to provide to your colleagues that being a [b]Remote Chairman[/b] is indeed hard work, or just making sure that the [b]Antique Library[/b] is tidy and quiet, these Costumes are here for you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m8XkaZ7.jpeg[/img]


They’ll be in the [b]Item Mall[/b] for a limited item, grab them as soon as you can and show the world what you are made of!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Take the Path to Become Stronger!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/o4U5dI6.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! A good start to the week as we bring news on what’s up and coming in Elrios.

The goddess has opened the path to become stronger as [b]Path to Becoming Stronger Event[/b] arrives this week. Complete weekly quests and acquire useful rewards. But wait, there’s more! Time to hone your skills with the new [b][Mod] Force Skill Update[/b] that will feature Elsword, Rena, Eve, Rose, and Laby!

 

[b]But what’s up with the Item Mall?
[/b]
Our Item Mall is also filled with fun updates! Starting with new custom motions from Lithia! Get to experience post-holiday joy with the new [b]Lithia’s Soft Teddy Custom Motion[/b] and [b]Lithia’s Snowglobe Custom Motion[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CokERCL.gif[/img]

 

Anyone looking for an ELSTAR Update? I definitely am! Get to experience your idols in an alternate group attire with the [b]First Song Switching Costumes[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k7LOyop.jpeg[/img]

These will be available only for a limited time, so if you really want ‘em, make sure to grab them while they last!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Happy New Year Elrios!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/g61D6n4.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

The New Year is upon us! Make sure to achieve your [b]resolutions [/b]alright?

Let’s start 2025 with a jam-packed month! The [b]Hyper Punch Master[/b], [b]Clear The Raid[/b], and [b]Carefree Collection Events[/b] are here to help you out with leveling those characters and ERP levels all while getting juicy rewards! And to sweeten that deal even further, we have a [b]Provision Event[/b] for a [b]+11 Vestige of Soul Weapon[/b] and an [b]Exascale Color Change Ticket Event[/b].

 

That’s surely gonna pique your interest, so get to it!

And if you are looking for a change, the [b]Class Change Event[/b] is here to give you a chance to try out the various Paths of your characters. Don’t be afraid to experiment and try new things, you might surprise yourself in how well other classes will just click for you!

Strengthening oneself is well and good, but let’s not forget our fashion sense.

So, onto the [b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]!

Our ELSTAR Idols are just speechless by your support, so they had to send a [b]Fan Package[/b] for a second time! Check it out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XJIF2rJ.jpeg[/img]

 

Whoa! Who turned off the lights? Wait, it’s just Lithia in her new [b]Ice Burner Set[/b], the [b]Mariposa Requiem[/b]! Who wouldn’t stare at the abyss if she is the one that gazes back at you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oGKL4q8.jpeg[/img]

 

These are all available for a limited time only! Hurry, you might lose them if you blink!

That’s all for now, folks~ Let’s have a great 2025!

 

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Merry Christmas Elrios!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fcdwIy4.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers!

It’s almost Christmas! Have you gotten your presents yet? Let me help you with that as the [b]Christmas Special Shop[/b] is open on the much-celebrated day! With it comes three packages for sale so get them as they’ll only last for a day!


Onto our [b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]!

We have a bunch of exclusives for [b]Lithia[/b], seasonal [b]Winter Costumes[/b] that will definitely keep you warm and cozy!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MrUUFBt.jpeg[/img]

Along with that, the [b]Lovely Winter Package[/b] includes these lovely and charming motions!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/TEtJ75c.gif[/img]

But if you want to dress to impress, then don’t hesitate with this [b]Costume Suit[/b], the [b]Christmas Velvet Dress[/b]! You’ll surely turn heads at parties!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iVQZe4j.jpeg[/img]


Remember that they are only available for a limited time so go get them before the season shifts!

That’s all for now, folks~ Have a Merry Christmas!

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Let the Stars Guide You this Christmas.
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bR6kYE3.jpeg[/img]

The [b]ELSTAR 2 Project[/b] will be with us for a long while, with it comes more exclusive and limited events! Celebrate Christmas with the gang with the [b]ELSTAR Christmas Story Event and 2024 Christmas Event[/b].


Elsword is definitely giving y'all an exciting back-to-back holiday celebration as we build up on what’s coming as winter approaches! That said, make sure you view and pre-register for our [b]Winter Update Preview Event[/b] to not miss out on the pre-registration rewards!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bpVgXUC.jpeg[/img]

Now to the [b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]!


More stylish fits await as the second set of songs have come out for the ELSTAR 2 Groups! Here are [b]Costumes [/b] and [b]Stickers [/b]for each group that I’ve scrapped for you to see!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZPK3S2m.jpeg[/img]


Here’s a same of their new [b]Custom[/b] dance as well!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3TzBABl.gif[/img]


Our cutie explorer is not done with updating her stylish fits! Bring smiles around the crowd with [b]Lithia’s Christmas Party Suit[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wa8YDBK.jpeg[/img]


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Burn Brighter with New Ice Burners!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers, the [b]ELSTAR 2 Project[/b] continues to move smoothly! We hope you continue to enjoy the fun events we’ve launched for you. Phase 2 is in preparation as we give you a [b]Preview [/b]this week of the second wave of songs coming your way!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aC1i4kg.jpeg[/img]

Straight to the[b] Item Mall Goodies[/b]!

Lithia gets new sets of wardrobes to play with! Make a path for yourself as you choose your fated set. Feel like you’d like the maid aesthetic? Hop-on the [b]Royal Maid[/b] hype!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Kz288v.jpeg[/img]

Manifest the irresistible charm of dragons! Choose [b]White Dragon: Servius Set[/b] and complete the look with [b]Lithia’s Custom Eye: Servion Eyes[/b], separately available at the Item Mall for a limited time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OD9syEp.jpeg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Let the Stars Warm Up your Winter Nights!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4wajdC.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers, I see that y’all have been celebrating [b]ELSTAR 2[/b] non-stop and are eager for more! I hear ya loud and clear! It’s time to show the world who your [b]PERSONAL FAVORITES[/b] are! [b]Decorate [/b]the in-game [b]Diary[/b], take some pictures in the [b]Photo Studio[/b], or even show off your [b]dance moves[/b] from the [b]Fan Package[/b] and share it on [b]TikTok[/b]~!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WAWouFT.jpeg[/img]

But we won’t just stop there! It’s the festive season, so that means prizes! Gifts! And just EVEN MORE EVENTS like the start of the [b]Hedgehog Attendance, Elrios Pass Season 9[/b] and [b]Ann Growth Support Pass[/b] or participate in our [b]Daily Discord Giveaways[/b]! With so much happening, you won’t even notice the cold!

Next up is our [b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]!

We already mentioned the [b]Fan Package[/b], so here’s a better look at it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/in6p3Ii.jpeg[/img]


Care to remember the warmer days? Then take a nap in a cozy [b]Cotton [/b]tent and let the [b]Breeze [/b]take you away to the time you drove your [b]Convertible alongside a field of sunflowers~!
[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SkTEDgC.jpeg[/img]

The time to reminisce is short, so hurry over to the [b]Item Mall [/b]to snag them before they become just a fleeting memory!

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Happy Holidays Elrios!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wa27POg.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! As we continue with the [b]EL MEGA DAY[/b] and [b]ELSTAR 2 [/b]hype, there’s a lot more to celebrate this week as [b]Thanksgiving[/b] and [b]Black Friday[/b] approaches!

A week of giving with the [b]2024 Thanksgiving Event[/b]! You just have to login for [b]180 minutes[/b] to receive [b]Thanksgiving Coupons[/b]! Do this daily and you’ll have enough coupons to exchange for some epic rewards. This and more, with [b]EXP x2[/b] and [b]Item Drop Rate x2[/b] bonuses! You can check our website for the upcoming announcement regarding this exciting event!


Let’s move on to the [b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]!

There’s an event brewing and it won’t be here until Friday! [b]Black Friday[/b] sales are coming with a lot of useful and bundled Items you can’t miss. For you to prepare ahead of time, more details on this will be posted on our website as early as Wednesday!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JWd5bfT.jpeg[/img]


This week also introduces a new cuddly companion, [b]Yomi[/b]! Our whimsical feline friend is ready to have an icy expedition with you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/e03f9ON.jpeg[/img]

Lithia also wants to be dressed up for more trick-or-treating! She just can’t get over Halloween. Besides, it’s never too late for a fright, right?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FJlMhc1.jpeg[/img]

That’s not all! Lithia’s spookiest costume suit yet, [b]Ghostly Pale Pajamas[/b], is also being added at the Item Mall!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jnf1IMC.jpeg[/img]

The fashion is strong with all of these Items for sale! Grab ‘em fast cause these are available at the Item Mall for a limited time!


That's all for now, folks~
See y'all in-game!

Heya, adventurers! The stage is set. With the cameras on and our stars are back in action, I hope you’re prepared with everything EL☆STAR2 related that’s coming this week! Ready to root for your favorite groups and biases? I myself can’t wait!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W7yMogK.jpeg[/img]


There’s more! The show will never be over without a performance. Impress the crowd with your breath-taking star presence through the [b]EL☆STAR2 custom motions[/b]!

Create your own meet and greet situation or host a Fan Cafe for your favorite idols! Even these EL☆STAR2 DIY El House Furniture are lookin’ like a must grab!

That's all for now, folks~

notes.title: The Stars Shine Brighter than Ever!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YUgB0Sp.jpeg[/img]
Heya, adventurers! I do hope y'all have been helping Farmer Pho on their farm! There are a couple of weeks left still, so work hard and earn those rewards! But don't worry, cause we got something to brighten up your mood! The El★STAR Idols are coming back with new hits! Make sure to take a break, listen to the song previews, and keep an eye out for more juicy details!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
I know that y'all are pumped up for the Idols but make sure to check yourself. Lithia has a new gig, and let's just say [b]Lithia Thanatos[/b] might want to visit if any of you happen to take your excitement too far.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wdDa1GA.jpeg[/img]


I heard that the [b]City View[/b] is great, even more so if a [b]Theme Park[/b] is in town! So, make sure to grab your friends, set it up in your Guild Base and revel in the lively atmosphere it brings! Hurry, before they pack it up and move to the next city!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iRfZuLK.jpeg[/img]

Time's a ticking! Head on over to the [b]Item Mall[/b] and get them, cause they ain't gonna stay there for long!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: The Hedgehog Farm Needs Help!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/67dAAWL.jpeg[/img]
Heya, adventurers! The 2024 Halloween Event is ending, but that don't mean you can relax, alright? Farmer Pho needs help Delivering Hedgehogs from their farm! From [i]11/06/2024 to 12/03/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i], achieve the hedgehog orders to earn points to get a bunch of rewards to aid you in your adventures or spruce up your El House!


[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies
[/h1][/b]
Time to demand attention and respect with the latest Ice Burner Set – [b]Empire Reign[/b], available for all but only for a limited time. Make everyone kneel before you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2QO3l5x.jpeg[/img]


It’s Lithia’s turn on the ring, and that shivering performance betrays her benign countenance. Care to share in her moment? Make sure that the cold doesn’t bother you, lest you freeze.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CSlntKl.gif[/img]


With such pressure from these new entries, let’s change it up, shall we? How ‘bout a new take on some familiar Skill Cut-Ins for Noah and Lithia’s 2nd Jobs? Mix up your style by grabbing these for the two’s 1st ~ 3rd Path!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1WpELPi.jpeg[/img]


We can only keep these goodies up for so long before they are gone! Grab them at the Item Mall before then!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Are You Ready for Fright Month?
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UJIHsUF.jpeg[/img]

Heya, adventurers! A spooktacular Halloween to you! We’re gearing up with events full of treats this 2024 Halloween Event, no tricks guaranteed! From [i]10/16/2024[/i] to [i]11/05/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i], participate in our Halloween Event to acquire helpful items such as [b]Sage’s Magic Stones, Phoru’s Foot Stamp Select Cube[/b], and tons of [b]Potions[/b].

There are even [b]limited accessories[/b] you can acquire for FREE! Join now!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qohSe3v.jpeg[/img]

We also have a [b]Class Change[/b] event that will spook your enemies and allies alike. It’s time you try something different! Log-in for a total of 60 cumulative minutes on [i]10/16/2024 to 10/29/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i] to acquire Class Change related items! This is once per account but the event resets weekly, so you can change classes [b]twice[/b]!

[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies!
[/h1][/b]
This week’s update is definitely a fest for a lot of spooks. Our Item Mall is packed with old items returning from the grave!

Whether it be Costumes, Accessories, or Motions, you’re free to get creative with your Halloween Get-up with these returning fits!

For the costumes department, you’ll find the [b]Halloween Nightmare and Candy[/b], plus, the [b]Ghostly Pale Pajamas[/b] Costumes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0qjRD53.jpeg[/img]


Brave your adventures with a little fun on the side. Let the [b]Little Dancing Spirit[/b] accompany you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QXqNUOs.jpeg[/img]


Bring out those thriller motions with the [b]Ghost Dance![/b] and [b]Jack O’ Lantern of Light[/b] custom motions!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RX1H9fI.jpeg[/img]

A bunch of Ice Burner Themed [b]Custom Eyes[/b] have returned for you to get creative with! Add more flair to your fashionable costumes with these piercing eyes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l1yZu0l.jpeg[/img]

Get ready to grab all these treats at our [b]Item Mall - Reorder Shop[/b] tab for a limited time!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Celebrate Another Bountiful Harmony Festival with the El Search Party!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5LEjDu.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week is going to be extra fun and extra bountiful for everyone. Get your inventories for the [b]2024 Harmony Festival[/b]! We have tons of in-game and community events lined up for you and you'll find out more about them soon. But for now, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store!


[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events
[/b][/h1]
Fall feels are starting up! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks!

[list]
[*] Let festival music fill the Elrios' airwaves! Strum along to Noel with your Ukulele and get [b][Cobo] Noel's Impromptu Music Sheets[/b] which you can exchange for awesome rewards! What those rewards are, you just have to find out!
[*] Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!
[*] Get ready because the Burning Boost for the duration is [b]FREE ENTRY[/b] to the [b]Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode, Pruinaum, Monaterra, and Serpentium[/b]! You also get [b]+1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward[/b] which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!
[*] We also have exclusive Harmony Festival Food! The [b]Harmony Festival Pie is totally FREE[/b]!
[*] The bonfire site is back! Hang out in there for a minimum of 1 minute to get dungeon-exclusive boosts like: [b]Physical/Magical Attack Power 5% Increase, EXP 50%, and Adaptation 3%[/b]!
[*] And there's truly so much more happening which you have to check out on your own!
[/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Nothing scares weak-willed enemies more than stern-looking heroes! Dress up in either the black or white coloration of the newest [b]Iconic Record Costume Sets[/b] this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vghmN0K.jpeg[/img]

Harness the shadows or control Time and Space; Lithia's ready for both! Choose to complete one or both of Lithia's newest fits: [b]Black Mass or Henir - Lord of Time and Space IB Sets[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y9zsyft.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: A New Raid Has Appeared! Challenge the Tower of Serpentium!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dPVitKG.png[/img]

Heya adventurers! Excited for the upcoming [b]Serpentium Raid[/b] update? Here's to hoping that your [b]Path to Becoming Stronger[/b] is going well!

This week will be filled with a lot of challenging updates. Cobo is ready to support you with your adventuring needs as you challenge Serpentium Raid with the [b]To Serpentium Event[/b]! 

[h1][b]To Serpentium Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]09/11/2024 – 09/24/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
To celebrate the addition of [b]Serpentium Tower[/b] and [b]Orchestra Hall[/b], Cobo is here to provide you with additional support with the [b]To Serpentium Event[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O2n5sKU.jpeg[/img]


Characters level 99 and up can do the weekly tasks, per account, to acquire a [b][Cobo] Raid Support Consumable Cube[/b] and [b][Cobo] Serpentium Authorization Tag[/b]! What’s more is that this mission resets every Wednesday!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies!
[/b][/h1]
[i]09/11/2024 – 11/05/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
This update doesn’t end with just the overflowing events! Who’s to say you can’t face all these challenges in style?

Lithia, for example, is ready to face the challenge wearing her new [b]Ice Cream Soda[/b] outfit!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Dv1ZcAv.png[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Discover New Lands and Rally Beneath the Sky Fortress!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XWThcDk.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Let us welcome another action-packed week and explore the newest region that's coming out - [b]Serpentium[/b]! Fight new enemies, explore novel surroundings, and interact with NPCs in this newly opened region. What's more is that plenty of simple tasks will reap amazing rewards, so don't miss out! And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful new things we have the Item Mall just for you!


[h1][b]Path to Becoming Stronger Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]08/28/2024 - 09/24/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
After the Punch Master hype, we have another epic event that requires very little effort to get amazing rewards! Just [b]complete simple quest conditions[/b] to get your hands on rewards such as: [b]1,500 Tenebrous Auras, [Cobo] Consumable Bundles[/b], and more!


[h1][b]Serpentium Update Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]08/28/2024 - 09/10/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Experience what kind of power Serpentium has to offer! Just [b]login for 10 cumulative minutes[/b] to get your hands on a [b][Cobo] Serpentium Region Trial Cube[/b]!


[h1][b]2024 Labor Day Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]09/02/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Spend your well-earned holiday with Elsword and the gang because rewards and an epic burning event awaits! A total of [b]20 cumulative login minutes[/b] will get you [b]1 [Cobo] Unlimited Refined Recovery Potion and 1 [Cobo] Unlimited Fighter Potion[/b]! Enjoy [b]x2 Item Drop Rate for 24-hours[/b]!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Head into the coast and enjoy the refreshing summer breeze as you don the newest [b]Chifon Costar Costume Set[/b]! Leave your heavy equipment behind and relax!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtYiggG.jpeg
[/img]

Lithia leaves her worries behind as she enjoys a unique teatime experience with [b]Pink/Sky Teatime Splash Custom Motion[/b]! Now here's a different way to cool off!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GuGWm4G.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Last week was an action-packed one so it's going to be a chill week! We want you to complete all the events like get your very own Vestige of Soul from the [b]VoS Weapon Provision Event[/b], if you haven't yet. And don't forget to level up your Resonance or increase you Combat Power with the [b]Hyper Punch Master Event[/b] as well as the [b]Clear the Raid Events[/b] that are still ongoing! notes.title: Unleash Your Draconic Spirit and Break Power Ceilings with Hyper Punch Master!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HlrgEZP.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your seats because it's going to be an extremely jam-packed week as your ascend to power begins! Punch your way to the top but this time we're making it a little more challenging with the [b]Hyper Punch Master Event[/b]. But that's not all, find out how you can get your hands on a [b]+11 Vestige of Soul [/b]below. To top it all off get ready for an exciting weekend of burning with the[b] Summer Update Special Burning Event![/b] And don't forget, [b]Elrios Pass Season 8[/b] has begun, maximize your adventures and don't dawdle.  And as always, whether it's a chill of action-packed weekend, don't forget to take a look at the fun items we have at the Item Mall this week!


[h1][b]Solace PVP Championship (2v2 Tournament)
[/b][/h1]With the new PVP updates we couldn’t resist hosting a tournament to test out the new additions and feature even more classes from the last time we held one! Registration is now open until [b]August 18th (23:59 PDT) for Solace (NA)[/b] players, so find your duo partner and register! Those who make it to Top 8 are guaranteed prizes, including K-Ching or even cold hard cash! If you need help with finding a partner, reach out to our GMs to assist you!

You can register at the following link:
[b]https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-solace-pvp-championship/
[/b]

[h1][b]Hyper Punch Master (HPM) & Clear the Raid Event
[/b][/h1][i]08/14/2024 – 10/08/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!
• Start racking up rewards through HPM if your Combat Power is anywhere [b]below 9 Million[/b]!
• Don't miss out on the Hyper Punch Master Burning Event where you'll get a buff of [b]Adaptation 20%[/b] as well as get increased Resonance Level through the [b]Resonance Burning Event![/b]
• Then immediately continue with even better rewards through Clear the Raid Event once your combat power reaches [b]above 9 Million![/b]
• Get [b]Senpai Points ♥[/b] when you clear Pruinaum and Abyss Raids and exchange your points for useful rewards!


[b][h1]+11 Vestige of Soul Weapon Provision Event
[/h1][/b][i]08/14/2024 – 10/08/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]
This is not a drill. I repeat, this is not a drill! Just complete [b]a cumulative login time of 60 MINUTES[/b] to get not only a [b][Cobo] Weapon Growth Quest Count x3 Medal - Vestige of Soul (1 Day) Cube[/b], but also get a [b][Cobo] +11 Vestige of Soul - Weapon of Requiem Cube[/b]. Don't miss your chance!


[b][h1]Summer Update Special Burning Event[/h1]
[/b][i]08/17/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PDT)[/i]
Take your weekends to the level and make it hotter with a 24-hour burning event! For a whole day you can level up your ERP with a [b]Resonance Burning[/b] (does not stack with HPM Resonance Burning) and with just 10 minutes of cumulative login, you can get [b][Cobo] Unlimited Potion 2 Kinds (1 Day) Cube[/b]!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]Harness the power of the epic mythical creatures with the[b] IB: Ascending Dragon[/b]. Enemies will flee at the sight majestic presence! Complete the whole set this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S5WvEuN.jpeg[image]
[/img]


Move with grace and dance with purpose with the newest [b]Costume Suit: Pure White Attitude[/b]! Step left and right like a majestic swan with the included Custom Motion!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LZpMPs0.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zoAbTYZ.gif[/img]

Lithia will never feel thirst again with her newest custom motion that's perfect for sweltering hot summers! Let her cool off with her very own [b]Sparkling Shower Custom Motion[/b] and let the heat dissipate!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o50gyBq.jpeg[image][/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

Hello, Elpeeps!

We are excited to announce the 2v2 Solace PvP Championship! This tournament features a cash prize pool alongside numerous changes to the format based on player feedback. Check out the details below and head to the official website to register now: https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-solace-pvp-championship/!

[b]Registration Period:[/b] August 5th (Mon) ~ August 18th (Sun) 23:59 PDT

[b]●	Day 1:[/b] August 23rd (Fri) 17:00 PDT

All tournament matches will be livestreamed on Twitch (https://www.twitch.tv/elsword) and YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@Elsword) at the start time for each tournament date.

notes.title: Gear Up and Upgrade Your Summer Experience in Style!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a5HaZpM.png[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s raining rewards as [b]Hedgehog Draw Lots[/b] and [b]Class Change Chance[/b] continue to run this week! That said, the gang is still enjoying their well-prepared summer vacation, as more Summer Themed Items are added in the Item Mall!

[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies
[/h1][/b]
Dive in with your most adorable companion! [b]Moli Tube Accessories[/b] are added in the Item Mall for a limited time!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JpIwWwt.png[/img]

Lithia goes on an island vacation bringing these new costumes to match! Embody elegance wearing the [b]Pure Vacation[/b] swimsuit!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UhCxjT2.png[/img]

Take a detour and soak in the sun while exploring the beaches of Elrios with [b]Core Black/Natural White Swimwear[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P0z2DYn.png[/img]

Embrace the mystery of the vast waters of Elrios as you wear the mystifying [b]Deep Blue Eyes[/b] for Lithia!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5xvvrEK.png[/img]

And so much more!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Hedgehog is Here to Bring Wonderful Rewards!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V3XvE6j.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Don't miss your chance for exciting activities and plentiful rewards this week! [b]Hedgehog Draw Lots[/b] is back so you can get free prize tickets just by logging in! Also, [b]Class Change Chance[/b] is here to let you experience something different. And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful things we have at the Item Mall for this jam-packed week!


[b][h1]Hedgehog Draw Lots Event[/h1][/b]
[i]07/31/2024 - 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i][list]
[*] Your daily log ins will not go unrewarded! Get prize tickets and accumulate them! You'll get a plethora of useful rewards for your adventures!
[*] When you clear dungeons within your level range 3 times daily, you'll get 1 Prize Ticket.
[*] Clearing 10 dungeons within your level range weekly will give you 2 Prize Tickets!
[*] The more you draw, the better the rewards you'll get! Get your hands on rewards like: [Luriel] Adventurer Support Potions, [Luriel] El Tree Seeds, a [Cobo] Spectral Amethyst or Tenebrous Aura Select Cube, and so much more!
[/list]


[h1][b]Class Change Event[/b][/h1]
[i]07/31/2024 – 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!


[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1][/b]
Don't waste your time under the sun. Go out and don an active look as you jog through the boundaries of sand and sea with the [b]Sporty Summer Costume Set[/b]! Coming this week to the Item Mall!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xnusIUb.jpeg[/img]

Take a piece of the ocean out and swim your way to relaxation in the streets of Elrios with Lithia's newest [b]Ocean's Dance Custom Motion[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iD8ZOaO.jpeg[/img]

Missed your chance to get these beloved mounts? Here's your chance to cop or more! Check out the [b]Reorder Shop for Summon Stones [/b]and grab your favorite ride this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zorKdBv.jpeg[/img]

And so much more!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Turn Up the Heat as Raven Takes Charge of Your Summer!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vLrk6GO.jpeg[/img]
Heya adventurers! This week, we're ready to get you into tip top shape with [b]Raven's Summer Camp[/b] Event so for sure it's going to be extremely action-packed! Also, don't forget to cast your vote on the [b]Lithia 4th Path Summer Art Contest Voting Event[/b]. You have a chance to win K-Ching if one of the artists you voted placed in the top 3, so check that out if you haven't yet. And as always, don't forget to take a gander at the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have for this week!

[b][h1]Raven's Summer Camp Event
[/h1][/b]
[i]07/17/2024 - 08/13/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
You think Summer's all about relaxation and fun and the sun? It is, but Raven's ready to put a challenging twist to your days so you emerge stronger!

[list]
[*] Raven's Summer Camp has a total of 4 normal stages and 1 Extreme stage. Finish the chain quests in each stage to move on to another stage. If you don't then you can't move on. Extreme Stage will only unlock once all 4 stages have been conquered!

[*] These challenges aren't just laughs, though. Every quest you finish will get you rewards such as: [b][Luriel] Red Bean Sherbets, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones, [Cobo] Shining Mystic Stone Cubes[/b], and so much more!

[*] Also, finishing a whole stage will get you an extra special reward. You'll find out what it is when the event starts!

[*] The Extreme quest can be done as many times as you can possibly do it! Choose 1 Special reward every time you finish it!
[/list]

[b][h2]Item Mall Goodies
[/h2][/b]
You can now live in the pinnacle of grandeur and majesty with the [b]El House DIY: Hall of the Sun[/b] set. Invite your friends, worshippers, and even enemies so you can show off how you live in ultimate opulence!

Ain, Laby, Noah, and Lithia are getting their new threads! Enemies will wish that the odds are in their favor when you "entertain" them in the [b]Trump Bunny Costume Set (Ain- Lithia)[/b]! And show them how fluid you are that whether you're wearing skirts or pants the [b]April Fool's Maid and Butler Costume (Laby-Lithia)[/b] was made for you!

Put on your [b]Light Denim Overalls Costume Suit[/b] because Lithia came fresh from farm! But if you want to park your yacht in the streets of Elrios, Lithia can whip out her [b]Black Ocean[/b] or Blue Ocean Custom Motion!

That's all for now, folks~

notes.title: Stop Those Thieving Phorus! Take Their Stolen Goods and Rewards Await!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zFlv5Z0.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Are you making progress in your [b]Lithia 4th Path Events and Community Events[/b]? You don't have much time left if you want to complete it! For this week though, a fun new event is popping up randomly at dungeons. Go on and check it out when it comes out! And as always, don't forget to check out the new things we have at the Item Mall!

[b][h1]Catch the Thief Phoru Event
[/h1][/b]
[i]07/03/2024 - 07/16/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
We've seen reports of Thieving Phorus wreaking havoc inside dungeons and we need your help to stop this menace!

[list]
[*] Stop that thieving Phoru and take his [Cobo] Thief Phoru's Stolen Bundle of Essentials! inside you'll find [b][Cobo] Fighter Potions, [Cobo] Giant Stone Apples[/b], and[b] [Cobo] Thief Phoru Emergency Rations[/b]! That'll delay their pesky tactics!

[*] Defeat 3 Thief Phorus once a day to get [b][Cobo] Thief Phoru Extermination Exchange Tickets[/b]. Exchange them through Ariel for epic rewards such as [b][Luriel] Floaty Mascot Seal Stickers[/b] or [b][Luriel] Floaty Doodle Shape Seal Stickers[/b] and a bunch of high value adventuring essentials!
[/list]

[b][h2]Item Mall Goodies
[/h2][/b]
This new costume is serving up styles of cuteness and functionality! Don't choose between becoming a maid or a cat; you can be both! Don the [b]Nyan Maid and Servant Costume Set[/b] coming this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/J5Lexe7.jpg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game

notes.title: This Vengeful Mad Magician is Coming and Will Leave You Spell Bound!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qIFHUkk.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It's going to be an exciting, jam-packed, show-stopping week filled with wonderful events and even more wonderful rewards! [b]Lithia's 4th Path Celebration[/b] is here, and we can't wait for you to try her out! The community's eagerly anticipating her launch in a couple days and has prepared a plethora of events with K-Ching and Merch rewards. Look forward to [b]Lithia's 4th Path Community Events[/b] this week! And as always don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week.

[b][h1]Lithia’s 4th Path Updates
[/h1][/b]
Come one, come all! Lithia's incredibly hyped to get this show on the road. Walk the path of vengeance and unleash powerful demonic abilities all while filling your inventories with rewards!

[h3][i]06/19/2024 – 07/16/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Lithia’s Contract Event [/b]is back. The whole El Search Party gets to participate and acquire rewards from the event quest every time a quest is completed daily! Gain a special reward once the whole chain quest is completed!
[/list]

[h3][i]06/19/2024 – 07/02/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i][/h3]
[list]
[*] Get ready for [b]Lithia’s Stage Preparation Event[/b]. Keep your eyes peeled or you just might miss Lithia's show stopping and twisted abilities to haul in tons of rewards!
[/list]


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]

"Beware of dogs". Especially when you see the newest [b]Pets Rime and Shiru[/b]! But don't underestimate these adorable poms, their attacks will leave you overwhelmed!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qC5xsiL.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KTxNDuK.gif[/img]


Lithia is exuding a traditional demeanor but is looking extra blooming! Like a bud blossoming in Spring, [b]Lithia's Eternal Love Costume Suit[/b] will make your heart bloom even at a glance!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VlO3vAx.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Block by Block, A Novel Weapon is Created!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rsIKOSJ.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It's going to be a fun week with the introduction of a new event. It's very simple with an extremely unique and fun reward, so look forward to it! Also, we've already laid out a pretty rough schedule of our biggest summer updates (you can proceed to the website to check it out), so look forward for that as well. And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have instore for everyone this week!

[h1][b]Block Weapon Making Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]06/05/2024 - 07/02/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Create your very own weapon that will certainly turn heads when completed! We've got the blueprints and all you have to do is make progress towards completion by completing quests! More details will be coming along this week so stay tuned!


[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies
[/h1][/b]
Spring has sprung and the season of knot tying has begun! Dress for the occasion and impress your loved one with the [b]Eternal Promise Costume Set[/b] in two colors! Match each other or show your contrasting personalities when it comes out this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8g04355.jpeg[/img]

Pop one of the most important questions of your life with this new, romantic motion! They'll no doubt say yes when you go down on one knee with the [b]Surprise Gift for You Custom Motion[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4MsW93a.jpeg[/img]

Lithia's arsenal of powerful Ice Burners is growing! This week, you can choose to complete her ominous [b]Dark Shadows IB Set[/b], her chilling [b]Glacial IB Set[/b], or her mech-tastic [b]Nasod Battle Suit MK2 IB Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BIwG5re.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GV4c272.jpeg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Time is of the Essence! Punch Through Limits Quickly!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6UZKtdA.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurer! This week will be a great week to get stronger! Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master events are back to guide you and deliver rewards as you punch your way to power! Class Change Event has also returned so you could try out try out different paths to elevate your gameplay experience! And as always, don’t forget to check out the many wonderful things we have at the Item Mall!

[h1][b]Powerful Punch Master (PPM) & Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master (LB!PPM)
[/b][/h1]
[i]05/22/2024 – 06/18/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!

[list]
[*] Start racking up rewards through PPM at 300,000 CP until 1,500,000 CP!
[*] Then immediately continue with even better rewards through LB! PPM at 1,600,00 until 3,000,000 CP!
[*] Apart from getting rewards for each Combat Power milestone achieved, you'll get additional rewards just by clearing dungeons within your level range 10 times weekly for both PPM and LB! PPM events!
[*] But that's not all! Get a powerful boost with [b]Weapon +11 Buff and Adaptation 20% Buff[/b] for the duration of the events! However, please remember that these effects do not stack on characters participating.
[/list]

[h1][b]Class Change Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]05/22/2024 – 06/04/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and a [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Another powerful set has made its way to Elrios! With the new [b]Tourbillon Assemble Ice Burner Set[/b], you’ll become the master of time. Watch out for it this week in the Item Mall!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z3tCXlR.jpeg[/img]

A cute, new companion is ready to tug on your heartstrings. Time is ticking so don't delay with taking the newest [b]Pet Nona[/b] as your new forever friend!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JSQtqss.gif[/img]

Lithia is ready to patrol and take charge as she traverses Elrios' seas with the [b]Hamel Navy Officer Ice Burner Set[/b]! Or she can become a mythical, mystical creature with the [b]Holy Unicorn Ice Burner Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2sE54b8.jpeg[/img]

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Daily and Weekly Rewards Await! Just Announce Your Presence to Hedgehog!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xuQYjhp.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Have you begun joining in on the [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/13th-anniversary-events/][b]13th Anniversary Community Events[/b][/url]? There's plenty of chances for everyone to win easy K-Ching. Flaunt your Elsword knowledge by answering daily questions from the [b]13th Anniversary Daily Quiz Event[/b] or, even simpler, leave a message for Elsword to read! And as always don't forget to check the wonderful items we have at the Item Mall today!

[h1][b]13th Anniversary Celebration Event
[/b][/h1][i]05/04/2024 - 05/12/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]
We've reached 13 and it's all thanks to you! If you haven't started it yet, don't forget to claim ALL your epic 13th Anniversary rewards by logging in once for a total of 140 cumulative minutes! You'll receive parts of the[b] [Cobo] 13th Anniversary 3rd Promotion Costume Cube [/b]every 20 minutes. 

Once again, we'd like to thank you for your continued support. We wouldn't be here without all of you!


[h1][b]Hedgehog Attendance Event
[/b][/h1][i]05/08/2024 – 06/18/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]
Get your inventories ready because this week we're going to fill it! Get rewards daily by completing a quest and weekly by completing the daily attendance - it's that simple! Missed a day? You can just buy your missed day using ED~ Stay tuned for more info coming out this week!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies

notes.notes:
