Hello Elpeeps!

Tomorrow begins our 13th Anniversary and many rewards coming with it! We will be having a Burning Event (3x EXP, 2x Drop Rate, and Unlimited Stamina) all day on 5/4, with a free permanent 13th Anniversary Ice Burner being given out to all players! Each piece of the Ice Burner Set can be obtained by logging in for 30 minutes each day from 5/4/2024 through 5/12/2024.

We'll also be rewarding players with a permanent 13th Anniversary 3rd Promotion Costume set to get the look of their favorite character's class! The rewards will be available from 5/4/2024 through 5/12/2024, with each piece being sent your mailbox every 20 minutes, up to 140 minutes! This is accumulative so you will have a week to get the full set! Lithia players will be able to use the 13th Anniversary 3rd Promotion Costume on Lithia's 4th Path when released in a future update.

Check out the full list of events and participate in our Community Events to earn K-Ching in the link below!

notes.title: Lithia Joins the Research! Dabble in Unknown Power from Beyond the Rift!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FdwJawr.png[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week will be filled with powerful game updates as we trifle with the dangers of the rift! Lithia’s 3rd Path will be joining the crew!

Who’s to say these updates do not come with complementary events? [b]Lithia’s 3rd Path Community Events[/b] will definitely happen as we celebrate her release! Get ready to take that sweet K-Ching home!

[h1][b]Lithia’s 3rd Path Updates
[/b][/h1]
Only the best researchers get to dabble with the unknown and get away with it, even stronger. Get to experience greatness trying Lithia's 3rd Path out while participating in these limited events!

[h2][i]04/24/2024 – 05/21/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Lithia’s Contract [/b]is back. The whole El Search Party gets to participate and acquire rewards from the event quest every time a quest is completed daily! Gain a special reward once the whole chain quest is completed!
[/list]
[h2][i]04/24/2024 – 05/07/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i][/h2]
[list]
[*] Who else can decode the secrets of the rift but Lithia herself? Complete [b]Lithia’s Research Paper[/b] and rack up tons of rewards!
[/list]
That’s not all! You can even train your new character to perfection with the upcoming [b]Elrios Season Pass 7[/b] and [b]Ann’s Growth Support Pass[/b]! A plethora of rewards await from seasonal cosmetics to useful bounties. Get your chance to have them all!

[h3][b]★Secret Dungeon Reward ED Adjustment  Pre-Announcement[/b] [/h3]

From the overall ED Gain data  collected from last year 2023-12-06 Secret Dungeon Revamp  update to now, we believe that the polarization of obtainable ED has been  partly resolved.

However, we have noticed the ED Gain  from Secret Dungeons have increased 4 times since the Secret Dungeon update,  and the overall ED Gain up to 2 times. This numbers have far over-exceeded our  expectations, and brings concern that it may be a major factor in ED value  dropping in the long run. To prevent this outcome, we will be adjusting some of  Secret Dungeon ED Gain.

When looking at the ED Gain per CP stage in the Secret dungeon, the farming  based on CP has been functioning mostly as intended. We intend to adjust the ED  gain only in stage 3 and stage 4, as the amount of ED gained from stage 1 and  stage 2 have not been extensive, and we acknowledge the importance of  early-game ED acquisition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4961457/a5e2c80ff5a879153b370a8468dc457a6eddb102.png[/img]

We understand that the issue of adjusting the amount of ED gain is a sensitive  matter and approach it as such, especially because ED acquisition is directly  connected to the game’s economy.

However, even with all  this consideration, we believe the current ED gain in Secret Dungeon will have  a major impact in future ED value and the overall game economy; therefore, it  is imperative to make adjustments now.
  
The above adjustments  will be applied with the 4-24 maintenance. We will continue to check on the issue of ED Gain  and make sure that all Elsword adventurers can enjoy a stable game environment.

notes.title: Lithia's Second Path is Coming! Be on the Mend with Her Around!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x2ly32q.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurer! Hold on to your gems because this week is going to be extremely action-packed! Get hyped for the launch of [b]Lithia's 2nd Path[/b] and prepare your inventories for all the bells and whistles that's coming with it. And if you're ready for a chance to win K-Ching, stay tuned for more details regarding [b]Lithia 2nd Path Community Events[/b]! And as always, don't forget to check out the wonderful things we have at the Item Mall this week.


[b][h1]Lithia's Second Path Updates
[/h1][/b]
Let the healing begin! Out of the goodness of her heart and also to spread good in the Goddess' stead, Lithia's out here curing the whole of Elrios - not for free of course!

[i]02/28/2024 – 03/26/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
[list]
[*] Get ready to fulfill [b]Lithia's Contract[/b]! An event not only for Lithia but for the whole El Search Party! Get rewards from the chain quest every time you complete 1 quest a day! Get a special reward once the whole chain quest has been completed!
[/list]

[i]02/28/2024 – 03/12/2024 (23:59 PDT)
[/i]
[list]
[*] Don't forget about [b]Lithia the Field Medic[/b] quests! It's a Lithia-exclusive event where she alone has to complete each quest from the chain! Each completion gives her tons of rewards too!
[/list]


[b][h1]Magmelia Bloody Nightmare Event[/h1]
[/b][i]02/28/2024 – 03/05/2024 (23:59 PDT)[/i]

Here's your chance to complete [b]Bloody Nightmare[/b]! You must first gather [b]Magmelia Fireworks Exchange Tickets[/b] which you can get from special [b]Magmelia Fireworks IB Package[/b] at the Item Mall. Once you have enough tickets, you can exchange them for a set number Ice Burners which can range from 1 up to 100 IBs!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Back for the second time to offer you two beautifully crafted attire to elevate your styles are the [b]Shining Change[/b] and [b]Magical Bright Sets[/b]! It's your chance to get your hands on the Costumes, Accessories, Awakening, and Motions!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xPWbowr.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sjsm5Di.jpg[/img]


While the rest of the El Search Party will be having a second chance at Magical Bright, Lithia will also get her hands at the [b]Heart El Magical Bright Set[/b]! This includes Motions, Accessories, and Skill Cut-Ins!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zd5isWA.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AbWU2zU.jpg[/img]

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Stop Spring Sprouts From Emergin’! Stay Cool & Stay Chillin’
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EuR2VI1.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It seems like Lithia doesn’t want winter to end and that’s understandable! Be like her and stay chillin’ because this week’s pretty idle. Or even the [b]Lunar New Year Fireworks Event[/b]? But you better be ready for next week because it’s going to be action-packed for sure! Why, you ask? Well, just stay tuned and find out soon! And as always, don’t forget to check out the fun thigs we have at the Item Mall for this week!

notes.title: Enter the Year of the Wood Dragon and Celebrate with Elsword and the Gang!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Opbs149.jpeg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Advance Happy Lunar New Year! It's still a few days away but we can't contain the exciting celebration and events we have in-store for all of you! For a bit of recap: don't forget that we currently have [b]Powerful Punch Master and Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master[/b] to make you even stronger and fill your inventory with amazing goodies! Also currently happening is the Adventure Support Attendance Event where you get a random number of a featured weekly item! Don't forget to check out the other two events such as the: [b]Class Change Event and the Budding Sprout Event[/b]! And as always, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


[h1][b]Lunar New Year Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/10/2024 (00:00 - 23:59 PST)
[/i]
Celebrate the Lunar New Year with us! We've got tons of events and a plethora of amazing rewards to fill up your inventories! Better not miss this because this event only lasts for 24 hours!

Your 10 minutes of cumulative login time will reward you with a [b][Cobo] When Spring Comes Costume Suit (1 Day)[/b] and a [b][Cobo] Respectful Bow Idle Motion (1 Day)[/b].
When you clear dungeons within your level range a total of 9 times, you'll get a [b][Cobo] Respectful Bow Idle Motion Cube[/b] and a [b][Luriel] Hedgehog Lucky Bag![/b]


[h1][b]Enhancement Events
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/07/2024 - 03/05/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Level up your weapons and reach unimaginable power!

Choose to clear dungeons or win 10 PVP matches to get your hands on [b]1 [Luriel] El's Hammer (30 Days), 5 [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ores, and 3 [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scrolls[/b]!
But that's not all! Login once for 10 cumulative minutes to receive 1 [Cobo] Lucky Enhancement Equipment (2) Cube! A must-have when you're trying to take your equipment to peak levels!


[h1][b]Magmelia Fireworks Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/07/2024 - 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Here's your chance to complete [b]Aether Nobilitas[/b]! You must first gather [b]Magmelia Fireworks Exchange Tickets[/b] which you can get from special [b]Magmelia Fireworks IB Package[/b] or [b]Lithia's Magmelia Firework's IB Package[/b] at the Item Mall. Once you have enough tickets, you can exchange them for a set number Ice Burners which can range from 1 up to 100 IBs!


[h1][b]Magmelia Gift Shop Event
[/b][/h1]
[i]02/07/2024 - 03/05/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Accumulate [b]Betty Points[/b] when you purchase from the Item Mall! Get enough and complete the powerful [b]Rosa Lethe (Black) Ice Burner Set[/b] as well as other amazing rewards!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Lithia's definitely not going to be left behind - not in fashion, at least! With two new Ice Burners just for her she'll definitely feel she belongs in the group! Get the [b]El Search Party[/b] and [b]Archdevil Ice Burner Sets[/b] this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y4QhV7H.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3hfq2GB.jpeg[/img]


It's still a little chilly but the little buds of Spring are slowly but surely popping up! Be ready to greet the new season with the [b]When Spring Comes Out Costume Suit[/b] and pair it with the [b]Respectful Bow Custom Motion[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AbBs3S9.jpeg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gKLpSYd.gif[/img]


If you're a cool-toned gal or guy and want to immerse yourself in those kinds of colors, then check out the newest [b]Hair Color Palette[/b] in [b]Aurora Nocturne[/b] for your cool-as-a-cucumber hair dyes!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NoL2Hdr.jpeg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Gain the Power to Punch Through Anything!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/giw5FYX.jpeg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Hold on to your hats because this week is going to be extremely jam-packed! You had your chill week but now, we're ramping things up with exciting events and a plethora of sweet rewards! Grab your partner and unleash your draconic spirit to welcome the [b][url=https://elsword.koggames.com/lunar-new-year-2v2-pvp/]Lunar New Year with a 2v2 tourney[/url][/b]! Sign-up (if you haven't yet) and you can win TONS of K-Ching plus the recognition of being one of Elrios' strongest warriors! And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store this week!


[h1][b]Powerful Punch Master (PPM) & Limit Break! Powerful Punch Master (LB!PPM)
[/b][/h1]
[i]1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)
[/i]
Becoming powerful is a truly arduous journey but we're here to reward your chosen character every step of the way! Reach a milestone, get rewards - it's that simple!
[list]
[*] Start racking up rewards through PPM at 300,000 CP until 1,500,000 CP!
[*] Then immediately continue with even better rewards through LB! PPM at 1,600,00 until 3,000,000 CP!
[*] Apart from getting rewards for each Combat Power milestone achieved, you'll get additional rewards just by [b]clearing dungeons within your level range 3 times[/b] for both PPM and LB! PPM events!
[*] But that's not all! Get a powerful boost with [b]Weapon +11 Buff[/b] and [b]Adaptation 20% Buff[/b] for the duration of the events! However, please remember that these effects do not stack on characters participating.
[/list]

[b][h1]Cobo Company Attendance Event[/h1]
[/b][i]1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i]

Your weekly logins have a chance to give you more![b] Just login once a week for 30 cumulative minutes[/b] and get the weekly featured cube that when opened would give you a random number of the item featured!


[b][h1]Class Change Event[/h1]
[/b][i]1/31/2024 – 02/13/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i]

Waiting for your chance to change things up? It's as easy as staying logged in to get your hands on 1 [b][Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] for the first 30 cumulative minutes and a [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket[/b] for the succeeding 30 cumulative minutes!


[b][h1]Consumable Support Event
[/h1][/b][i]1/31/2024 – 02/27/2024 (23:59 PST)[/i]

Which of your characters need the most support in their journey to the top? In this event, it doesn't matter if their level 1 or 99, just input their names in the UI and they'll immediately receive [b]1 [Cobo] Budding Sprout Gift Cube[/b] that contains useful consumables they can utilize during their journeys!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
With Lithia's successful debut into the El Search Party, comes her full fledged debut as an ELSTAR idol! Check her out as a member of Mega Cake and get her all the bells and whistles that idol life has to offer: Custom Motions, Accessories, and more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3EdXKFp.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a4UsBAg.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cq6W9Us.jpeg[/img]


[b]ELSTAR [/b]is coming back for everyone! [b]ACE, MEGA CAKE, ALTER CROWN[/b], and [b]MAZE [/b]costumes, accessories, custom motions, and more have returned so that your characters can take a break from being a hero and experience the idol life for a change!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1dBUGQe.jpeg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QyIfh7m.jpeg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ehDuCtI.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! How are you loving our newest seeker, Lithia? Have you participated in the events yet? If you haven’t, well, you still have a bit of time to complete it get all the amazing rewards! And as always, don’t forget to check out the many things we have in the Item Mall for this week!

 

[h1][b]Login Event
[/b][/h1]
Ready your grabby hands for easy-peasy rewards! Why is it easy? Because all you have to do is login! Just 30 cumulative login minutes will give you 1 [b][Cobo] Vestige of Soul – Weapon of Requiem Cube[/b]! This is available for all characters not just Lithia and whoever opens it gets the weapon! And if you’re a Lithia, you’ll get trial titles from the [b][Cobo] Titles for Lithia Cube[/b]!

 

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
These fun and casual costumes are back! Elsword and the Gang can pause training for fights and train for stardom instead with [b]ELSTAR Trainee Costume[/b]! Feeling and little catty inside and want to manifest it outside? Don the [b]Meow Meow Mascot – Black Kitty Costume Suit[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qj9bVhT.jpg[/img]


Lithia’s second IB is literally heaven-sent! Enrobe this truth-seeker in an angelic garb with the [b]Archangel Ice Burner Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Q9IGBMb.jpg[/img]
 

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Elsword’s Holiday Event Will Prepare You For A Stronger New Year!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dH9UyIO.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Happy Holidays to everyone who celebrate it as well as to those who don’t! This week, if you celebrate the holidays with Elsword and the gang, you’ll be rewarded with plenty of items which you can use to enhance your equipment! And as always, don’t forget to take a look at the Item Mall for the wonderful goodies we have in-store!


[h1][b]Preparation for a New Adventure Event
[/b][/h1]

We may have reached the end of the year but that doesn’t mean you can’t prepare for the next! And ho boy, prepared you will be! We will have amazing deals, but you’ll have to watch out for it this week to find out!

 
[b][h1]Item Mall Goodies[/h1][/b]

Raring to add another cute mount to your collection? Or are you just looking for a cuddly, cute bear? Whichever category you fall on [b]Pure Bear Mount[/b] is ready to travel the lands of Elrios with you! Get him this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R9UYHfW.jpg[/img]

 
That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Lithia's Debut is Imminent! Be Sure to Pre-Register!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurer! We're a week away from Christmas so get ready for a busy and abundant week ahead! And whether you celebrate the occasion or not, we've got tons of event for you to enjoy and even more rewards to get your hands on! Also, don't forget to [b][url=https://elsword.koggames.com/lithia-pre-registration-event/]Pre-Register for Lithia's launch[/url][/b] or you won't get the extra special rewards! And as always, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store!


[h1][b]The Mysterious Rift that Appeared in Elrios
[/b][/h1]
Woah! There's a rift in Elrios that appeared out of nowhere! Simply fill the [b]Rift Shard[/b] by completing quests! Once filled you can get your hands on rewards such as [b][Cobo] Lithia's Soul Select Cube, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones, [Luriel] Fighter Potions[/b], and so much more!


[h1][b]Elrios Pass Season 6
[/b][/h1]
You’re in luck because this week, Elrios Pass Season 6 is here! Get your hands on even more rewards when you complete new Season Missions!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Don't let the winter chills prevail! Envelop yourself in warmth and look cute to boot while you traverse the lands of Elrios! Get your hands on [b]Winter Preppy Look Costume Set[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f2Q8HAm.jpg[/img]

Worried about what to wear this Christmas? We got you! These dapper looking garments are back! Don one of these impressive attires this week: [b]Christmas, 2012 Christmas, Christmas Dress/Tuxedo, Winter Salvation, X-Mas Fairy of Holy Nights, Christmas Velvet, or Christmas Party[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AJpvLy1.jpg[/img]

[b]and more!
[/b]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Discover and Enjoy a New Secret Dungeon Experience!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VaJj4f7.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! We've got something big planned before the year ends, but it'll remain a secret for now. However, for this week, we've got some exciting events planned that we know you wouldn't want to miss! And as always, don't forget to take a quick peek at the Item Mall for all the fun goodies we have in-store for this week!


[h1][b]Into the New Secret! Event!
[/b][/h1]
We're revamping Secret Dungeons and adding a new one before the year ends! Try it out on the day of release and haul in awesome rewards!

Completing conditions for the weekly quests will grant you high value consumables and a trial title!


[h1][b]Class Change Event[/b][/h1]

Here's your chance to experience a new class! Just login for a total of 60 cumulative minutes and we'll reward you with [b]1 [Cobo] Class Change Selective Cube[/b] (for the first 30 minutes) and [b]1 [Cobo] Physical/Magical Stone Change Ticket[/b] (for the succeeding 30 minutes)! The best part is you can claim these rewards again the following week!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]
Take heed for the rulers of the sky has descended and ready to grant you powers! The new [b]Aether Nobilitas Ice Burner Set[/b] will help you rule not only land but the skies and seas starting this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NCxaeqF.jpg[/img]



Tired of the home-y set-up you got going on for your humble abode? Why don't you turn it into an exciting coin-operated laundry place? With [b]El House DIY: Coin Laundry[/b], your house will be smelling like fresh laundry 24/7!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eqV9Lo0.jpg[/img]


That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Get Ready for a Bountiful Festival Month! Harmony Festival is Back!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SqeoIFp.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Whether you like the smell and taste of Pumpkin Spice, it's that time of year again! You know what else is back? The [b]Harmony Festival [/b]is! But that's not all, [b]Prof. Pho Attendance Event[/b] is also returning because we really want to fill all your inventories in preparation for the coming cold season! And as always, don't forget to check out the many things we have at the Item Mall for this week!


[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events
[/b][/h1]Fall feels are starting up! Plenty of rewards await just by logging in and doing super easy tasks! 
[list]
[*] Want to help out during the festival? Deliver food to the customers to get[b] [Cobo] Harmony Festival Exchange Tickets[/b] which you can exchange for awesome rewards! What those rewards are, you just have to find out!
[*] Don't forget to get your fishing rods ready because Helen has got some rewards to give you in exchange for certain fishes!
[*] Get ready because the Burning Boost for the duration is FREE ENTRY to Elrianode, Secret Dungeons, Heroic Dungeons, Pruinaum, and Monaterra! You also get +1 Additional Dungeon Daily Special Reward which stacks with your Elrios Pass effect! Plus, there are more daily Burning Boosts which you wouldn't want to miss out on!
[*] We also have exclusive Harmony Festival Food! [b]The Harmony Festival Pie is totally FREE[/b]!
[*] The bonfire site is back! Hang out in there for a minimum of 1 minute to get boosts like: Physical/Magical Attack Power 5% Increased in Dungeon and Fields, EXP 50%, and Adaptation 3%!
[*] And there's truly so much more happening which you have to check out on your own!
[/list]

[h1][b]Prof. Pho's Attendance Event
[/b][/h1]You want rewards? Well, we got ‘em! All you have to do is log-in every day for 14 days to get goodies like: [b]Spectral Amethysts, Dungeon Entrance Tickets, [Luriel] Sage's Magic Stones[/b], Elixirs, Potions, and so much more!


[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b][/h1]Go get your cottagecore aesthetics! With the new [b]Cozy Garden Costume Set[/b], you'll look like you're having a cozy time even in the midst of an intense battle!

That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

Heya adventurers! The action-packed weeks just continues! How are y'all loving these back-to-back events? Are your inventories filled to the brim? notes.title: The El Search Party Continues and Enter a New Region!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sn3Ft9e.jpg[/img]
Heya adventurers! Hold on to your mounts because it's going to an extremely jam-packed week! First, we open the gates to [b]Monaterra [/b]where you'll find out what's next for the El Search Party as they continue their story! Next, is of course the many events and rewards that follow as the new region is unveiled! And, lastly, don't forget to check out the Item Mall for all the goodies we have for you this week!



[h1][b]Monaterra Update Event
[/b][/h1]
Elsword and the gang continue their adventures as they brave a new region. Participate in the events and plenty of epic rewards will follow!

Want to get a taste of new Monaterra accessories and haul in other rewards? All you need to do is clear dungeons within your level range 3 times!
Start beating up enemies in Monaterra's dungeons! Once you've beaten enough, you'll get 10 [b]Harconium Steel[/b] weekly for each completed dungeon milestone!
And for this weekend only, enjoy [b]EXP x2[/b] and [b]DROP RATE x2[/b]!


[h1][b]Class Change Event
[/b][/h1]
Waiting for your chance to change things up? Now's your chance! It's as easy as staying logged in for a total of 60 cumulative minutes to get your hands on 1 [b][Cobo] Class Change Select Cube[/b] and a 1 [Cobo] [b]Physical/Magical Mystic Stone Change Ticket![/b]





[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Elevate your summer style with hints of mild pirate-esque feel! Don the [b]Pearl Mermaid Costume Set [/b]and enjoy the summer season without breaking a sweat!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WNXO3QM.jpg[/img]



That's all for now, folks~

See y'all in-game!

notes.title: Nickname Reset Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

In order to have more nicknames available for more adventurers, nicknames will be reset for accounts that have not been logged in for a long period. Please find the detailed information below.

[h1][b][Nickname Reset Announcement]
[/b][/h1]

– [b]Reset Date: 2023-08-30 00:00 Pacific Time[/b]
– [b]Reset Target:[/b] Character nickname that hasn’t logged on since [b]2020-09-01 00:00 Pacific Time[/b]
[b]– Details and Warning:
[/b]
[olist]
[*] Login data is checked per account instead of per character, so as long as at least 1 character was logged in since the target date, none of the character nicknames on the account will be reset.
[*] Even when the nicknames are reset, all other game information will still remain, and upon logging in, you can change to a new nickname.
[*] If you wish to keep your nicknames, please make sure to log in to at least 1 character in your account by [b]2023-08-30 00:00 Pacific Time.[/b]
[*] Reset names cannot be restored, and other adventurers will be able to claim them.
[*] The dates when the reset nicknames become available for use will be announced at a later date.
[/olist]

We will always strive to keep Elsword a fun experience for everyone.

Thank you.
-Elsword Team

Heya adventurers! Summer is here and to celebrate, we've got a jam-packed week! First of all, you've got another chance to choose a different path - try something new for a change! Then, you can pile up cute Phorus as high as you can to get awesome rewards! And lastly, to prep you for our amazing summer updates, we've got the exciting Summer Pre-Event for you! [/b][/h1]
Play this fun mini game to get[b] [Cobo] Special Gift Exchange Tickets![/b] You can exchange it through Ariel for a plethora of rewards! Which includes potions, [b]Shining Mystic Stones, Sage's Magic Stones,[/b] exclusive accessories, and so much more!



[h1][b]2023 Summer Pre-Event
[/b][/h1]

That's not all, you can complete the daily quests to get your hands on[b] [Cobo] Pre-Event Preparation Coins[/b] to exchange for more rewards through Ariel!

Heya adventurers! We've got a big fun update for Elsword's bond system! [list]
[*] Increase your Affinity Stage with your selected character by 1 when you Login for 5 accumulative minutes AND clear dungeons within your level range twice!
[*] You can get another increase in Affinity Stage by 1 when you use your selected character to clear dungeons within your level range twice!

notes.title: Traveling through dreams to ignore reality, Noah's 4th Path arrives in Elsword!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nEmitwu.jpg[/img]

Ignore reality and embrace your dreams with Noah's 4th path now available in Elsword! As Noah learns to control his magical power, will he lose control of himself? See what this power can do in our Gameplay Trailer below!

[previewyoutube=YWHDiOifaw8;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YWHDiOifaw8[/previewyoutube]

The past haunts Noah as he wishes to change it, but as he continues to fail, no matter how hard he tries, Noah blames himself. Confessing these feelings to the Clamor of the past, Noah receives guidance from Clamor, helping him to sleep and awaken with a new resolve. Feeling that he can finally have a good dream, Noah continues to learn how to control his power with materializing magic. With a new twisted reality become the new truth for Noah, he becomes a dreamer that avoids reality to achieve a morphed goal, with Clamor choosing to not share the truth with Noah, preventing him from feeling any more pain.

Noah's 4th Path Events are now live as players can obtain a free Character Slot Expansion Card to create a new Noah or any character they wish, available until 4/4/2023 (23:59 PDT)! More events for Noah's 4th path to encourage players to create and level their own and even play with others are happening as well! Check out the full details in the link below!

[url=https://elsword.koggames.com/noah-4th-path/events/]https://elsword.koggames.com/noah-4th-path/events/[/url]

notes.title: Ain's 4th path, the Corrupted Messenger, is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WR4xS3g.jpg[/img]

Corrupted by demonic energy and chaos, and abandoned by the Goddess which he served, Ain's 4th path has arrived to Elsword! Will this corruption make Ain a thread to the world of Elrios? Check out his gameplay trailer below!

[previewyoutube=5zIzMXLMz7k;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zIzMXLMz7k
[/previewyoutube]


Ain's 4th path takes a dark turn as he fails to fulfill his mission, resulting in the Goddess of Elrios cutting him off and never speaking to him. Desperate to hear her once more, Ain becomes anxious and sick, using El Energy to help maintain his body, but fears he has been forgotten for good. Coming into contact with the Dark El, Ain begins to feel an uncontrollable rage, but with it comes a new evolving power. Corrupted by demonic energy, Ain could not return the El to it's former state, but if the Goddess would not speak to him, he would do whatever it takes to get her attention. Will Ain go so far as to destroy Elrios to do so?

Check out Ain's 4th Path and Events in the link below!
[url=https://elsword.koggames.com/ain-4th-path/events/]https://elsword.koggames.com/ain-4th-path/events/[/url]

[/b]

[/b]

notes.title: Join Elsword’s 10th Anniversary! Freebies, Rewards & MORE Await!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7PtTxdn.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve started the EPIC 10th Anniversary Celebrations with a bang! I’m sure you’re all loving the pre-events we’re having but be warned, we’re not even done yet! We’ve only just begun! Stay tuned and watch out for what’s to come this week! And even though we’ve got all these goodies, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall because we’ve got awesome stuff in-store!


[b]Elsword 10th Anniversary Art Contest
[/b]
Get your creative juices flowing and show off your awesome art to the community! The best part? You just might win (along with 4 other artists) 5,000 K-Ching and have your art appear in-game! Here’s your chance! Submission starts tomorrow, [b]May 4, 2021 PDT![/b]
 

[b]Elsword 10th Anniversary In-Game Events
[/b]
We’re filling your days and inventories with TONS of goodies and rewards! This is an anniversary you don’t want to miss!

Get ready to get your hands on a [b]FREE Ice Burner Set! [/b]Elsword to Laby gets an awesome [b]Elpheus Set[/b], while Noah gets his hands on a formidable [b]Archangel Set[/b]! All you have to do is login for a total of [b]180 minutes[/b] starting tomorrow (PDT)!
You’ll also be coming out of this Anniversary stronger than ever with the [b]10th Anniversary Burning Event![/b]
Plus, your weapon and equipment will be stronger too! The [b]10th Anniversary Mini Enhancement Event[/b] only requires you to have 1 enhancement aid to enhance! How’s that for awesome?!
 

[b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b]
Tired of the bitterness of the outside world? Say no more, fam! Turn your guild base into your sweetest escape and leave all the unpleasantries behind! Transform your guild with the [b]Guild Contract Package: Dessert Haven[/b]!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R4mhgta.jpg[/img]


Don’t get bamboozled! Noah has disguised himself as the enemy to confuse them! He looks 1000x much cooler, though! Get [b]Noah Ice Burner Evil Tracer 1[/b] when it comes out soon!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4PMzD4i.jpg[/img]


That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’re Balancing Things Out & Rolling Out A Few Pruinaum Raid Improvements!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/F2T218J.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s a balance and improvement type of week this week! We’re bring you character balances that makes them stronger and better! And of course, we’re also rolling out improvements on the Pruinaum Raid! Want to find out what the changes and improvements are? Stay tuned this week for all the deets! And as always, don’t forget to take a look at the Item Mall for all the goodies coming out!

 

[b]10th Anniversary Survey and Art Contest
[/b]
Our 10th anniversary is coming very soon, and to get started, we’ve announced a quick little survey and art contest to take part in! Our survey results will be posted with our 10th Anniversary Site when it goes live, and the Art Contest  is perfect for you to show your talent off in-game! You can check both out in the links below!

[b]Survey[/b]: [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2021/04/join-the-elsword-10th-year-anniversary-survey/]https://elsword.koggames.com/2021/04/join-the-elsword-10th-year-anniversary-survey/[/url]

[b]Art Contest[/b]: [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2021/04/elsword-10th-anniversary-art-contest/]https://elsword.koggames.com/2021/04/elsword-10th-anniversary-art-contest/[/url]

 

[b]Pruinaum Raid Improvements Event
[/b]
Gather your friends or teammates and get ready to go on a refreshing raid in Pruinaum where you’ll be bringing bosses their much-needed pain!

When you clear dungeons within your level range 5 times, you get the following awesome rewards: [b]1 [Luriel[ Adaptation Elixir, 5 [Luriel] Fighter Potions, and 20 [Luriel] Red-Bean Sherbet![/b]
 

[b]Balance Patch Event
[/b]
Characters have been balanced and now it’s time for you to test ‘em out and the longer you login to test ‘em out, the easier you get the rewards!

Login for [b]30 accumulative minutes this weekend[/b] to get[b] 1 [Cobo] Class Change Selective Cube[/b] and [b]60 minutes[/b] to get [b]1 [Cobo] Mystic Stone & Color Change Ticket Cube[/b]! It’s super easy!
 

[b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b]
Accessorize and bring the beauty of Spring wherever you go! Don either the [b]Fair Spring Flowers – Midday Flower[/b] or the [b]Fair Spring Flowers – Midnight Flower[/b] and embody the bloom! Get ‘em when they come out!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/56ipUaR.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vuUcYw4.jpg[/img]

 

It’s nighttime and Noah’s ready to investigate crime in a dark and dreary city! But wait, let him suit up with [b]Elrios Noir[/b] so he doesn’t stick out like a sore thumb! Get ready to investigate when they come out soon!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NWSnlV2.jpg[/img]


That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Heya adventurers! How’d you like Part 1 of our QoL updates? We hope y’all are loving it because we’ve got more quality-of-life updates coming this week that’ll make your endgame life much, much easier! And as always, don’t forget to take a gander at the Item Mall this week because there’s a few fun stuffs coming in for Spring that we know you’ll love!
 

[b]Quality of Life Events: Part 2[/b]

Test out the latest QoL update and your time spent in-game trying out these changes will be rewarded!

[list]
[*] Your daily [b]30 minutes[/b] of login will reward you with a[b] [Cobo] Quality of Life Support 2 Cube[/b] that contains [b][Luriel] Adventurer Support Potions[/b] and a [b][Luriel] Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube![/b] So you can choose which dungeons you wanna hangout in!
[*] Your weekends will be even better! When you login for [b]60 minutes[/b], you’ll get a [b][Cobo] Quality of Life Special Support 2 Cube[/b]! When opened, it has [b]Spectral Amethysts, [Luriel] Chlorite Seeds (5%)[/b] and other special goodies! So, don’t forget to check back on the weekends!
[*] But we’re not even done yet! When you login for 60 minutes weekly you’ll get this awesome cube: [b][Cobo] Quality of Life Celebration Cube[/b] which contains titles to boost you up! Find out which titles when you get’em!
[/list]
 

[b]Item Mall Goodies
[/b]

[b]Noah 3rd Path Pre-Event[/b]

Noah's last path is coming soon but we want you to be prepared for another awesome path! Get ready to greet the Full Moon and be blinded by its light!
[list]
[*] Login for 20 mins to get NEW [b]Full Moon Orbs[/b]! You can test ‘em out immediately during battle!
[*] Get [b]2 Full Moon Shards[/b] when you clear dungeons within your level range. You can use these to exchange for cool items like: Phoru’s Foot Stamp (Gold), Sage Magic Stones, Dungeon Entrance Tickets, and more!

Noah’s about to train to become part of the ELSTAR group! But first, he needs his training uniform to train! Successfully open the lockers to collect Clothing Tags so you can exchange them for costume pieces! And even if you fail to open a locker, you’ll still get an Exchange Ticket so you can exchange them for items!

notes.title: Out of the Shadows and Into the Streets of Elrios! Noah has Arrived!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hjms0dI.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We know you’re super excited to meet Noah because we are too! The best part is that when he finally arrives our newest boy will come bearing gifts of the best caliber! We’ve got tons of EPIC events for you to join in so you can get your hands on TONS of rewards not only for our moon child here but for the rest of the gang as well! So, stay tuned! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the wonderful things we have in-store this week, including items for Noah! 

Moon Shadow Noah Release
We’re pulling all the stops to welcome the El Search Party’s newest member! He’s bringing tons of new items and rewards for everyone!
[list]
[*] Login for 30 minutes and 60 minutes respectively to get these Noah exclusive items: [b]Noah Diorama[/b] and a H[b]arque Ebalon Voice Speaker (90 Days)![/b]
[*] Excited to play as Noah? Good! Because when you keep leveling up Noah from 1 to 99, you’ll get rewarded for every 10-level milestone you reach! So, go on and get this boy to MAX!
[*] But that’s not all, spend your Saturday (PST) with Noah, to get a [b][Cobo] Noah Special Support Cube[/b]. Open it up to receive [b]Magic Stones[/b] and [b]Mystic Stones[/b]!
[/list]

[b]Invitation to the Moonlight Gala Event[/b]
Noah’s inviting you to his very special welcoming party and he’s got plenty of rewards to give away when you complete various quest conditions!
[list]
[*] Get rewards like [b]Spectral Amethysts, Sage’s Magic Stones,[/b] and even a [b][Luriel] Hedgehog Adventure Costume Suit [/b]not only for Noah but for the rest of the gang (well, depending on who opens the cube)!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Not up to go adventuring outside because of the chilling cold? Just slap on this adorably cozy [b]Fluffy Rabbit[/b] and you can go on your merry way to slicing and dicing enemies out in the open once more!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NAZbOhE.jpg[/img]

Be on your guard because Laby’s ready for a noble fight! Dress her up in this beautiful and elegant Elrios Noble Duelist Costume Suit and stick it to the man… or monsters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/f3GPIdy.jpg[/img]

Aw lawd he comin’! Noah’s hauling in tons of costumes, accessories, customizations and more just so he won’t get left behind by the rest of the El Search Party’s fashionable ensembles! Here’s a preview of what he’s bringing along!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BQdpj8p.jpg[/img]

And there’s more! Watch out for it!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The El Search Party Sings a Chorus of Cheers for the New Year!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DOkoDUo.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Happy New Year to everyone! We’ve ended the old year with tons of events and rewards and we’ll definitely have more at the start of the new year! However, for this week, we’ll let you have a bit of a downtime before we bombard you with exciting events and TONS of rewards once again!

That doesn’t mean you get to fully relax just yet because you still have to [b][url=https://elsword.koggames.com/noah-pre-registration-event/]Pre-Register for Noah[/url][/b] to get your hands on exclusive items before he comes out! And then there are Noah-related events to give you a chance to win K-Ching! Plus, the Full Growth Support Event is still on-going where you can nab amazing things like Pets, Accessory sets, consumables, Epic weapons, and so much more! notes.notes:

Heya adventurers! The end of the old year means the coming of the new! Prepare for TONS of amazing New Year rewards, deals, and more! Plus, get ready to meet the newest hero to join the El Search Party: Noah! Check out the sneak peeks and pre-register to get exclusive rewards but you’ll meet him soon! [b]New Year’s Event[/b]

Enter 2021 strong and with TONS of new items!

[list]
[*] Get a random reward when you log-in! The Fortune Cookie will decide what you’ll get! Which may be one of these: Awakening Customization, Mystic Stones, Spectral Amethysts, Refined Recovery Potions, and so much more!
[*] For the whole day, enjoy [b]EXP x2, Normal Drop Rate x2[/b], and [b]Unlimited Stamina[/b]! Time to get stronger before you enter the New Year!

And as always, don’t forget to take a look at the new things we have at the Item Mall for this week!

[b]Full Growth Support Event[/b]
When you create a new character during the event, they get all sorts of EPIC advantages and rewards! This is your time to get another powerful character!
[list]
[*] When you create any character from Elsword to Laby, you are guaranteed EPIC rewards once certain milestones have been reached (Regions for Elsword to Ain; Levels for Laby)! 
[*] Get rewards such as:[b] [Cobo] Combat Power Jump Support Special Accessories Cube, [Cobo] Shaviana Truffles Costume Full Set, [Ariel] +9 Apocalypse Type-Void Weapon Cube, [Ariel] +9 Elrianode Armor Cube[/b], and so much more!

[*] And every Saturday during the event is Burning Time! Watch out for either [b]EXP x2[/b] or[b] Normal Dungeon Drop Rate x2[/b]!
[/list]

Ready for a date in town but it’s super chilly? Worry not! We have the perfect attire just for Elsword and the gang! The [b]Romantic Date Costume Set[/b] is a posh winter outfit that will keep you warm but still fashionable! Get it when it comes out!

notes.title: Get Together! Join The El Search Party for an Epic Harmony Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FvNCylV.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! The Harmony Festival is here! It’s going to be an extremely abundant week for everyone with all the buffs, rewards, freebies and more that we have in store! So, get hyped and prepare yourself for the onslaught of bounty coming to you! And as always, don’t forget to take a gander at the Item Mall to check out all the cool, new things we have!

[b]Harmony Festival Event[/b]

Free your inventories because we’re about to fill ‘em up yet again! Get ready for weeks of freebies and buffs ahead!

[list]
[*] We’ll start off with a Harmony Festival-exclusive title: [b]Wise Peace Maker (7 Days)[/b]! All you have to do? Just login for 30 minutes and it’s yours! Get one once every week!
[*] Don’t miss out on our event-exclusive food items! The [b]Harmony Festival Pie?[/b] Absolutely free! Take as much as you want! The others cost a mere 100,000 ED! Just talk to Ariel to haul ‘em!
[*] The [b]Bonfire Site[/b] is back! Hang out there solo or with friends for 1 minute and get a buff! It’s a different buff each week!
[*] Also, get a [b][Luriel] Crimson Trace Reset Ticket[/b] once a week when you login for 30 mins!
[*] But that’s not all! Starting this week, enjoy 2 whole weeks of dungeon runs with these boosts: [b]Free Entry to Secret and Heroic Dungeons, Free Entry to Elrianode, [/b]and [b]ALL Secret Dungeons[/b] are open!
[*] Complete Quests to acquire [b]Harmony Festival Part 1 Tickets[/b] which you can exchange for epic items and rewards. Including the new [b]Harmony Festival Ceremonial Robe[/b]!
[/list]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

notes.title: End the Feud with a Long-Standing Enemy! Time to Become Stronger & Raid!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B40yUc8.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Prepare yourselves for an action-packed week! Berthe is back and he’s stronger than ever! So strong in fact that you’ll need a bunch of friends to bring him down and end your long-standing feud! Plus, a new raid means new ranking rewards and a brand-new legendary weapon!  But worry not, we’re here to help you fight this canine menace with plenty of boosts to get you and your friends ready for the battle of your life, so don’t miss out! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall because we got something wonderful in-store!

[b]Pruinaum Special Event[/b]

We’re here to give you what you need so you reach the pinnacle of strength faster! There’s plenty of easy rewards for everyone!

[list]
[*] Your daily [b]30 minutes of login [/b]will guarantee [b]20 [Cobo] Mystic Stone Random Cube[/b]!
[*] Plus, clearing dungeons within your level range will also guarantee [b]MORE MYSTIC STONES[/b]!

notes.title: Elsword's Laby Gets Her 3rd Job Path
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qTKQJ3r.jpg[/img]

The Eternal Night Takes Over the Adorable Brawler

Irvine, Calif., March 6, 2019 – KOG Games, a leading developer and publisher of popular free-to-play action MMORPGs, today released the 3rd Job Path, Rusty Child, for their newest, playable character, Laby (pronounced lab-ee). [url=https://youtu.be/A5b9OsAhnAw ]Check out the new trailer here[/url].

Laby's excitement from entering a new world soon faded and was replaced by a feeling of discomfort. She could not shake the feeling, eventually leading her to make a mistake in the battlefield. Despite this, she was able to defeat the enemies with Nisha’s help. Bellonde, however, was injured in the process and his wounds were not healing immediately like hers. She finally realized where her feelings of discomfort were coming from. 

Trusting Nisha to take care of her, Laby gives all of her emotions to Nisha allowing her to become corporeal while Laby slowly fades away. To prevent Laby from disappearing, Nisha turned her into a mirror and promised to make this world a place just for Laby - where she can be happy like before. 

Rusty Child, Daydreamer, and Nisha Labyrinth; come to realize the nature of their existence... together. Until the day all light fades to nothing.

Dark path stans and Laby lovers unite! Today is the day you’ve all been waiting for! The gloom and doom of Nisha is upon us! An Exciting New Adventure and special rewards are available today, including:
[list][*]Every 10 levels plus accomplishing specific tasks will give Laby plenty of rewards to keep her afloat as she explores her new world! Fill your inventories with rewards like: Accessories, Expansion Cubes, Potions, Mounts, a Mini Poco, and so much more!
[*]Plus, get more consumable rewards daily like Sage’s Magic Stones, Elixirs, and Potions when you clear dungeons within her level range![/list]

The Laby 3rd Job Path Event begins today and concludes on March 19 at 11:59 PDT.

notes.title: Laby is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/z33nCvY.jpg[/img]

KOG Games, a leading developer and publisher of popular free-to-play action MMORPGs, today released the newest playable character to Elsword’s roster, Laby.

Laby, short for Nisha Labyrinth, is a dynamic and explosive, in-your-face brawler with a unique style, all her own. She lived deep within the Black Forest for what may have been an eternity, but she left to learn about who… or ‘what’ she really is. Everything is exciting and new to Laby and she is always eager to learn more about herself and the world around her. Laby’s mirror, Nisha, is her trusted ally and confidant; it helps her out as if it has its own conscience. Adept at using her fists, she will occasionally utilize her mirror in combat. Couple this cute, mysterious character with a brooding and engaging story, seething with fantasy, bamboo forests, pirates and a dark undertone and you have Laby, one of the most anticipated character releases to date.

Heya adventurers! We’re giving you more reasons to be extra excited this week starting with our fun yearly celebration of the Harmony Festival! Enjoy boosts, free consumables, titles, epic rewards, pets and more! This is a festival you definitely don’t want to miss! After some fun at the festival, it’s time to get pumped up for a show at Velder Academy's very own concert hall! Defeat the Phoru wreaking havoc on music-loving patrons and get awesome rewards (even an adorable exchange-exclusive pet) from this new Event Dungeon! And lastly, don’t forget that we have some fun new stuff at the Item Mall for you to check out so watch out for all of these and more, tomorrow!

[h1][b]Harmony Festival Events[/b][/h1]
There’s so many ways for you to enjoy this year’s Harmony Festival and much like past festivals, it’s going to be totally awesome!
[list][*]Everyone’s going to get a festival boost that adds [b]+5% of Physical, Magical Attack Power[/b] and [b]HP![/b]
[*]Special Harmony Festival titles and special consumables are back! But only available for a limited time!
[*]There will also be an awesome Special Dungeon Burning event, so watch out for it!
[*]Don’t forget to do quests for the [b]Harmony Festival Tickets[/b] which you can use for Ariel exchanges! They have some really cool and useful rewards tomorrow!
[*]Simply logging in for 30 minutes will reward you with a [b]7-Day [Cobo] Milky Way Accessory Set![/b] So, you can try out some fun, new accessories for music lovers!
[*]And there’s so much more! You’ll have to see for yourself![/list]

notes.title: Brace Yourself! A New Week Means TONS of New Updates and Events!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jt0jUkt.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s time to brace yourselves again this week because we’ve got tons of exciting new updates! First up, the El Search Party has discovered another dungeon at the Demon Realm, journey with them and find out what manner of creatures roam the area and uncover what will happen in their journey! Speaking of the Demon Realm, we’re adding a Story Mode in the Raid Dungeon which requires less Combat Power! Now, you can learn the story with less stress and then you can just come back to deal with the real fight in Normal Mode if you wish!

Next up, it’s the start of PVP League Season 3! Ranks will reset and everyone will get a fresh start! Will you remain on top or will someone take your place? For this season’s PVP update, we have two new maps for you to enjoy your fights in! So queue up for a match to check them out! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wxfhf2t.png[/img]

Then, we have a Balance Patch to iron out certain character skills. Plus, more Guild updates are released to increase every guilds’ quality of life in the game! And last, but not the least, we’re rolling out a fun new event with rewards to choose from! Come have a look tomorrow to find out what rewards you’ll get to choose from! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for some brand-new goodies! 

[h1][b]Choose Your Reward Event[/b][/h1]
We’re giving plenty of rewards and you get to choose which one you’ll receive! From potions to amulets to magic stones, take your pick!
[list][*]After clearing 2 dungeons within your level range, you can choose your reward for the day! Do that again the next day and choose another reward! It’s totes awesome![/list]

[h1][b]Shadow Vein Event[/b][/h1]

We’ve launched a new 3-part raid with 3 all new dungeons, the [b]Crimson Tower of Howling Flames[/b], [b]Never-Ending Darkness[/b], and [b]Crimson Cradle of Flames[/b]. 

After Nephilim Lord regains his senses, the El Search Party asks Nephilim Lord the location of the Dark El. Nephilim Lord asks the El Search Party to get rid of a tower that formed centuries ago, which was the cause of all the abnormalities in Spirit Asylum and in turn, he will give them the location of the Dark El. Plant and grow crops which you can use raw or cook them to make food with much better boosts, recovery, or buffs! Spend time cultivating guild soil so you can grow more! And lastly, we have a massive Magic Wardrobe update for you, you fashionable bunch. You can now store and apply literally hundreds of costume and equipment pieces even those from way back! Don’t miss all these wonderful events and more tomorrow!

notes.title: We’re Raising the Quality of Life Once Again for You and the El Gang!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LZZlVN2.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Make sure your schedules are open because we’ve got TONS of exciting events happening this week! First up, we have another Quality of Life update where a plethora of exciting changes await you! From free inventory expansion of old characters who haven’t expanded yet to an ED Shop in the Item Mall where you can buy costumes, consumables, pets, and more using your hard-earned ED! This may be the most exciting update yet! Apart from that, we’re also introducing a new Enchant System for all your end-game gears, as well as a more streamlined way to display and distinguish your stats on the character UI and on the weapons! And we have another balance patch to go along these wonderful updates! 

But that’s not all because next up, we have two new end-game dungeons for your adventuring needs. The El Search Party goes into the Demon Realm where all manner of new and sinister creatures are waiting for them! Explore these new lands starting with the [b]Labyrinth of Ruin[/b] and then moving on to [b]Guardian’s Forest[/b]. And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the fun stuff we have in store for you!

[h1][b]Demon Realm Events[/b][/h1]
Explore the uncharted lands of the Demon Realm and defeat its mighty rulers. Epic rewards are waiting for you!
[list][*]For characters level 99, clear the Labyrinth of Ruin daily to get [b]1 Leviathan Fragment[/b] and [b]15 [Cobo] Highly Concentrated Recovery Potion[/b] every time! And get [b]1 Forginay’s Leaf[/b] and [b]15 [Cobo] Highly Concentrated Recovery Potion[/b] when you clear the Guardian’s Forest once daily!
[*]You can also exchange [b]Leviathan’s Fragments[/b] and/or [b]Forginay’s Leaves[/b] thru Ariel for even more wonderful rewards![/list]

[h1][b]Are You Ready Event[/b][/h1]
Are you ready for more daily rewards? Who doesn’t want more awesome rewards every day? Not us!
[list][*]All you have to do is Clear dungeons within your level range once for the lowest number of rewards, twice to get more rewards than the first, and three times for the most number of rewards! Check out the website tomorrow to find out what you’ll get![/list]

[h1][b]GM Rush’s Play-The-Update[/b][/h1]
Watch [url= https://www.twitch.tv/elsword]GM Rush on our Twitch Channel[/url] on [b]Wednesday at 4:30 PM PDT[/b]. He’ll have a go at our all-new updates to help you understand what these are all about! Don’t miss this exciting blow-by-blow!

[h1][b]COBO Crew Streaming[/b][/h1]
The COBO Crew are back at it again! Come hang out with some of your favorite Elsword streamers as they play Elsword! We have a handful of streams this week, so you can plan accordingly! We will be hosting the streams on our own channel as well as have the schedule posted there, so if you forget who is streaming you can always visit our page and go from there!

[b]Wednesday, July 11th[/b]
[list][*]2 PM PDT: [url= https://www.twitch.tv/hanzo_j2c]Hanzo_J2C[/url]
[*]6 PM PDT: [url= https://www.twitch.tv/silvershimo]SilverShimo[/url]][/list]

[b]Thursday, July 12th[/b]
[list][*]12 PM PDT: [url= http://www.twitch.tv/gytka312]Gytka[/url]
[*]3 PM PDT: [url= http://www.twitch.tv/Jette15]Jette[/url][/list]

[b]Saturday, July 14th[/b]
[list][*]5 PM PDT: [url= http://www.twitch.tv/KayneTheSlayer]KaynetheSlayer[/url][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
From school swimwear to champion swimwear, level up your water sports attire to something cooler! Choose between the [b]Velder[/b] or [b]Hamel High Swim Team[/b] for your champion swim set and get it tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NcGYwEo.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Upcoming Quality of Life Changes (July 11th Update)
notes.notes:
[h1][b]MORE CONVENIENT[/b][/h1]

[b][Free Skill Slot Medal/Quick Slot][/b]
[list][*]All characters’ b slot and quick slot expansion will be free.
* Transcendence Skill Slot will not be expanded for free but you can acquire it by clearing a quest or purchasing it from the ED Shop in the Item Mall.[/list]

[b][ED Shop Update][/b]
[list][*]ED Shop contains Skill Slot Medal (Transcendence), Adult Pet, Fetch Aura, Costumes per Character, and etc. will be sold.
* Items purchased from the ED Shop can be stored in the share bank but cannot be traded.[/list]

[b][NPC Reward Exchange Function Change][/b]
[list][*]When exchanging multiple Random items from an NPC, you can receive different items.[/list]


[h1][b]FASTER[/b][/h1]

[b][Beginning Section Improved][/b]
[list][*]Noah’s Lake field will disappear and Elder Town and Ruben Town will be directly connected via porta.
[*]Quests related to Fields will either disappear or have their quest rewards and exp will be changed.
[*]Elrios Guide will be changed to Contents Guide and can be searched by key words.
[*]Required Level for Ereda Island and Quests will be changed to Lv.90.
[*]Quests related to Luto Mode will require Lv.75.[/list]

[b][Skip Function Improved][/b]
[*]When a Lv.5 or higher character uses the Quest Skip function, they will receive 50% of the EXP and receive the reward item.
(However, ED will not be rewarded and some quests related to Secret/Heroic Dungeons will not be skippable.)
[*]Recommended level for dungeons will be displayed on the dungeon select screen.[/list]

[b][Elrios Studio Quest Removed][/b]
[list][*]All quests related to Elrios Studio will be removed. (Players with already accepted quests can still complete it.)
[*]Quests rewards like ‘High-Performance Nasod Megaphone’ and ‘Cobo Entertainment Studio’ can be purchased from the Item Mall using K-Ching or ED.
[*]However, items purchased from the ED Shop will be tagged [Cobo] and cannot be traded.[/list]

[b][Mentor Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]Mentor Quest requirement will be improved.[/list]

[b][El Resonance Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]El Resonance Quests will be improved.[/list]

[b][Camilla’s Skill Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]Camilla’s Intermediate/Advanced/Expert Manual quests will be improved.[/list]

[b][Stamina Improved!][/b]
[list][*]Stamina spent from all dungeons and fields will be reduced and Ereda Island no longer consumes stamina. [/list]

[b][Old Character Inventory Expansion] [/b]
[list][*]All old characters with Inventories smaller than 8 x 5 will be expanded to 8 x 5. [/list]

[b][Market Board ED Limit Increase] [/b]
[list][*]Market Board ED Limit will increase from 3 Billion ED to 5 Billion ED. [/list]

[b][Share Bank Improvement] [/b]
[list][*]You can now deposit ED in share bank. (Limit 5 Billion ED depending on the player’s Bank Rank) [/list]
Share Bank now has a sort function.

[b][Secret/Heroic Dungeon, Elrianode City, and El Tower Defense can be entered 1 time a day for free] [/b]
[list][*]Free Daily Entry will reset every midnight server time. [/list]

[b][Secret Dungeon Tab] [/b]
[list][*]All Secret Dungeons will be moved to a Secret Dungeon tab. The Secret Dungeon tab will be opened at Lv.70. [/list]

[b][Heroic Gear Improved] [/b]
[list][*]All Heroic Gears can no longer go below Heroic Rank Lv.10. [/list]


[h1][b]MORE IMPROVEMENTS![/b][/h1]
[b][Equipment Enhancement Safe to +8!)][/b]
[list][*]Equipment Enhance can no longer fail up to +8.
[*][Apocalypse Type – Void Weapon Cube can now be share banked.]
[*][As you clear Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon without getting the Weapon Drop, the chances of the weapon cube dropping will increase.] 
[*]Even if you don’t pick-up the weapon cube, once it drops, the increased drop rate will reset.[/list]

[b][Epic PVP Quest Improved][/b]
[list][*]Required level for quest will become Lv.75 and the quest will become easier. 
[*]When clearing an Epic PVP Quest, you will be given Camilla’s Sparring Equipment Cube (+8) as a reward.[/list]

[b][Character Slot Revamp] [/b]
[list][*]Avg. Item Level will be removed from the Character Info UI but will be replaced by Combat/Defense Power. 
[*]Also, dungeon entry requirements will be changed from Item Level to Combat Power. 
[*]You can now check the below options from the Stats window.
[*]Some stats will be shown as % instead of numbers. 
[*](Example: Maximize 572 à Maximize 4%)[/list]

[b][Item Revamp][/b]
[list][*]Equipment set effect from beginning leveling part will be removed. (lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded), Magic Stone Enchant Socket numbers will increase depending on the level. 
[*]Depending on the Rank of Lv.1 ~ Lv.90, Secret Dungeon Excluded, will be provided more random effects.
[*]Specialization A & B will be removed and the A & B options will be changed.[/list]

[B][If Specialization A & B is a fixed effect][/b]
[list][*]Critical Chance, Maximize % 
[*]Certain Set Effects or Title Effects will be changed.[/list]

[b][If Specialization A & B is a random option or a socket effect][/b]
[list][*]You can change to the below effect from Ariel. 
[*]* Critical Chance, Add Damage, Maximize, Add Damage, Attack Speed, Damage Reduction, MP Gain (Attack), MP Gain (Attacked)
[*]Specific Skill Damage Increase effect will no longer appear from equipment. 
[*]However, effects that existed before this change will remain and all new equipment will have ‘All Skill Damage Increase’ option.[/list]

[b][Old Ice Burner Improvement][/b]
[list][*]Old Ice Burners will no longer require phoru footstamps to trade. You can now freely trade all Ice Burners without seals.[/list]

[h1]For more details on all the changes happening with the 7/11 update, please visit our website [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2018/06/upcoming-quality-of-life-changes-july-11th-update/]here.[/url][/h1]

notes.title: New Guild Expeditions and Permanent Daily Rewards are Coming At You!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oEACopF.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got big things coming tomorrow! Tons of exciting changes and fun events that we know you’ll go crazy for are happening this week so strap in and read on! First up, we have the awesome new Guild Revamp. We’ve added something called Guild Expeditions to make your guilding experience a tad more exciting. We’ve also added the use of Guild Banners because we want your Guild to Represent! Getting excited yet? You can find out more when it comes out. Next is something totally exciting because it involves rewards and who doesn’t like rewards?! We’ve just made Daily Login Rewards permanent addition to the game! That’s right, just log-in, spend time in game, and claim your rewards! Returning users will also get a special set of rewards when they come back, and the best part is, they can also get the Regular player set of rewards! This is the perfect time for you or your friends to return!  

Then we have another Elrios World Travel event! Same simple mechanics but totally different epic rewards! And lastly, we have balanced some of the characters once again for your enjoyment! But importantly, Transcendence Skills have been added as a socket option! You’ll feel more powerful! And as always, don’t forget to check out the fun new stuff at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[h1][b]GUILD EXPEDITION QUESTS[/b][/h1]
Build your Guild Banner so you can represent your members anytime, anywhere! These quests will help you get your foot out the expedition door!
[list][*]The more guild members you party with, the bigger the boost! So, party up with as many guildmates as you can to create that lasting bond and an epic looking flag!
[*]Clearing appropriate dungeons will reward each member with either [b][Cobo] Guild Honor Points 50% Medal, [Cobo EXP 50% Boost Medal, or [Cobo] Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube![/b]
[*]Participate in the Guild Expeditions and you can get special items like [b][Cobo] Royal Roll Cake,[/b] and [b][Cobo] Guild Elixirs![/b][/list]

[h1][b]ELRIOS WORLD TRAVEL 2[/b][/h1]
Go around the world in few days and you’ll get exclusive event costumes from places you’ve visited!
[list][*]Once you’ve selected a destination, you already get [b]25 [Cobo] Phoru Airlines In-flight Food, 25 [Cobo] Phoru Airlines Special Drinks,[/b] and a [b]1-Day Hair and Costume![/b]
[*]Don’t forget, all the [b][Cobo] Elrios Travel Coins[/b] you get can be exchanged to Ariel for consumables and exclusive costumes![/list]

[h1][b]ITEM MALL GOODIES[/b][/h1]
Your enemies will let their guards down when they see you and when they do that’s when you’ll strike! Become a fierce hero in this cute sheep’s ensemble with the [b]Mary’s Little Lamb Costume Suit![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Mlqsfi0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Heya adventurers! We’ve got an awesome and jam-packed week ahead of us starting with Elsword’s 7th Anniversary Celebration! Then here’s some good news for the raiders this week – Drabaki, The Serpent of the Mountain, is wreaking havoc in the lands of Elrios. And as always there’s new stuff at the Item Mall just for you!

[h1][b]Elsword 7th Anniversary Event[/b][/h1]
Join us as we celebrate 7 years of Elsword! That’s right, our beloved game turns 7 and we’re bringing TONS of boosts and epic rewards that are only available during this time! Don’t miss out!
[list][*]All characters level 10 and up will get an exclusive sit motion! The [b]Ely’lywood Blue Carpet![/b] Make sure to login all of your characters for ONLY 10 minutes so they can get it!

First up, we have a Balance update coming up, get ready for tiny tweaks that make a big impact on your skills, and don’t forget to test them out as well! Next, we have an event perfect for all the travelers out there – pair it up with tons of amazing rewards and you’ll be going places non-stop! And as always, don’t forget to take a peek at the Item Mall for new stuff and things! All these and more, tomorrow!

[h1][b]Balance Patch Event[/b][/h1]
Newly rebalanced skills bring for a more streamlined gaming experience and we bring a very simple but fun event with this important patch!
[list][*]Clear dungeons daily up to three times and get these rewards: [b][Cobo] Recovery Potions, [Cobo] EXP Boost Medal 50% (7 Days), [Cobo] Stamina Potions,[/b] and [b][Cobo] Mana Elixir![/b] How’s that for easy questing?

[h1][b]Elrios World Travels[/b][/h1]
Become the coolest jet-setter in all of Elrios! Choose your destination for the day and complete the quests to get awesome rewards including an extra awesome [b]event-exclusive sit-motion[/b]!

[*]Use the coins to exchange them with Ariel for the following costume suits: [b]Yukata, Martial Arts,[/b] and [b]Water Spirit![/b] 
[*]You can also exchange just [b]1 Elrios Travel Coin[/b] for [b]5 Phoru Airline Beverages![/b] Happy travels~[/list]

[h1][b]Combo Video Contest[/b][/h1]
Showoff your character’s greatest moves and become a combo master! Let out your creativity and mesmerize the audience with your character’s impeccable techniques. notes.title: Bring Order Back to the Velder Academy Library and Check Out New Sparring Features!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2Jb3k9o.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? Have you reached the peak of 3rd Job goodness? If not, don’t worry, you’ll reach it soon! Just hang tight and keep leveling. This week, we have TONS of new improvements in our Sparring System like Free Training improvements where you can now check for damage info, choose map options, choose a new NPC, and many more! We’ve also added Spectator Mode where a maximum of 4 spectators can watch and observe a match! Then there’s also a new El Resonance feature where you can add an El Resonance page with a completely different build! How awesome is that?

Apart from these improvements, there’s a new event dungeon as well where you can beat those pesky Phorus and teach Professor Banthus a lesson! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for all the awesome goodies we have in store for you! All these and more, tomorrow!

notes.title: More 3rd Job Goodness Coming at You with Daily Rewards – Don’t Miss It!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6yTQj99.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, this week we have another exciting event for you! We’re bringing you a very simple way to earn rewards and maximize your 3rd Job status! Costumes, potions, tickets, and more are waiting for you this week, so don’t miss the fun and the epic rewards! And don’t forget we have wonderful items at the Item Mall, so don’t forget to check it out!

[h1][b]3rd Job Finale – Part 3 & 4[/b][/h1]
Earn epic rewards daily with these exciting events! Level up faster, look spiffier, run dungeons and more with a plethora of rewards just for you!
[list][*]The 3rd Part of the Finale has to do with clearing dungeons within your level range a few times. Completion of the condition will give you [b][Cobo] Complete Recovery Potion x10[/b] for the first time, [b][Cobo] 50% EXP Boost Medal x1[/b] for the second time, and [b][Cobo] Stamina Potion[/b] and [b][Cobo] Mana Elixir[/b] for the third time! So, what are you waiting for, sweep those dungeons clean!
[*]Part 4 is a fantastic daily attendance event that lasts until April 1st. Curious to know what you’ll get? You’ll find out soon!
[*]You’d think that’s all we have, but watch out in the coming days because we still have more surprises up our sleeves![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Fly like the monkey-king and be one with the clouds! Control the weather and smash your foes with great ease! Get on a fluffy [b]Somi[/b] tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cIOjfTC.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6sHPJtH.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DWjEMj8.gif[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: 3rd Job Madness Brings Endless Fun, Amazing Boosts, and Epic Rewards!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Fum7ZGD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? We hope you’re still pumped and still have that 3rd job high because we’ve got so much in store for you now that you’re all very familiar with your favorite 3rd Job classes! This week, you can test out your characters and match up against other players with the PVP Revamp now that PVP Season 6 begins tomorrow! We’ve also got an awesome Enhancement Event to help you make your epic equips more awesome! And don’t forget, there are always new things at the Item Mall we can’t wait for you to get your hands on!

[h1][b]PVP Revamp + Season 6[/b][/h1]
It’s time to oil your gears once more because PVP Season 6 begins tomorrow! Ranks have been reset and you may just become the top dog this time around!
[list][*]Login for 10 minutes to receive a [b][Cobo] +10 Sparring Equipment Cube[/b] and a [b][Cobo] PVP Essential Items Cube (15 Days)[/b] which contains rings and a magic necklace!
[*]Plus, earn milestone rewards by completing individual and guild PVP![/list]

[h1][b]Enhancement Event[/b][/h1]
Hold on to your hats because another round of enhancement event awesomeness is here! Be sure not to miss it, though, because this awesome event is only for 1 day tomorrow!
[list][*]Login for an accumulative time of 10 mins to receive [b]2 [Cobo] Blessed Fluorite Ore, 2 [Cobo] Blessed Restoration Scroll,[/b] and [b]2 El’s Hammer![/b]
[*]Most exciting of all, for one day only, all enhancement aid requirements will be reduced to 1 when enhancing from level 8 to 13![/list]

[h1][b]Elsword Amazon Shop Is Now Open![/b][/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/T9aFUM9.jpg[/img]
Check out the awesome items we have in store for you! This Elsword swag is not only fun but very well-made and in high demand. All these items all waiting to be purchased and just a click away!

More items will be added soon, but supplies are limited, so grab them now while they’re still hot! [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/2018/03/elsword-amazon-shop-is-now-open/]Visit our website to see all the goodies on sale![/url]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Take to the streets and turn it into your runway! Flaunt this fashionable set and garner the stares of friends and enemies alike! The [b]Street Star Costume Set[/b] comes out tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CuG6IdL.jpg[/img]

Complement your Street Star ensemble with a pair of heart-shaped tinted sunglasses to match! This accessory is sold separately.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PhZL0zG.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

notes.title: Continue Your Leap to Greatness with Your New Companion!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wcd52eQ.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve finally completed the epic Third Job transformations for all paths, at last! Since you’ve probably already spent enough time with your characters, which one is your favorite so far? Are you digging the canon paths more or is the call of the dark side too strong to ignore? Let us know! By the way, how are y’all loving our list of amazing events, so far? Have you made that great jump to 90 yet? If you haven’t, you better not dawdle because this event won’t last long! With that said, last week’s events are still on-going so enjoy it while you can! 

We have two new awesome Forum Events with to keep your creative juices flowing, so don’t forget to check those out as well because winners will get TONS of K-Ching! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall to see what’s

[h1][b]Forum Events[/b][/h1]
[b][url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/229848-eldoodle-3rd-job-edition]El Doodle: 3rd Job Edition[/url][/b]
Now that ALL of the third jobs are out, we know y’all are gawking at their beautiful forms so why not show off your awesome art skeelz and win some K-Ching? All you have you have to do is draw your favorite 3rd Job Character and that’s it! That’s your entry! But make sure you follow the guidelines and don’t forget to include your IGN + Server!

[b][url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/229841-luck-of-the-irish]Luck of the Irish[/url][/b]
It’s time we go green… for St. Patrick’s Day! Celebrate the occasion by wearing your greenest and best outfit! Show off your flair for fashion! Take a screenshot of your character celebrating St. Patty’s Day and post it on the forums! 10 lucky winners will get 1,000 K-Ching!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
This messenger of death walks with you to complement your ominous presence! You can raise her up yourself for a cute (but just as intimidating) little [b]Morte[/b] or if you want to reap the full benefits immediately, the adult version will be right up your alley!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nSoSYk7.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Darkness and Destruction Rules the Path of the Corrupt: 3rd Job – 3rd Path is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eTzOr3u.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, fans of the dark path will be howling in joy this week! Whether you’re a Dark El user or a Henir fanatic, we know this update will make your shadowy heart giddy so don’t forget to participate in the events! 

[h1][b]3rd Job – 3rd Path Events[/b][/h1]
This is the last of the spectacular 3rd Job events that you wouldn’t want to miss! The period to reach the pinnacle of 3rd Job -3rd Path power in the shortest amount of time is now! 
[list][*]Don’t forget, just like before, each quest in the chain quest you complete will reward you with extremely useful items, costumes, accessories, and more!
[*]Get a [b]Topiary of Transformation (15 Days) and (Permanent)[/b] when you complete Quest 2 and 20 respectively![/list]

[h1][b]GM Livestream Today[/b][/h1]
The GMs will be hosting a special livestream today that will have exciting news too big to tell you in this blog, so if you want to be one of the first people to know what is headed your way, you won’t want to miss this Livestream! Livestream starts at 5 PM PST / 8 PM EST on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/Elsword]Elsword Twitch Channel[/url]. See you then!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lP5jGHW.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Fly like a butterfly, and sting like a… butterfly? Sure, why not! This elegant [b]Mariposa Set[/b] will make the calmest friend you have convulse in envy. Show off and slay foes while donning giant butterfly wings! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jilSFmq.jpg[/img]

And if you just want those piercing [b]Mariposa Eyes[/b], you can buy it separately! Stun your enemies with a powerful glance!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DeU5yAG.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~
See y’all in-game!

notes.title: The 3rd Path Opens the Road to Greatness! It’s Prep Time Again!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/86pVEeL.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How y’all doing today? As you may have read in the title, 3rd Jobs for 3rd Paths Preparation Event (including 4th Path for Rose) is just a few hours away! It’s time to prep once again for the last time if you’re ready to transform because we are so ready! And as always, don’t forget that we have new stuff and thangs at the Item Mall that guarantees an Olympic gold medal! Check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]Openbucks Promo[/b][/h1]
Still on the fence about purchasing K-Ching? This may be the promo you need to get you started! From February 21 to 27, 2018 players who load up using Gift cards from CVS, Subway, and Dollar General will get 20% BONUS K-Ching! Don’t miss it!

[h1][b]3rd Job-3rd Path Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
Get your 3rd Path characters ready because it’s their turn to have an epic transformation! Events, rewards, and more await!
[list][*]Characters you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Lvl 70[/b] during the event will get the [b]Book of Transcendence: God’s Will[/b] to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! This weapon alone makes it all worth it!
[*]And there’s so much more than you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details![/list]
[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Go for gold and outmaneuver your enemies on ice with the new [b]Frozen Edge Costume Suit[/b]. Perform pirouettes and ace your landings with the motion that comes with the package!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZgMbiOP.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!
