notes.title: Show Your Burning Passion Because Love Is in The Air This Week!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Md6tp7.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! This week we show our love to you with an awesome event that’ll grow your heart 3 sizes! So, watch out for a fun-filled day full of love tomorrow! And don’t forget our awesome Sweepstakes Event with TONS of epic prizes for players of all regions. The more playtime hours you accumulate, the more entries you get for a chance to win 15,000 K-Ching! 

In case, you don’t already know the New & Returning Characters Event is back at it again with boosts and rewards. Whether you’re a returning character or a player making a new character, we’ve got something to help you reach third jobs quickly! And if you have some K-Ching to spend, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall! There’s always something new and fun for everyone!

[h1][b]Valentine’s Day Event[/b][/h1]
Here’s a simple but sweet event for you to do on Valentine’s day when you’ve got no date! But of course, you can also do this together with your date!
[list][*]Get [b][Cobo] Sweet Chocolates[/b] every 2 times you use your Quick Slot items!
[*]Get your [b][Cobo] Couple Rings[/b] and show the world that you’re the best pair! Just clear 10 dungeons within your level!
[*]All this and more tomorrow![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
When the cold never really bothered you in the slightest, flaunt these [b]Shining Snowy Accessories[/b] in front of your friends! Available tomorrow!

notes.title: The Second Ultimate Path Opens! Start Your Ascend to Greatness Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zc8ygPS.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, tomorrow is the big day! Are you ready?! Because we are so pumped for everything that will happen tomorrow! We have plenty of events and TONS of awesome rewards for everyone so you really shouldn’t miss the 3rd job-2nd path launch! We also have something for new and returning characters so you can catch up and reach 3rd Jobs as fast as you can! And as always don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for new stuff!

[h1][b]3rd Job Events[/b][/h1]
Feel the rush of new-found powers once more! Unlock 2nd Path’s 3rd Job and reach the pinnacle of might and magic! Fantastic rewards are waiting just by logging in for 10 minutes and doing quests!
[list][*]Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but [b]10 Philosopher’s Scroll![/b]
[*]If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a [b]Topiary of Growth![/b]
[*]After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it![/list]

[h1][b]New & Returning Characters[/b][/h1]
Whether you want to start from scratch, you’re completely new to the game, or want to continue your epic journey, we’ve got just the thing to help you out!
[list][*]1st and 2nd Class Advance Tickets are [b]FREE[/b] in the Item Mall during this time! 
[*]Awesome chain quests for both New and Returning characters are available and will reward you big time![/list]

[h1][b]Facebook[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to check out our Facebook page to be the first to know about news, announcements, events, and more! [url=https://www.facebook.com/Elsword]Follow us![/url]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
No one is as sweet as the boy or girl who dresses up as a chocolate maker! Get the [b]Chocolatier Costume[/b] and start showing off your sweet side tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Qm6jLz.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

We also have something for new and returning characters so you can catch up and reach 3rd Jobs as fast as you can! And as always don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for new stuff!

[h1][b]3rd Job Events[/b][/h1]
Feel the rush of new-found powers once more! Unlock 2nd Path’s 3rd Job and reach the pinnacle of might and magic! Fantastic rewards are waiting just by logging in for 10 minutes and doing quests!
[list][*]Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but [b]10 Philosopher’s Scroll![/b]
[*]If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a [b]Topiary of Growth![/b]
[*]After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it![/list]

[h1][b]New & Returning Characters[/b][/h1]
Whether you want to start from scratch, you’re completely new to the game, or want to continue your epic journey, we’ve got just the thing to help you out!
[list][*]1st and 2nd Class Advance Tickets are [b]FREE[/b] in the Item Mall during this time! 
[*]Awesome chain quests for both New and Returning characters are available and will reward you big time![/list]

[h1][b]Facebook[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to check out our Facebook page to be the first to know about news, announcements, events, and more! [url=https://www.facebook.com/Elsword]Follow us![/url]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
No one is as sweet as the boy or girl who dresses up as a chocolate maker! Get the [b]Chocolatier Costume[/b] and start showing off your sweet side tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0Qm6jLz.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Get Ready for Another Round of Extreme 2nd Path Prepping!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VQYL4E9.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Guess what? 3rd Job 2nd Path is coming very, very soon and so we have another round of extreme prepping just for you! It’s time to hype yourself up and get ready! Before that though, let us remind you that you only have until next week to complete your attendance checks. Don’t miss out on another day so you can get more rewards by accumulating login days and logging on the last Saturday of this event! And as always, we’ve got an awesome new costume suit coming at the Item Mall. Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job – 2nd Path Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
It’s time to once again level up like there’s no tomorrow! Items, boosts, and extra special events line up an exciting pre-event so you better not miss it!
[list][*]First up, the character you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Lvl 70[/b] during the event will get the [b]Book of Transcendence: God’s Will[/b] to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist such rewards?! Not me, that’s for sure!
[*]And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details![/list]
[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Whether you want to look adorable while keeping warm or you want to have a tactical advantage on your enemies from the freezing cold, this [b]Padded Hedgehog Coat Costume Suit[/b] has got your back! Fight for warmth tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tYqb5Q0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Get Ready for Another Round of Extreme 2nd Path Prepping!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VQYL4E9.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Guess what? 3rd Job 2nd Path is coming very, very soon and so we have another round of extreme prepping just for you! It’s time to hype yourself up and get ready! Before that though, let us remind you that you only have until next week to complete your attendance checks. Don’t miss out on another day so you can get more rewards by accumulating login days and logging on the last Saturday of this event! And as always, we’ve got an awesome new costume suit coming at the Item Mall. Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job – 2nd Path Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
It’s time to once again level up like there’s no tomorrow! Items, boosts, and extra special events line up an exciting pre-event so you better not miss it!
[list][*]First up, the character you selected to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! You only have to do half the job of leveling that character up!
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Lvl 70[/b] during the event will get the [b]Book of Transcendence: God’s Will[/b] to bypass quests and requirements so you can Transcend in no time!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist such rewards?! Not me, that’s for sure!
[*]And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the juicy details![/list]
[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Whether you want to look adorable while keeping warm or you want to have a tactical advantage on your enemies from the freezing cold, this [b]Padded Hedgehog Coat Costume Suit[/b] has got your back! Fight for warmth tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tYqb5Q0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

[list][*]Magic Ice powder has been removed from the Alchemist store.[/list]
[b][i]Elrianode[/i][/b]
[list][*]Lowered the difficulty level of Debrian Laboratory and El Tower Defense.[/list]
[b][i]Camera[/i][/b]
[list][*]Range of the camera when players zoom-in has been expanded.[/list]


[h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1]
[list][*]When players have an El Resonance Point Reset Scroll and the [Cobo] version of the same item, the [Cobo] item will be consumed first. The pop-up message "El Resonance Point Reset Scroll is consumed" has been fixed to indicate the correct type of item consumed.[/list]

notes.title: Raise Your Hands if You’re Here! We’re Taking Attendance at the Start of the Year!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/O3x7ZXv.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you all starting your year? Got any gaming resolutions you want to accomplish? We can help with that! The start of the year brings so many new things and we want you to be present at all of them so we’re taking a daily attendance starting tomorrow! But of course, we’ll shower you with TONS of free stuff that will help you out through your journey to become strong! How exciting! And as always, there’s a cool new item at the Item Mall you can check out tomorrow!

[h1][b]Mystery Attendance Event[/b][/h1]
Don’t miss out on this extremely simple event that rewards you with something special every day!
[list][*]Log-in for an accumulated time of 20 minutes using whichever character. Open up the Attendance UI and click on the day to get your random reward! 
[*]You get a fixed reward every Saturday! 
[*]There are also special rewards when you’ve logged in for 3, 7, and 14 days![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Cure the disease of a bad fashion day with the [b]Elrios Medical Team Costumes[/b] for the El Search Party! You’ll always be ready for action with this wonderful set! Get them tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y5YqUl5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jUGa5u4.jpg[/img] 

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Celebrate Your Christmas with Elsword and Have a Wintery Merry Blast ALL Week!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jv8bkRO.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How were your holiday celebrations? We hope you’re having fun with our events and the 3rd Jobs as much as we are! There’s so much happening this time of year and it gets us really excited, but there’s more coming in this week. From Christmas Eve and entering into the New Year, we have got covered and you’ll never get bored this winter! Don’t forget to login every day because you’ll never know when awesome rewards or boosts are going to suddenly popup! And of course, don’t forget to check out the wonderful Item Mall for limited time holiday sales!

[h1][b]New Year’s Event[/b][/h1]
We want you to start the new year with a bang so we’re preparing awesome things for you! On January 1st, 2018, this fantastic one-day event will be the perfect way to start your year strong!
[list][*][b]DOUBLE EXP & DOUBLE DROP RATES[/b] for the whole day! Time to reach that 3rd Job status, fam!
[*]Get [b]1 [Cobo] Stamina Potion[/b] when you login for 1 minute! Run dungeons to your heart’s content!
[*]Clear Special Dungeon quests for extra special additional rewards!
[*]And lastly, clearing any dungeon within your level range will give you [b]2 [Cobo] Sage’s Magic Stone![/b][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to check the Item Mall for extra special package deals and steals! You just might complete your White Dragon: Servius Ice Burner Set in no time!

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: This Christmas, We’re Giving Everyone the Gift of Ultimate Power, Fun Mini-Games, and More!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HKBTt3p.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Christmas is just around the corner (we’re very excited!) and so we’ve guaranteed to make your Holidays extra special by bringing out the big guns! Are you as hyped up for 3rd jobs as we are? Because we totally are! A plethora of awesome rewards await you and a new skill system will unlock so you can tinker with it! But that’s not the only thing you can look forward to because we have tons of other amazing events perfect for the Holidays! Like the PVP Pre-Season Events, Christmas Events and so much more! Don’t forget to invite back friends who used to play Elsword or friends you want to introduce Elsword to because we have something extra special for them! And of course, holidays in Elsword would be incomplete without something new and awesome at the Item Mall! Don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job Events[/b][/h1]
The biggest and most awaited update in the history of updates is here! Elsword and the Gang break limits to unlock 3rd jobs and with it come fantastic rewards through quest completions or even just by logging in for 10 minutes!
[list][*]Only need a few more levels to get to 3rd jobs? We got you, fam! Login for 10 minutes (per account) and you’ll get not 1, not 3, not even 5, but [b]10 Philosopher’s Scroll![/b] 
[*]If you want a permanent accessory, this event has got the thing for you! Just complete the chain quest and you’ll get a [b]Topiary of Faith![/b]
[*]After reaching 3rd Jobs, head right on to the dungeons to test out your newly unlocked powers! You’ll even get rewarded for it![/list]

[h1][b]Christmas Events[/b][/h1] 
[b][u][i]Throw the Dice: Elriopoly![/i][/u][/b]
Go around the board and get rare rewards after your Item Mall shopping spree! Every 100 K-Ching spent will give you 1 Dice Roll that automatically goes to your Elriopoly UI! 
[b][u][i]Phoru Snowball Game! [/i][/u][/b]
A winter mini-game that guarantees TONS of fun as you try to accumulate points for certain rewards! Hit multiple targets at once for massive points! 

[h1][b]PVP Pre-Season Event[/b][/h1]
We’re making your PVP more fun before the new season starts with these awesome events!
[list][*]Get [b]2X EXP and AP[/b] when you win Arena matches!
[*]Encounter more Epic NPCs!
[*]Get a book that contains TONS of titles when you login for 10 minutes![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Dress up for the festivities in a luxurious ensemble that’s posh and fun at the same time! Get the [b]Christmas Velvet Suits and Dresses[/b] tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3hhYysZ.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all

notes.title: This Winter Season, We’re Bringing the Heat with Exciting Events and Cool Contests!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zraq7qY.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, it’s chill time again this week but that’s because we’re getting ready for something extremely big and super exciting! If you’re wondering what it could be, you’ll just have to wait for next week! But don’t get completely bummed out since we have tons of events going on right now! If you don’t already know we have an on-going in-game event that prepares our heroes for the upcoming third job. This is an event you don’t want to miss because of its insane boosts (like having half of your EXP bar filled every time you level up) and epic rewards! Then, we have 2 very simple Facebook events that will give you the chance to win TONS of K-Ching, perfect for your in-game holiday shopping! You can check them out and join here: [b][url=facebook.com/events/191936851366188/]Chibi ALL the Jobs[/url][/b] and [b][url=facebook.com/events/1517757765008382/]It’s the Most Wonderful Time of the Year – To Level![/url][/b] And as always, we have new stuff at the Item Mall so don’t forget to check it out!

This lovely winter ensemble makes its way to you just in time for your freezing winter dates! Guaranteed to [b]not[/b] make you look like a bundle of potatoes the [b]Lovely Winter Costume[/b] will keep you fashionably warm!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UkBgy33.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’re Preparing You for Our Biggest and Best Update Yet! 3rd Jobs Are Coming Very Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KXaGd9Q.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’re feeling immense powers looming over the not-so-distant lands and soon it will be yours! You just have to be patient, because great things are worth the wait, after all. However, since we’re so hyped up about it, here’s an overview of what will happen: Your characters will get the most awesome transformation you can imagine complete with the best skills you have ever laid eyes upon! For that to happen, we have to get you all prepped up that’s there will be tons of events and loads of rewards to boost you to 99 in no time! On top of that, we’re bringing you another much the anticipated update of trade improvements and ED limits! You can finally become the savvy business person you’ve always wanted to be in Elrios! And as always, the Item Mall has some wonderful new stuff for you to check out! Don’t miss these updates and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]3rd Job Pre-Event[/b][/h1]
Now’s your chance to level up like a madman! We’ve got special events and boosts to make sure you reach level 99 before 3rd jobs roll in!
[list][*]First up, your selected character to participate in the event automatically gets half of the EXP required to level up at no cost! All you have to do is half the job of leveling that character up! 
[*]Characters who achieve [b]Transcendence[/b] during the event will get [b]Book of Transcendence[/b] to bypass quests and requirements! So convenient!
[*]When you reach level 90, you’ll get a [b]Unique-Grade Heroic Weapon[/b] to deal an even mightier blow! Who can resist rewards?! No one!
[*]And there’s so much more that you’ll definitely need to check out the site tomorrow for all the nitty-gritties![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
It’s the most wonderful time for Ain! He’s getting two more epic Ice Burner sets to add to his wardrobe with the scholarly [b]Miracle Alchemist Ice Burner Set[/b] and the firey [b]Ignition Caligo Set[/b]. Collect them all tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UZz5jRC.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

Heya adventurers! How was your Thanksgiving week? We hope you were stuffed to the brim with all that wonderful Thanksgiving goodies! Did you get a nice big haul during our Black Weekend Sales? Heya adventurers! Thanksgiving is only a few days away and we’re so incredibly excited! But before that, we’ve got a fun pre-thanksgiving activity happening right now on our Facebook page and then we’ve got another exciting event tomorrow as well! You’d think that’s all of it but wait ‘til you see more awesome events and amazing deals coming to you this weekend! As for what they are, well, you’ll just have to find out! We have a very special Ice Burner set coming tomorrow so don’t forget to check out the Item Mall then!

[h1][b]Mystical Moon Rabbit Event[/b][/h1]
Hop on to this wonderful event that will shower you with TONS of rewards! 
[list][*][b]10 minutes[/b] of accumulated login time once a week for two weeks will give you a [b]Moon Rabbit Ticket[/b] which is one of the materials needed to craft an awesome costume!
[*]Collect [b]Moon Shards[/b] from doing difficulty-based (Normal, Hard, and Very Hard) quests and exchange them through Ariel for consumables. Better yet, you can also ask her to craft them for a wonderful Rabbit costume![/list]

notes.title: Out of the Screens and Into the Game, We Have Something Special for Everyone!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6WRG33x.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you all doing? So, you know when Halloween ends the fun Halloween Dungeon will disappear soon, right? Wrong! We saw how much fun you’ve been having at the Hide and Seek Halloween Dungeon so we’re making it a permanent addition to our special dungeon lineups. How awesome is that? Now you can play graveyard hide-and-seek whenever you want! We also have another Balance Patch to bring some balance into your gaming life! It also comes with a very simple event so you get rewards for testing out the balanced skills! There will also be other game related updates and improvements coming in tomorrow! And as always, we have exciting new stuff at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow so stay tuned!

[h1][b]Elsword Anime Recap[/b][/h1]
Wasn’t that last Elsword episode uber exciting? At last the El Search Party has reached Lanox but Edel was much too busy with Town matters to help look for the priestesses. What would become of our red-haired knight and will Elsword and the gang be able to find the priestesses? You’ll have to watch to find out, it’s too exciting! [url=https://elsword.koggames.com/elsword-animation/]Watch Episode 4 here![/url]

[h1][b]Balance Patch Event[/b][/h1]
Test out the newly balanced Pvp and Dungeon skills and get rewarded for it!
[list][*]Get [b]1 Balance Patch Experience Certificate[/b] when you [b]Play 2 Matches in Arena[/b] or [b]Clear 3 Dungeons Within Your Level Range![/b] Do both Daily to get 1 Certificate for each completed task!
[*]Get a [b]Skill Tree Page Expansion[/b] when you collect all [b]14 Balance Patch Experience Certificates![/b]
[*]You can also exchange [b]1 Balance Patch Experience Certificate[/b] through Ariel for any of the following items: [b]10 [Cobo] Complete Recovery Potion, 2 [Cobo] Various Magic Stone Random Cube,[/b] or [b]1 [Cobo] Special Dungeon Entrance Ticket Selective Cube![/b][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Play your Anime and experience Elrios in a whole new light! Relive the anime accurately with a costume and sit motion package that’s straight out of the anime ending credits! Get ‘em tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0ldUEsZ.jpg[/img]

And a new stage backdrop has opened at Elrios Studios! Become the idol you were always meant to be! Get a Cobo Entertainment Studio at the Item Mall to unlock the [b]Idol Studio[/b] backdrop tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oCEOHfM.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xmPa5N5.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How was the Halloween event? Did you have fun playing hide and seek at the cemetery? Have you gotten that adorably ghastly reward yet? If not, you still have time to hustle so you don’t miss it! For those not in the know, our lovely Forum Moderators are having another sticker creation contest fit for the holidays and it already started! If you’ve got that creative festive spirit in you, show us what you got and post it on the forum. Winning stickers will become part of Elsword’s forum community and get K-Ching!  And as always, we have lovely items for you at the Item Mall tomorrow so don’t forget to check it out!

[h1][b]Happy Sticker Days![/b][/h1]
Here’s to another round of sticker love for the Holidays! Get those juices flowing and create your best Holiday-themed sticker (Christmas, New Year, Hanukkah) and your creations will have a chance to be part of the forums forever and of course, you’ll get TONS of K-Ching as well! 
[list][*]Check out the rules here [url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/122576-happy-sticker-days][link][/url] and reserve your spot now![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PEWgnxH.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Get Ready for a Fantastic Hallow’s Eve Week with the El Gang!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OjZUFzD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a fun week ahead of us starting tomorrow~ But first, a few reminders: We’ve got two Halloween forum events whose deadlines are coming up soon! But don’t worry, you still have a few more days left to submit your awesome pumpkin art and Halloween El-Doodles! And don’t forget to keep exorcising those monsters at the cemetery for awesome rewards! See y’all in game!

notes.title: Monsters Come Out of Hiding as Halloween Draws Near! Hang Out at the Cemetery and Party with its Dwellers!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/f3IiMpD.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! You only have a few days left to complete the rewards for the Heartbeat Attendance event! If you missed a few days here and there, we hope you at least still have the chance to get the accumulative log-in rewards, but make sure you don’t miss the remaining days! This week, we’re going to do what every adventure loving chaps like to do; hang out at the cemetery! But we swear it’s going to be extremely fun so don’t forget to check it out! And we have a lovely Halloween set coming to you when you make your way to the Item Mall, so watch out for it!

[h1][b]Elsword’s Spooky Graveyard Adventures![/b][/h1]
A vengeful spirit is wreaking havoc and possessing monsters at the cemetery causing them to move differently and maybe say different things. Find out which monster is possessed and get awesome rewards!
[list][*]For 10 minutes of accumulative log-in time, get [b]3 Rusty Cemetery Keys[/b] every day from Monday to Friday, [b]5 Rusty Cemetery Keys[/b] on the weekends (Saturday and Sunday), and 5 more on October 31st! You’ll be spending your days at the cemetery for the rest of October, that’s for sure!
[*]We’ll also reward you with awesome treats for clearing the cemetery of its vengeful spirit! Clear it [b]once and you’ll get [b]30 [Cobo] Pumpkin Flavored Candy[/b], clear it [b]twice[/b] for [b]30 [Cobo] Every Flavor Candy[/b], and clear it [b]3 times[/b] for [b]30 [Cobo] Brightly Shinning Witch’s Amber![/b]
[*]You’ll also get [b]Ghost’s Trace[/b] which you can collect and exchange for awesome things from Ariel![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
You don’t have to look far for the best treat this Halloween because you’re it! This devilishly sweet design is enough to destroy your enemies with its sugar content alone (or so we hope!). Check out the [b]Candy Devil Costume[/b] when it comes out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bv5DnHb.jpg[/img]

If the costumes aren’t sweet enough for you (or the enemy) this little [b]Candy Devil Pet[/b] will definitely make sure to knock out some teeth! Get your sweet new companion soon!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GyNuJsf.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Become the Shadow that Stalks in the Night, Show Off Your Skills, and Give Them a Fright!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NztAneo.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Fall is here and we all know that means, Halloween is just around the corner. Treats here we come! Also, we've got an awesome surprise brewing for you this week but we'll have to keep mum about it for the time being. However, make sure you're as lucky as a leprechaun! 

We’ve got TONS of forum activities for you this week, you might want to join them coz K-Ching will definitely rain down on the most creative players! And don’t forget to check out the Item Mall because we’ve got cool stuff waiting for you as well!

[h1][b]FORUM EVENTS[/b][/h1]
[b]Elrios Pumpkin Decorating[/b]
How creative are you when working with pumpkins? If you think you’re the best, share your most creative Elsword Pumpkin design with us and you’ll be swimming in sweet K-Ching! [url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/98609-elrios-pumpkin-decorating]Click here to view the event on our forums.[/url]

[b]El Doodle – Halloween Edition[/b]
Who would you dress your character as this Halloween? Pick a favorite NPC, Boss, or monster and draw your beloved character dressed up as them! Characters with the most awesome costume gets a chance to win TONS of K-Ching, so start drawing! [url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/98613-eldoodle-halloween-costumes]Click here to view the event on our forums.[/url]

[h1][b]ITEM MALL GOODIES[/b][/h1]
Reveal your demonic side and become a dark menace that frightens friends and foe alike. Exude an aura of intimidation with the [b]Goatman[/b] set coming to you this week!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZUaEIWx.jpg[/img]

So you’ve got the costume, but you might want to take it up a notch with a sit-motion that makes you look as regal and as powerful as you feel! Take a sit on the [b]Goatman Demonic Throne[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kvPZvVB.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’ve Got Awesome Items for You Everyday and All You Have to do is Login!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2PE7y67.jpg[/img]

Heya Adventurers! Get ready to fill your sacks with our daily giveaway coming this week! The best part of this giveaway is you only have to check your attendance after 20 mins of log-in! You heard that right, it’s a fuss-free attendance check event with awesome rewards and who can say no to that?! Not me, that’s fo sho! Plus, we’ve got something cool coming at the Item Mall so stay tuned to find out! 

[h1][b]Attendance Event[/b][/h1]
Don’t forget to announce your awesome presence via attendance check because you wouldn’t want to miss even just a day because of the rewards we have in-store!
[list][*]Log-in to the game for an accumulative time of 20 minutes using the character you want to receive the reward. Simply wait for the exclamation mark to appear on the event icon located on top of your screen, click to open the UI and check the date of your attendance to receive a random reward listed at the rewards list!
[*]We also have extra special rewards to those who manage to log-in for 3, 9, and 15 accumulative days! Hnnnggg! Rewards![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
When evil becomes a fashion statement, you wouldn’t want to be an on-looker because the [b]Evil Tracer 3[/b] Ice Burner set brings something epic to the streets of Elrios! Complete the set!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WY5DB6l.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Let Peace and Prosperity Reign Over the Magical Lands of Elrios in the Harmony Festival!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XpIFwMO.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a fun week ahead of us with revamps and awesome events! First up, we have a Character Balance Revamp to make your battles efficient and fair. You can test out your new skills tomorrow! Our beloved Profession System gets a major revamp with new achievements, new items, and a whole lot of new functions! You just might want to log-in and try it out for yourselves! Then we’re finally launching the new Mentor-Pupil System. Forge lasting friendships with one another while passing down a more experienced player’s knowledge to a new player! How awesome is that?! No more confused and directionless playing (unless that’s your style) again, totes awesome!

And finally, Harmony Festival is back! That’s right, get ready for awesome events, boosts, buffs, costumes, and more! It’s going to be one fantastic festival for sure! And don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for to check out new stuff and things!

[h1][b]Harmony Festival[/b][/h1]
A period of momentary peace has come to Elrios and with it brings lots of goodies and fun! 
[list][*]Start hoarding [b]Harmony Festival Pies[/b] because you can get it for [b]FREE[/b] from Ariel!
[*]Chat up Ariel to unlock special titles and use them during the event!
[*]You also get to use a special skill and get additional Harmony Festival Buffs when you go dungeon running with the Heroes Assemble buff active!
[*]Get [b]Harmony Festival Costume Cubes[/b] when you login for 10 minutes once!  And get even more rewards when you log-in for 10 to 20 minutes daily!
[*]Collect [b]Harmony Festival Coins[/b] to exchange them with Ariel for useful consumables!
[*]There’s also a very special place in Elrios to celebrate the Harmony Festival. Want to find out where it is? You can check it out tomorrow![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Make the ladies and gentlemen swoon when you sit down and play your tunes! Get the [b]Eternal Vows Serenade Sit Motion[/b] in black and white tomorrow!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LdhdJyV.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Couples and Singles Unite in Elrios for an Exciting Event that’s Filled with Love!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vnGiUGN.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! It’s not even the month of love but we’re all ready to spread some for the whole week! Why, you ask? We’ve got an awesome event for the week that’s not only made for the lovey-doveys in Elrios but for singles too. But wait, what if you’re not married but you want to get married?! As in real life, weddings can be quite costly in Elrios too… But fret not! Special Wedding packages and a cute red panda to take you and your significant other away after the ceremony await you at the Item Mall tomorrow! This may be your chance for the most affordable but still grand wedding ceremony in Elrios ever! Don’t miss it!

[h1][b]Elrios Wedding Event[/b][/h1]
And can you feel the love tonight? Of course you can! Partner up with your significant other to enjoy a whole week of marital bliss! 
[list][*]Singles can also join in on the wedding fun! During the event, they too can enjoy the power of love because the skill [b]Extreme Heavenly Love Lv. 2[/b] can be used by everyone!
[*]Using [b]Extreme Heavenly Love[/b] will yield some fantastic [b]Sage’s Magic Stones[/b] too when used a certain number of times.[/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
An adorable red panda is coming to you to wash your loneliness away! Fierce but eye-poppingly cute this new companion will be with you to the ends of Elrios. Get [b]Wah-Kun[/b] at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uXR3Ef6.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Come Face to Face with A Mysterious Man in Elrianode’s Epic Tower!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/AYruQE1.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, the last of our Elrianode adventure will come to an epic end with the El Tower Defense dungeon. A mysterious man awaits your arrival but what is he there for exactly? We haven’t got a clue but we want you, brave hero, to go and find out what lies inside. Get ready for an epic undertaking as the El Search Party’s plot thickens! For those of you who haven’t heard yet, we’re currently having a forum sticker contest at the new forums! If you’re creative and have awesome ideas, you may want to join because the winners will not only get K-Ching but their stickers will be used throughout the forums! Gold and glory, mmmmm. [url=https://forum.elsword.koggames.com/forum/news-and-announcements/contests/25303-sticker-contest-sticker-contest]Check it out here[/url] and start creating! Don’t forget to also take a gander at the awesome new items at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[h1][b]El Tower Defense[/b][/h1]
Barge through the doors of the tower and conquer whatever evil lies inside. Prepare for an immense challenge ahead!
[list][*]For adventurers level 95 and up, you’ll be given [b] [Cobo] Elrianode Defense Request[/b] tickets to enter the dungeon after 10 mins of login time!
[*]For players level 10 and up, they will also have to log-in for 10 mins to get the [b][Cobo] Elrianode El Tower Defense Dungeon Title (7 Days) Cube[/b] which contains the [b][Cobo] El Tower Defender (7 Days) and the [Cobo] Guardian of Elrianode (7 Days)[/b] titles.
[*]Players level 10 and up with 30 minutes of login time will be given a [b][Cobo] Corrupted Elrianode Earring (7 Days).[/b] Test out the mighty boost it gives![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Let Ain teach you how to masterfully dress up for a fancy soiree or for world domination with new Ice Burner sets just for him! Dress up Ain in [b]Masquerade[/b] or [b]Perkisas[/b] tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VY6M4RW.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game~

[EDIT: Wah-Kun will not be coming out this week. We are sorry for the inconvenience]

notes.title: Will You Join Henir’s Fanatics in Their Cause or Will You Purge Them?
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/uguQnEF.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers, we’ve got some purging to do this week! Henir’s Fanatics are on the loose and they’re trying to wreak havoc around Elrios! You can find them lurking about in certain dungeons waiting for some poor unfortunate soul to convert! But it’s totally understandable if you want to join their cause. You have to admit, they’ve got that mysterious cult look down to a T. You can get that same look too starting tomorrow so joining will be easy. Just don’t ask us about their initiation rituals. There’s no denying that their choice of cult clothing is impeccable! Still, if you want to resist the call of the void, we’ve got other items that are just as awesome coming in tomorrow so don’t forget to check those out as well!

[h1][b]Henir Fanatic Event[/b][/h1]
Purge Elrios of fanatics that support Henir and want to wreak havoc in the land!
[list][*]Defeat [b]10 Henir’s Fanatics[/b] every day to get an awesome reward that differs per day! Get tickets, magic stones, potions and more![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Dress up for the ultimate summer getaway by completing your looks with whimsical accessories that will brighten up any location. Get the [b]Summer Getaway Accessory Package[/b] tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iOLY0ac.jpg[/img]

Don’t forget to complement your costume with a pleasant sit motion that’s suited for some chill cruisin’! Hop on the [b]Convertible Sit-Motions (Bluesky & Sunshine)[/b] tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ipDtUBS.jpg[/img]

And if you’re a true follower of Henir, the Lord of Time & Space, you’d want to put on this cool cult costume to get on his good side. Get the [b]Fanatic Outfit[/b] costume suit tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/mH1sJ8P.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: What Lies Await Inside the Ancient Debrian Laboratory? Let Your Heroes Find Out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TDMNsWz.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Another ancient Elrianode vicinity has been discovered! This time it’s the incredible Debrian Laboratory! If you remember, the Debrians would later on excel in the theory and application of El Energy. Adrian Nasod, who created the Nasods (Eve being Queen) is a Debrian himself! So, what manner of creatures and discovery await our heroes inside this ancient laboratory? What history will the El Search Party uncover? Find out tomorrow, dun-dun-DUN! 

PVP-ers, get ready for another round of intense PVP action with the 3rd season of PVP League! Watch out for and test out your heroes’ revamped skills and climb on top of the leaderboards once more! We’ve got another wonderful burning event for you this summer with boosts and buffs galore but for dungeon runs! And of course, the week wouldn’t be complete without a fun Ice Burner event for a chance to get TONS of awesome Elpheus Ice Burners! Don’t get left behind because this may be your only chance to double and even, dare I say, TRIPLE your Ice Burners so you can finally complete your set! A fun new summer outfit graces our favorite Item Mall too! All these and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]Debrian Laboratory Event[/b][/h1]
Discover more ancient secrets and get rewarded for battling the monsters that lurk within its walls!
[list][*]For level 10 and up, you’ll get [b][Cobo] Elrianode Debrian Laboratory Title (7 Days) Cube[/b] for 10 minutes of login time that contains three titles you can choose from to boost your stats!
[*]And then, 30 minutes login time for characters level 10 and above is needed to get a [b][Cobo] Corrupted Elrianode Mask (7 Days).[/b]
[*]And defeating the Debrian Laboratory Boss a number of times will reward players with [b]Elite Equipment Fragment Cubes.[/b][/list]

[h1][b]Dungeon Burning Event[/b][/h1]
Starting tomorrow [b]Once Per Day for 1 Hour[/b] get [b]2X EXP, 2X DROP RATE,[/b] and [b]UNLIMITED STAMINA[/b] when you log-in!

[h1][b]ITEM MALL GOODIES[/b][/h1]
Go to your dream Elrios destination in style with the new [b]Summer Getaway Costume[/b] for your heroes! Become the hippest vacationer in town! Check it out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sbvUVST.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Enter the New Elrianode City Dungeon and See What Awaits Our Heroes Inside!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RGbglSZ.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a fine week ahead of us starting with an epic new dungeon called Elrianode City. This ancient city dungeon boasts a number of corrupt creatures all waiting for you to battle with them!  What lies inside this ancient city and what more will unfold in our heroes’ stories? Well, you’ll just have to find out tomorrow, won’t you? By the way, how are you liking our new forums so far? Pretty awesome, right? Also, as a general reminder for everyone: the old forums will now serve as an archive. You will not be able to create new threads or continue a thread in the old forums but you can always link back to it for reference. Start posting your questions, games, other stuff in our forums today! As always, we’ve got awesome things at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow so don’t forget to check it out!

[h1][b]Elrianode City Event[/b][/h1]
We’ve got freebies for everyone, and we mean everyone (not just high-level players) during the Elrianode City event! Boost your stats with accessories and titles to get a taste of awesome Elrianode rewards!
[list][*]For characters level 95 and up, you get [b]3 [Cobo] Elrianode Defense Request[/b] for 10 minutes of log-in time so you can go inside the dungeon!
[*]For level 10 and up, you’ll get [b][Cobo] Elrianode City Dungeon Title (7 Days) Cube[/b] for 10 minutes of login time that contains two titles you can choose from to boost your stats!
[*]And then, 30 minutes login time for characters level 10 and above is needed to get a [b][Cobo] Corrupted Elrianode Bracelet (7 Days).[/b][/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Add a bit of water work to your daily attire with this fun and splashy [b]Water Spirit Costume Suit Package[/b] complete with a very subtle accessory that’s extremely relaxing to look at! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/EAKVY29.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Make Your Way to Elrianode and Its Perilous Dungeon Then Talk About It in our New Forums!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yV1roAW.jpg[/img]

Heeeeyyya adventurers! It’s here fo’ reals! The forums we’ve all been waiting for goes live tomorrow! Explore new features and start posting about Elsword or just about anything really. And if you’re worried about your old posts, fret not! You can still refer back to them as we’re keeping the old forums as an archive! And speaking of exploring stuff, we have new wonderful places for you to explore. One is a nice village where the El Masters and the El Priestesses are, and another is a dungeon I know the level 99s will go crazy for!

If board games are your thing, then the 2017 Elrios World Tour is just the thing for you! Get coins that you can exchange for sweet rewards every time you finish the board! Take a trip around the board in 80 minutes, maybe?  And PVP-ers, we have not forgotten you this fine summer. You can show off your PVP skills to gain tons of rewards and AP. Win or lose everybody gets a reward! However, we’d advise you to not go charging into fights unprepared. Luckily, you can enhance your equipment with the most awaited Enhancement Event! And as always, there are new things at the Item Mall that you should totally check out tomorrow!

[h1][b]Elrianode[/b][/h1] 
Experience Elrianode and all the wonders (and danger!) it has to offer! From beautiful landscapes to creatures that will kill on sight, there’s no better place for end-gamers to roam and relax!
[list][*]For everyone that’s level 10 and above, you get a 7-day title cube! Choose if you want a [b]Denif’s Blessing[/b] title or a [b][Cobo] El Tear Fragment Collector![/b]
[*]Beating up the big bad boss a number of times will give you excellent rewards. You’ll get [b][Cobo] Elrianode Equipment [Elite] Random Cube[/b] for beating him 3 times or a [b][Cobo] Red/Blue/Purple Elrianode Equipment Fragment [Unique Top Piece] Cube[/b] for beating him 15 times![/list]

[h1][b]2017 Elrios World Tour Event[/b][/h1]
Play this simple board game inside an RPG and rack in those sweet travel rewards! You’ll definitely keep going back for more!
[list][*]Login for 30 minutes to get [b]1 Elrios Tour Dice[/b] to get your very first roll![/list]

[h1][b]PVP Burning Event[/b][/h1] 
 Punch, kick, slice, hack, and blow up your opponents in this exciting PVP Event. We’ll give you the rewards and all you have to do is fight!
[list][*]Login for 10 minutes to get a [b]+10 Sparring Weapon Cube[/b] that gives your character a very grand weapon to use during PVP!
Plus, you only have to PVP 3x to get receive a [b]PVP Essential Item Cube (15 Days)![/b][/list]

[h1][b]Enhancement Event[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Race to Your Goal Level in More Fun Summer Events in Elrios!

Heya adventurers! It looks like you’re having a lot of fun with our super awesome fantastic summer events. You just can’t get enough of our out of this world bonuses, can ya? We’ve got so much hot stuff going on this summer that boredom just melts right off! 
[list][*][b]200% EXP on the weekdays[/b] for a whole week for level 98 and below! But wait, level 99s can get in on the 200% EXP action too when they party up with their low-level friends!

notes.title: We’re Not Riding the Waves This Summer, We’re Making ‘Em with Epic Events Ahead!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LLolytT.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! The last addition to the Hall of El is finally here! What will be the outcome of the choices we make? Remember not to get too absorbed by the El, if you know what I mean. Find out more and continue the journey! All you avid PVP-ers better prepare because PVP Free Season starts tomorrow! With Ereda Island opening 24/7 until August, you can fight to your heart’s content until you drop! 

Here’s something for the fashionistas of Elsword, Magic Wardrobe is dropping something big, something that’s definitely suited for everyone. What could it be? Stay tuned. And as always, we’ve got awesome summer thangs for y’all at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow!

[h1][b]Skill Slot & Quick Slot Quests[/b][/h1]
Here’s something different! [b]A monthly quest[/b] to give you those much-needed slots has appeared! Increase your efficiency in the battlefield as you dish out skills and use items with ease!
[list][*]To get a [b]30-Day Skill Slot Change Medal[/b], you can use simply use your skills for 100x
[*]A [b]30-Day Extended Quick Slot[/b] will be rewarded to you when you use items in your current extended slot 50x!
[*]From tomorrow until August 8th (11:59 PM PDT), you only have to use skills 10x and items 5x to receive these coveted medals!
[*]But wait, there’s more! As a [i]SPECIAL PRESENT[/i], login for an accumulated time of 10 minutes and you’ll receive a [b][Cobo] Skill Slot Change Medal (Permanent) for FREE![/b] Don’t miss this once in a blue moon reward! (this giveaway is per account only)[/list]

[h1][b]Summer Bingo Event[/b][/h1]
To add a little more fun in your summer days, we’ve got an awesome bingo event for you. But this isn’t like your nana’s light-hearted bingo nights. You gotta complete the bingo tasks to get all of ‘em sweet rewards so don’t miss it!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Don’t drown while swimming in the ocean, trade your heavy armors for something cool and light! [b]Summer Splash Swimwear[/b] sets are available tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/UtgqHgA.jpg[/img]

And now, you can match your swimwear with an awesome customization! [b]Summer Splash Skill Cut-Ins[/b] are your mighty flair for those heavy hits!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/JQ5yWUI.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~’

See y’all in-game!

notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9UVo2Wd.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Happy 4th of July!! Celebrate your freedom with a bang and then return to Elrios to chill only to get excited again because the second part of the Hall of El, the Trials, opens up to heroes tomorrow! More surprises await the many end-game challenge seekers and they better prepare hard because this part won’t be as easy as the first! It’ll give you buffs, boosts, double reward, and double EXP every day for a whole month! You’ll be soloing those perilous but rewarding halls in no time! Also, we’ve got a few extremely adorable items coming out so don’t forget to check out the Item Mall tomorrow!

Dress up in something simple but extremely cute this hot summer! We’ve got [b]Denim Overalls,[/b] cute [b]Blonde Waves,[/b] and a [b]Glimmering Blush[/b] that would summon senpai from 50 miles away! Watch out for it tomorrow!

notes.title: Break into the Hall of El and Face Its Powerful Will
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/OS7P2JP.jpg[/img] 

Heya adventurers! We’ve got a very exciting week for you! The Hall of El opens up its first doors to welcome adventurers and challenge them! Within these halls, you’ll come face to face with your heroes’ darkness and the Will of El in this action-packed level 99 dungeon. Better get ready because this is going to be an exhilarating ride for end-game thrill-seekeers! We’ve also got something to fill your summer days with more fun and excitement! A whole month of boosts and buffs and double rewards are waiting for every single one of our adventurers. How fun is that? And as always, the Item Mall will be filled with new stuff that will be the envy of your peers! Unless they have the same thing as you. Don’t forget to check them all out tomorrow!

[h1][b]Entering the Hall of El: The Beginning[/b][/h1]
Step into the Halls of El and battle against dark heroes that will eventually lead to deciding the fate of El!  But for now, just have fun battling!
[list][*]Clearing the Hall of El once will reward players with an awesome accessory called [b]Will of El (7 Days)![/b]
[*][b]10 Mana Elixirs[/b] will also be given after clearing the dungeon once per day. It’s an incredibly useful reward for your persistence in this perilous journey![/list]

[h1][b]Burning Summer Event[/b][/h1]
Prepare for a fantastic summer coming to you tomorrow! There’s boosts and buffs and more err’day for a whole month!
[list][*]All Day [b]Guild Buffs[/b] and 200% Guild Points every Monday!
[*]Double [b]Time & Space Crystal Rewards[/b] every Tuesday!
[*]Double AP Reward and Victory Medals every Wednesdays! And don’t forget Ereda Island is open for 24 hours on these days!
[*]You only need [b]1 Heroic Dungeon Ticket[/b] to enter Heroic Dungeon on Thursdays!
[*]200% Barrier’s Fragment Drop and All Dungeons will all be opened simultaneously on Fridays!
[*]And thank goddess it’s Saturday because we have 24 Hours of 2X EXP, a [b]Hot Spring Wear Cube,[/b] 10% increase in Physical/Magical Attack and Defenses inside dungeons!
[*][b]FREE[/b] enhancements, repairs, and market registration on Sunday! Plus, craft an [b]El’s Hammer (3 Days)[/b] through Ariel using various items! AND MORE![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
Get three costume sets inside one awesome All-in-One Ice Burner! Inside each one is a chance to get costume pieces from [b]Ignition Caligo, Hamel Navy Officer,[/b] and [b]Thanatos.[/b] Coming tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8uUXneZ.jpg[/img]

Bring the charm of Elysion wherever you go with a sit motion that’ll make you want to relax. Sit back and enjoy the cool breeze in [b]Elysion Tree’s[/b] majestic branches offering relaxation tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hbPRUN5.jpg[/img]

Bring more impact into Rose’s attacks with 4 new skill cut-ins!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/M1h5ITF.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Y8skcYt.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game~

notes.title: The Rift to the Dimension of Sinister Intent Opens Up And Offers A Challenge!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Lfj33VN.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! I have exciting news for you all and it’s something that you’ve all been waiting for since the release of the Magic Wardrobe. You probably have a bit of an idea now but I’ll just go ahead and say it: The Magic Wardrobe’s most awaited function is finally here! You now have the ability to add your Ice Burner sets inside the Magic Wardrobe! It’s totally ok to do some low-key spazzing today and then just go all out tomorrow when it comes out. Plus, we also have a few surprise accessory additions in the Magic Wardrobe so don’t forget to check that out as well! 

Is it me or is there a very sinister feeling in the air? It could be nothing, I could just be paranoid… or it could be something big! It could be our newest one-player dungeon that’s so epic it sends out its massive sinister energy from a dimensional rift! But don’t fret, it IS a dungeon filled with sinister intent but it doesn’t mean you can’t conquer it. Watch out for the Dimension of Sinister Intent tomorrow and try it out for yourself! And as always, don’t forget to check out the Item Mall to have a look at our awesome new stuff!

[h1][b]Dimension of Sinister Intent Event[/b][/h1]

notes.title: ARRRR! Get Ready to Crack Open Some Pirate Treasure and Discover the Wonders Within!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LkTFA7u.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! What’s cookin’? How was your Memorial Day Weekend? We had tons of fun during the Fever event and I even managed to score some of the items on sale (hello empty wallet!) that became available during the long weekend. We’re pretty sure you enjoyed it as much as we did! But don’t worry, the fun doesn’t stop there! We’ve got a new event dungeon coming in tomorrow and let’s just say it’s going to be booty-ful, so don’t forget to watch out for it! And we’ve also got more fun stuff for y’all at the Item Mall! If you want to look cool in the latest fashion, accessories, and customization, you know where to go!

[h1][b]Treasure Hunter Dungeon Event[/b][/h1]
It’s chest opening season in Elrios and in this fun, new dungeon the only way to win (other than to beat enemies up) is to open all the chests you see! Gather points for opening different chests and get ready for awesome rewards!
[list][*]How are you going to open the chests when you can’t get in the dungeon? Turn your frown upside down because we’re giving away [b][Cobo] Magical Treasure Maps[/b] on the weekdays and weekends (you’ll get more on the weekends!) and all you have to do is to login!
[*]Every time you destroy those treasure chests, you can get a [b]Hidden Emergency Food[/b] that recovers 50% of HP & MP or a [b]Mysterious Potion[/b] that recovers 100% HP & MP! Totally awesome![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Show off raw, almost unlimited, power that’s over 9000 with these special [b]Awakening Effects! Watch Dancing Flames[/b] or [b]Retro[/b] effects scare off the living daylights off your foes. Check it out tomorrow!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGcMbpz8CGW6QxLq/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGcicgVZe62w09DG/giphy.gif[/img]

Defend the seas or infiltrate enemy lines by disguising as one of them, Ain’s two new Ice Burners will help pave the way to victory! Get the [b]Hamel Navy Officer[/b] or the [b]Evil Tracer 2[/b] and start collect the pieces tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BFhMgxI.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in-game!


*Edit: We updated the images of Ain’s Hamel Navy and Evil Tracer 2 sets. We apologize for any confusion.

Hey adventurers! We’ve got tons of new stuff coming in for you tomorrow. Better prepare right now so you don’t miss out on all of the fun things and rewards we’ve got lined up for you! notes.title: Dance Your Way to the Top, Fight to Become the Last Team Standing or Spend Your Lazy Days with Cats!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TrsrcTN.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are you liking our anniversary events so far? Pretty epic, huh? A bunch of Ruchis told me that we still have a few players who have not joined yet! Well, if you’re still planning your masterpiece, don’t think too hard because this event and all its sweet, sweet rewards only lasts until next week! We also have a new PVP Mode for everyone to enjoy. It’s going to be super fun and exciting, so watch out for it and get ready to test it out! And as always, don’t forget to wander into in the Item Mall tomorrow to ogle at the new awesome stuff coming in!

[h1][b]PVP Winner’s Match[/b][/h1]
Take down your opponents in this fast-paced PVP mode! You and your random team mate as well as your opponent’s team must battle with each other until one team wins four times first! If this doesn’t get your adrenalin pumping, then nothing will!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Dance your way into people’s hearts with costumes and smooth moves inspired by award-winning Kpop group, B1A4. Show the people of Elrios what a [b]Sweet Girl/Sweet Guy[/b] can do!

If cuteness can kill, then this extremely adorable [b]Cat Sit-Motion[/b] can commit mass murder. Sit in a fluffy cat chair, surrounded by cats and you’re on cat heaven!

The [b]Dark Chaser[/b] is your cool, new futuristic ride! Traverse distant paths and look extremely cool while doing so. Get it tomorrow!

notes.title: Elsword’s 6th Anniversary Steam Exclusive Celebration!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cqkN9Px.jpg[/img]

Irvine, Calif., May 2, 2017 

The Elsword team has made it clear over the years that they go all out for their May 4th Anniversary events, and this year is no exception! Except this time, in addition to all of the amazing in-game events, drops and giveaways, Steam players get a VIP party of their very own! This 2-week, 3-part soiree has all the things: An in-game giveaway, an in-game, Steam-Only Black Friday styled sale and (2) new, limited time DLC package offerings.
Here are the details…    

[h1][b]Event Date:[/b][/h1]
5/02/2017 – 5/16/2017 (2 weeks)

[h1][b]The Giveaway:[/b][/h1]
Every Steam player (yes ~ that means you) that logs into the game for 10 minutes will receive a notification that they’ve received an item. That item is a free Class Change Ticket Cube. This Cube offers players the ability to select (1) of the following class changes: 1st Job, 2nd Job or Transcendence Class.
Up to a $37 value, for free!

[h1][b]The Sale:[/b][/h1]
Steam players that log into Elsword, and access the in-game shop will notice a new tab across the top dubbed the “Steam” Tab. In this Tab, Steam players will have the ability to purchase the hot new Salvatore Rosso Ice Burner packages in 5+2, 10+4, or 20+10 bundles ~ don’t miss out!  

[h1][b]2 New DLC Packs:[/b][/h1]
For $10.99, Steam players will have access to the following DLC Packs 
Adventurer Starter Pack 1 
Containing: 1 Skill Slot Change Medal, 1 Extended Quick Slot, and 1 Magic Necklace (II) 
Adventurer Starter Pack 2 
Containing: 1 Skill Slot Change Medal, 1 Magic Necklace (II), and 1 Ring of Skills (II) Cube

[b]Again, these are Steam Exclusives in addition to the current [url=http://elsword.koggames.com/6th-anniversary/]6th Anniversary events![/url] From new character creation support, loot drops, giveaways and much more![/b]
[list][*]Buffs For All
[*]Physical Attack, Magical Attack +600, 6MP per second (5/02 – 5/16)
[*]200% EXP (5/02 – 5/09  Except 5/04)
[*]300% EXP, 200% Drop Rate, Unlimited Stamina on 5/04

notes.title: Elsword is getting ready to Celebrate its 6th Year Anniversary with Events Galore!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oWrn8ZX.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We are here on a Monday with the GM Blog, meaning that the update this week must be tomorrow! So to help you prepare for this earlier update, we have a list of all the special Anniversary events and goodies going into the game. You read that right, Elsword will be celebrating its 6th Year Anniversary on May 4th! Along with these events, the Magic Wardrobe will be receiving its first update that will allow for even more costume sets to be available for registering. So be sure to keep an eye on our website for more details tomorrow. But for now, let’s dive right in and see what’s in store for you to help us celebrate Elsword’s Anniversary!

[h1][b]Elsword 6th Anniversary[/b][/h1]
Elsword is getting ready to celebrate its 6th year anniversary on May 4th, my how time flies! 
[list][*][b]600 Days Login Event[/b] is finally available! Starting tomorrow, you can log into Elsword and claim your present for being such a loyal player. Those who have 600+ days of game time saved will be able to receive a [b]FREE Royal Servant/Maid Ice Burner Set[/b], while other presents will be available for the grabbing. And for those players who are close to qualifying for a specific package, do not fret! Last day to claim your prize will be on 5/16, so there is time to keep racking up the days!
[*]Starting May 2nd and continuing through May 16th, all players will receive buffs that will grant you [b]PHYSICAL ATTACK +600, MAGICAL ATTACK +600, [/b] and [b]6MP Per Second[/b]!
Need more buffs? Then log in on May 4th to receive [b]300% EXP, 200% Drop Rate[/b], and [b]Unlimited Stamina[/b]!
[*]But what if you can’t login on the 4th to receive those buffs? Don’t worry because all players will receive [b]200% EXP[/b] May 2nd through May 9th! Be sure to log in and take advantage!
[*]Having trouble receiving the drops you need from [b]Henir’s Time & Space, Heroic Dungeons, or even Secret Dungeons[/b]? Well, rewards will be [b]DOUBLED[/b] when completing specific quests. Be sure to check out the website tomorrow for more details!
[*]And to keep the party going well into the night, Ariel will have your endless supply of [b]free 6th Anniversary Party Potions[/b] that will [b]recover 60% HP and MP[/b]. So visit her tomorrow and stock up![/list]

[h1][b]El’lywood[/b][/h1]
As if those previous events weren’t enough, we want to make sure you are looking stylish as you run around Elrios for our Anniversary, so get ready to receive our [b]6th Anniversary El’lywood Costume Cube[/b]! 
[list][*]All players who log in on May 4th will receive a [b]FREE 6th Anniversary El’lywood Costume Cube[/b] which can be used on any character level 10 and up (limit to one cube per account).
[*]If you miss out on this date, you’ll still be able to receive the [b]6th Anniversary El’lywood Costume Cube (15 Days)[/b] item so you can still look fabulous for this extravagant event. You’ll be able to snag yours until May 16th!
[*]Also, ALL PLAYERS who log in during the event will receive a free [b]6th Anniversary El’lywood Red Carpet Custom Sit Cube[/b] as a final gift from us to you! Also if that sit motion isn’t flashy enough for you, talk to Ariel and she’ll be able to help you upgrade your sit motion into the [b]El’lywood Red Carpet – Glitz and Glamor Sit Motion[/b]![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Lights, Camera, ACTION! Ah El’lywoood, where the stars come out to play! And why should your character be any different? [b]6th Anniversary El’lywood Costume Package[/b] come out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/n7kXo0R.jpg[/img]

Lastly, Rose and Ain get to finally join the ranks of rest of the Elgang, in terms of Idol Status that is! [b]Rose and Ain 2015 Idol Packages[/b] will be ready to pick up just in time for our Anniversary Celebration!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/69ZCKST.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Discover the Magic of Wardrobes and Start Your Day with a Nice Brawl in Ereda Island!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RPmSvdR.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! Get ready to stretch those gaming fingers and make sure that you’re very comfortable in your seats because we have tons of stuff coming in this week just for you! Fashionistas, say you want to wear something for the stats but it’s just not quite your style, what do you do? Why not wear that fashionable costume on top of that not-so-stylish but totally OP set? I see you shaking in excitement but hold on to your girdles for now because this update doesn’t come out until tomorrow! PVPers, this one’s for you. We’ve made some awesome improvements in Ereda Island that we want you to check out, so don’t forget to queue up and start a fight tomorrow! Also, if you’re planning to create a new character, tomorrow’s the perfect time to do so. Newly created characters will get awesome rewards when they reach Ruben to start their journey. And as always, there’s plenty of amazing stuff at the Item Mall that you wouldn’t want to pass up tomorrow so don’t forget to take a peek!

[h1][b]Magic Wardrobe[/b][/h1]
The new magic wardrobe is coming out and what it does is it overrides your current attire with one of the many available costumes from the Magic Closet. It definitely won’t transport you to Narnia but it’s a most-awaited solution to stop you from choosing form over function because fighting baddies when you don’t feel cute doesn’t feel right at all!

[h1][b]Ereda Revamp[/b][/h1]
Battle against another team to destroy a giant crystal and your foes’ hopes and dreams in an all-new Ereda island! Want to experience these improvements? Test it out tomorrow!
•	[list][*]Get a [b]Tenacious Warrior’s Accessory Cube (1 Day) [/b] every day during the event so you can trial the awesome accessories you can get from Ereda. From this cube, you will get 8 accessories plus [b]1 Tenacious Warrior’s Chronicle[/b] that’s unique to each character!
•	[*]Get additional [b]15 Champion’s Victory Medal[/b] daily when you play Ereda island 3 times a day!
•	[*]Receive an [b]Incomplete Guardian Flag[/b] when you login for 10 minutes. It’s an accessory but also a crafting material which you can use to make an even better accessory: [b]Ereda’s Guardian Flag! [/b]
•	[*]And get [b]1 Sage’s Scroll[/b] every Saturday and Sunday during the event when you play Ereda Island win or lose![/list]

[h1][b]New Character Support[/b][/h1]
We know you love creating new characters and we’re here to support them with a new event! 
•	Every time you create a new character during this event, they will be given up to 9 [b]Adventurer Equipment Cubes[/b] containing a variety of useful and fun items (you even get a 30-day pet) to help your newly created characters begin their journey into Elrios!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

More cute stuff in the form of cats are coming in tomorrow! The [b]Cat Accessory Package[/b] comes with a feisty tail you can wear and a real live cat that’s super chill to put on top of your head!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/fTQNXhR.jpg[/img]

Finally, Rosso has his own set and can sit at the cool kids’ table with Solace and the other El Masters! Feel the fiery wrath of the El Search Party because [b]Salvatore Rosso[/b] comes out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RmaaZR6.jpg[/img]

Edit: The [b]Dark Chaser[/b] mount we previously mentioned will come out on a later date. We apologize for the inconvenience.

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Get Ready for An Enhanced Gaming Experience Tomorrow with ALL the Revamps Coming In!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VG6CHvR.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! We’ve got something big coming in tomorrow and I’m just going to get right into in it and spoil it for you, if that’s ok (the title already spoiled it anyway). A large revamp patch is coming in and that means there’s a bunch of improvements on the way! From small things like crafting items to things like remodeling the guild base and improving some of the characters’ skills, there’s certainly no shortage of exciting things to look forward to. And for this week, we have a bunch of cute and snuggly items coming in so you can celebrate your Easter adorably – like a bunny or a bear. So, don’t forget to check these out and more tomorrow!

[h1][b]General Revamp[/b][/h1]
The changes in the general revamps encompasses quests, system related, dungeon related, and item related revamps. Here’s a quick preview of what to expect:
[list][*]Players only have to play a set number of Epic Quest depending on the region. They also get more Stamina Potions for each Epic Quest they finish!
[*]Players below level 90 will now need less EXP when leveling up! Cheers to less grinding and more leveling, I say!
[*]The difficulty of Normal Dungeons has been removed and has now defaulted to “Very Hard” mode. Just because it’s less grinding doesn’t mean it has to be easy!
[*]And, crafting has become less confusing just because you can use more items now! Things that take less space in my inventory are winners in my book![/list]

[h1][b]Guild Revamp[/b][/h1]
We’re improving your guild experience with these changes and Myu wants to be more involved with Guild relations! She’s front and center in towns now!
[list][*]We’ve increased the guild capacity so you can invite more people and their whole friends’ list for the strongest guild ever!
[*]Revamped guild skills for a more guild-friendly experience.
[*]Updated Guild Services and Guild Quests
[*]And most importantly, we’ve got a spiffy new one-floor Guild Base which has access to everything you need.[/list]

[h1][b]Item Lock Revamp[/b][/h1]
We’ve also added a new lock system to protect your “prrrrecious” costumes, armors, and weapons from theft or accidental destruction. This is super handy for players who want to make sure that their hard-earned items will never be compromised. Ever.

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]
When things are looking a little grizzly, you can brighten up your day with this adorable [b]I Bear Cuddles[/b] costume suit! Let’s all be bears tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/i1G69JJ.jpg[/img]

If being a bear isn’t enough, you can always get a cute bear maid to be your pet. It’s totally harmless… errr… if enemies keep their distance, that is. The [b]Shy Teddy Maid[/b] can be yours tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KaRNBDY.jpg[/img]

Annnnd! Right in time for Easter, these extra cute accessories have decided to make themselves available to everyone for a limited time. The [b]Fluffy Rabbit Carrot, Fluffy Rabbit Mini-Me,[/b] and the [b]Fluffy Rabbit Cushion[/b] are all available tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3GnWo3R.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in-game!

-----------------------------------------

For more details on tomorrow's patch, check out this Patch Preview video for tomorrow's update. 

https://youtu.be/SoDFvo7u90s

If being a bear isn’t enough, you can always get a cute bear maid to be your pet. It’s totally harmless… errr… if enemies keep their distance, that is. The [b]Shy Teddy Maid[/b] can be yours tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KaRNBDY.jpg[/img]

Annnnd! Right in time for Easter, these extra cute accessories have decided to make themselves available to everyone for a limited time. The [b]Fluffy Rabbit Carrot, Fluffy Rabbit Mini-Me,[/b] and the [b]Fluffy Rabbit Cushion[/b] are all available tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3GnWo3R.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks!

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: We’re Breaking into Spring with Awesome Events and Epic Item Mall Goodies!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SKw5iTT.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How did you like our April Fool’s Event so far? There were so many things happening last weekend that I’m sure you were quite overwhelmed (and, of course, overjoyed) with all that.  Did you have fun dressing up as someone of the opposite gender? Did you manage to catch our awesome sale? Yeah, we’re pretty sure y’all had fun last weekend! And then there’s Add’s long-name dungeon. It’s such a challenge to do but incredibly fun! If you haven’t tried it yet, I urge you (the high-level players) to try it just once and you’ll immediately get hooked, fo sho! Plus, think of that super epic weapon you can get. There’s nothing more OP than that anywhere in the game! And as always, prepare to have your mind (and wallet) blown by our awesome new Item Mall selection for tomorrow!

[h1][b]Spring Break Events 2017[/b][/h1]
Get more out of your spring break by joining our fun events! Get creative and show the community what you can do! 
[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/events/216698175479662/]Spring into Spring Break[/url][/b] – How do you Spring Step? What do?! Teach us, o sage one! Show us your moves and mad editing skeelz. Who knows, you might get chosen as the player who has the most spring in their steps!
[*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/events/1501404419871599/]Spring Break Adventures Event[/url][/b] – Show our Elsword Chibis (and everyone else) what you’re up to this spring break! But you better hurry, it ends very, very soon!
[*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/events/1455716694471294/]Ahoy There, Matey![/url][/b] – Ready to join the Straw Hat Pirates on an adventure? Well, you better look the part! Dress up your character and create their story, complete with abilities that might fit in the anime’s universe! Where do you go to look like a pirate though? Mix and match pieces in your wardrobe or use the Item Mall’s fitting room![/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Rose walks the path of dark alleyways with guns in hand and an aura of mystery. Complete the feeling of a back-alley crime scene with [b]Rose’s Elrios Noir[/b] costume set. Available tomorrow at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KOXmZ7s.jpg[/img]

We know you’re tired of escorting enemies inside the train of pain so here’s a nifty bench where you can rest your weary bums on! Complete your Netherworld look tomorrow with the [b]Netherworld Express Platform![/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PLwfYTV.jpg[/img]

Now everyone in the gang can emulate Apostasia with the [b]Fallen Angel’s Dark Restraint[/b] set. Do you feel the darkness slowly creeping on to you yet? Watch out for it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6yy5Wa1.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~
See y’all in game!

notes.title: Check Out Add’s Mad Creations!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zTondhZ.jpg[/img]

Hiya adventurers! You will love what we have for you this week. April Fool’s Day is just around the corner and we have a very special event and tons of awesome rewards for everyone this week. If you want to know more then, don’t miss it! Next, we have a new solo dungeon for players level 90 to 99. It’s going be a test of your abilities to get materials to craft one of the strongest weapons to date. If you want to be the very best that no one ever was, then threading this dungeon is a start! And lastly, watch out for our special April Fool’s Day thangs coming in at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[h1][b]Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon[/b][/h1]
Take down Add’s weird experiments and get rewards and a chance to get a Legendary weapon by combining materials gathered in the dungeon! 
[list][*]Players level 90 to 99 who finish the dungeon just once will get an [b]Add’s Energy Fusion Theory Dungeon Trophy Cube[/b] that contains very useful items. That’s totes awesome, yo!
[*]And if you want a really awesome ring, all you need to do is log-in for 10 minutes! The [b]Energy Fusion Ring[/b] is upgradeable using materials that can be bought from Ariel. Once upgraded, the ring accumulates different stat boosts until stage 10 which would make for a pretty OP ring, IMO.[/list]

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Well now, this is where we usually show you all the goodies headed your way this week. 

[b]But not today![/b]

Be sure to keep an eye out for the Item Mall Goodie announcement coming your way soon!

That’s all for now, folks! 

See y’all in-game~

notes.title: Get Ready to Reach Unimaginable Heights with the Transcendence Class Change Ticket Event!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/eff0stb.jpg[/img]

Heya adventurers! How are y’all doing? Spring is finally here! To jumpstart the spring mood, let's get you excited about what's happening this week.  First up, we have what many players have been eagerly waiting for. It’s a very straightforward and simple event but one that will benefit a lot of players. Yes, it’s finally happening, the [b]Transcendence Class Change Ticket Event[/b] is set tomorrow! Definitely don’t miss this because who knows when we’ll have another one like this! Next, is just a reminder to let you know that you only have a week left to join Elesis’ March Madness. Join one or all of the events that you think will best showcase your talents and let your creative juices flow (especially heightened by adrenalin to finish in time). And lastly, we have a few new and returning things at the Item Mall. They’re going to be awesome so watch out for it!

[h1][b]Transcendence Class Change Ticket Event[/b][/h1]

The thing you’ve all been waiting for is finally here! Are you ready for the [b]Transcendence Class Change Ticket Event?[/b] It happens tomorrow and all you need to do is just log-in for an accumulated time of 60 minutes. It’s really that simple! And the event lasts for a whole week so there’s no excuse to miss it!

[h1][b]Item Mall Goodies[/b][/h1]

Become the most extraordinary-looking train crew member to ever walk mortal planes when you equip yourself with these ominous accessories. Nothing says, ‘welcome to the last train ride of your life’ like the [b]Netherworld Express Crew Accessories.[/b] Get ‘em tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7Htve3a.jpg[/img]

And coming back to the Item Mall tomorrow we have the [b]Glacial Ice Burner Set[/b] and the [b]Nasod Battle Suit MK2 Set.[/b] These Ice Burner sets are stronger than ever and guaranteed to win your fights faster! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8iu7VDm.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jS2RgQ5.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks!

See y’all in game~
