notes.title: Luciel Unbound: The Demon Duo Unleashes Their True Demonic Forms
notes.notes:
They’re here, they’re here! Luciel Diabla & Demonio is finally here! Well, almost, they’ll be here tomorrow but they’re technically here! There’s no need to put on your cult robes for this Dark Overlord and servant duo, just log-in to the game tomorrow and play to your heart’s content. Meet Lu in her true form before the enemies took her powers and was transformed into a child; and meet the less human Ciel as Lu’s Demonic energy slowly consumes his humanity. Dark stuff, but really good dark stuff. Don’t forget to also check out the Item Mall tomorrow for new and exciting things!

Diabla & Demonio Events
It’s Luciel’s time to shine as the Demon Duo finally gets to unleash their true forms and maybe take back the throne. We know you’re exciting to test out Diabla and Demonio so we’ve arranged events for that very purpose!
•	If you happen to be a Luciel with no job, don’t be sad. Log-in for 5 minutes to get a [Cobo] Luciel’s Growth Cube once. And if you’re Diabla or Demonio, you’ll also get a [Cobo] Diabla Growth Cube and a [Cobo] Demonio Growth Cube for logging in for 5 minutes! Inside you’ll get +10 equipment!
•	10 minutes of log-in time will give you a Manic Demon Spirit Cube which contains, the accessories Awakened Demon’s Instinct (7 Days) and the [Cobo] Thriving Demon Form (7 Days).
•	During the event, you can also level up Luciel faster with Level Up Support! The higher Luciel’s levels are, there higher the EXP boost will be! Also, dungeon all you can coz Luciel has unlimited Stamina, yo!

Diabla & Demonio Sweepstakes
If it’s real, tangible items you want, then it’s real, tangible items you’ll get (for the players in NA at least)! Play Diabla & Demonio from September 7 to September 13 for four hours, just four hours, to be able to qualify for the sweepstakes! Epic items await the winners!

Item Mall Goodies

Here’s a bang for your buck: Four costumes in one Ice Burner for Luciel when you use Luciel’s All-In-One Ice Burners. Get a chance to complete any one or all of the pieces of the featured costumes in the set! Watch out for it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5bQtAgW.jpg[/img]

Open your eyes and everybody who gazes at it will be mesmerized by the deep blue hue. Luciel gets a new customization! Watch out for Deep Blue Eyes tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/DRVcjbY.jpg[/img]

Step right up and be amazed… at how wonderfully adorable the Magician to Illusion costume looks on the El Search Party. Start making magic in this set tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/pWsZep1.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks and don’t forget to join us tomorrow to welcome Diabla & Demonio~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Luciel Gets Ready for a Big Transformation to Heed the Call of the Underworld
notes.notes:
Hello brave adventurers! Have you felt a disturbance in the lands of Elrios lately? It feels like a great power will be unleashed very soon. Whose it is? Our beloved Demon Duo may be preparing for something big. I won’t spoil but you’ll find out soon enough! Tomorrow, we have Ice Burners and other fun thangs at the Item Mall you might want to check out. Try them on for size when they come out! Go, go, go~!

Luciel 3rd Path Events
The Demon Duo still needs ample time to prepare for their great revelation but while they do that, help them get ready by joining the events!
•	Prepare to be an enigma when you log-in for 10 and 20 mins to get both the Demon Eroded Equipment Cube and the Demon Eroded Costume Cube. Wear it, and everyone will be wondering if this is a foreshadowing. Heh. 
•	60 minutes of hanging out and grinding with friends in Elrios will give you a Luciel… I miss you! Cube. Could the name of this cube mean something? We don’t know but you’ll find out when you get it!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

You don’t have to dive into the deep to go on a magical whale ride. You can now get your very own Seta to ride anytime, anywhere! And have it charge towards your enemies to boot! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Q03G1sv.jpg[/img]

Rose will not be left behind when it comes to the latest Elrios fashion. She’s finally got a complete Bunny Girl Set to call her own! Complete with costume, skill cut-in and a pair of wonderful heart eyes! Check it out tomorrow, bruhs!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FOSJR7X.jpg[/img]

Send shivers down your enemies’ spine when they see you wearing the Glacial. They’ll be too frozen in their tracks from fear. Let your coldness rule! Get it from Glacial Ice Burners tomorrow! (Available for Elsword to Add only)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hlDCmoy.jpg[/img]

Show your enemies that the only entities they should fear are themselves – especially when you’re disguised as them with Evil Tracer 2. Let them know that you’re a better version of themselves tomorrow! (Available for Elsword to Add only)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VdI1HmV.jpg[/img]

Become a heavy metal fighter when Elsword and friends suit up in the latest Nasod Battle Suit MK-2 (Light) /MK-B (Dark). Gain the strength and speed of the Nasods tomorrow! (Available for Elsword to Add only)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/29ldyIZ.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now folks~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Enter Another Dimension to Pass the Heavenly Gates of Elysion! Plus, It’s Your Last Chance to Beat Eltrion!
notes.notes:
Hey, hey adventurers! We have two major events going on this week! Can you guess what they are? Well you really won’t have to coz I’m just going to tell you, teehee. Let’s get right into it! Elysion opens to welcome player into its heavenly, majestic gates. And in here you will start a new journey towards that may lead to the El Lady.  What’s that I hear? That, my friends, is the sound of the level cap being raised. Exciting isn’t it? To help you get to 99 faster, why don’t you explore Elysion’s two new dungeons? 

Need more experience to level up? We’re going to have to introduce you to the new and improved Eltrion! It’s Phase 3 now and he’s stronger than ever. He also comes in a new a stunning black color probably to intimidate you more. Lastly, we have two new items at the Item Mall coming in tomorrow that will definitely pique your interest so watch out for it!

Elysion and Level Cap Increase
The Gates to Elysion have opened and with it, new challenges await. You have to get stronger take on new enemies and bring the El Search Party closer to the El Lady.
•	If you’re level 85 and above, every level up will reward you with a [Cobo] Max Level Expansion Celebratory Cube (7 Days). How awesome is that? Super awesome!
•	Visiting Elysion and clearing its new dungeons (Celestial Crossroads and Adrian’s Palace) guarantees equipment and accessories. 
•	Want a new set of jammies? Log-in daily on the weekdays and on the weekends to get a [Cobo] Dreamy Cube that contains 1 to 5 Fantasy Dusts depending on your luck. You can exchange these with Ariel to get a cozy pajama set.

Eltrion Phase
You’ve snuck in Eltrion’s chambers and tried to subdue the mighty giant while he recuperates but you failed. Now it’s your last chance to beat this steel behemoth, can you do it?
•	Getting new Eltrion accessories is easy-peasy: just log-in for 30 mins and then check your mail, yo! You’ll get a Deviated Sky Guardian’s Accessory that contains Eltrion accessories like a mask, a pair of wings, and a tail. 
•	If you log-in daily for 30 minutes, you’ll get a Luriel’s Amnesia Ticket to conquer that raid one more time!
•	When you clear the raid twice you’ll get an Eltrion MK2 Nasod Treasure Chest and an Eltrion Gateways Trophy from Ariel. 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

No one comes close to the Phantom of the Opera’s swag when wearing masks and acting all mysterious – that is, until now.  Beat that phantom fashion back into the sewers with your Masquerade set. Flaunt your masks and your wings! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vVXc256.jpg[/img]

Japan’s costume design winners finally get to showcase their proud work! Just check out all these unique designs for each characters! Watch out for these amazing designs tomorrow at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VGeU7Wd.jpg[/img]

Well, that’s it for now, folks.

See y’all in game!

•	When you clear the raid twice you’ll get an Eltrion MK2 Nasod Treasure Chest and an Eltrion Gateways Trophy from Ariel. 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

No one comes close to the Phantom of the Opera’s swag when wearing masks and acting all mysterious – that is, until now.  Beat that phantom fashion back into the sewers with your Masquerade set. Flaunt your masks and your wings! Get it tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vVXc256.jpg[/img]

Japan’s costume design winners finally get to showcase their proud work! Just check out all these unique designs for each characters! Watch out for these amazing designs tomorrow at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VGeU7Wd.jpg[/img]

Well, that’s it for now, folks.

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Bid the Summer Farewell by Hoarding All the Swimsuits and Getting to Know the NPCs
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! School is almost here for some of our players and for some of you it may have already started. Tell me dear players, is it yay or nay? Nevertheless, no matter what your feelings about school may be, Elsword and the gang is here to make it all better. There are no failing grades in this world *winkwink*.  But remember, only when you work hard, can you play hard. That said, we got your back when it comes to playing hard. We’ve got tons of new content, new events and a never ending barrage of items from our favorite shopping place – the Item Mall. So don’t forget to check those out tomorrow!

Summer Harmony Festival
The Summer Harmony Festival continues with more fun in the sun activities! This is one last summer festivity before the summer ends so enjoy it!
•	You will receive a 2nd Summer Harmony Festival Celebratory Swimsuit Exchange Ticket so you can exchange these to Ariel and get some very cute swimsuits.
•	You can get all the permanent swimsuits you want when you collect Summer Harmony Festival Beach Wear Cloths! You can use these to craft your desired swimwear from Ariel’s list! So you can hoard all the cloth to make ALL the swimsuits you can dream of!

Side-Story Quests
Is a new game feature designed to get to know the people of Elrios better. Learn more about the new photographer NPC Adams through special quests designed to open up his story or you can also discover more about an existing NPC! Check your quest UIs and game menu tomorrow!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Who says sitting on teacups are for children 10 and below? Now your character can relish the joy of sitting on a stationary teacup without judgment. Get the all-new Teacup Splash sit motion tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RSa9b8w.jpg[/img]

From the harsh training of military school in Empyrean, Rose now becomes a student at Elrios. There’s no doubt it’ll be a breeze for the Empyrean Gunner especially when wearing their comfortable Summer Star Academy uniform. Put Rose in a learning mood when you get her uniform tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3ixKBRU.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now adventurers~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Enter the (Secret) Dungeon and Fight Your Way Out!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! How are you all on this fine day? Are you hydrated? Like really hydrated? If you aren’t make sure you bring at least 3 gallons of water with you ‘cause tomorrow’s update is hot and it’s going to be super lit! You know why? Lanox’s Secret Dungeon – Grand Cavern: The Source of Demonic Energy opens tomorrow! Invite your friends and take on this new dungeon to see how well you fair. You’ll also notice a few minor changes in Dungeon UI so be sure to read up on that too! Remember to check out the Item Mall for new items that’ll make you want to dance for joy! Or join a Kpop group. Just saying.

Lanox Secret Dungeon Events
You know what’s cool? Definitely not Lanox ‘cause that place is smokin’. Literally! Ba-dum-tss. Terrible joking aside, if you love a good challenge then you’ll definitely like Grand Cavern. 
•	Log-in to the game for 5 minutes and you’ll receive [Cobo] Lanox Secret Dungeon Equipment Cube (1 Day) and a [Cobo] Enhanced Lanox Secret Dungeon Equipment Cube (1 Day). Boom New Equipment!
•	You’ll also get a [Cobo] Lanox Secret Dungeon Entry Device. An item that forcibly opens Lanox Secret Dungeon any day it’s not open. What better way to gain advantage over your enemies than the element of surprise? Come barging in, they won’t know what hit ‘em.
•	Receive a [Cobo] Secret Dual Magic Stone Random Cube for the simple task of clearing Lanox Secret Dungeon once!
ITEM MALL GOODIES
Like a true child of the earth, Rose has been blessed and clothed by Gaia to destroy Elrios’ baddies. Suit her up in the powerful Salvatore Gaia found in Rose Ice Burners. Out tomorrow!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4Nsy4oy.jpg[/img]
Another fitting suit for Rose is the Police Uniform set. She’s ready to lock up the bad guys and throw away the keys. Get this righteous costume tomorrow!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/XcQAeri.jpg[/img]
Ara, Elesis, and Add are watching over the seas of Elrios. Dressed up in their Sailor outfits, our three heroes are ready to take down any marine menace that comes their way.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/cz5RV9M.jpg[/img]
Time to bop up and down and spin all around in a costume inspired by award-winning Kpop sensation, GFRIEND. Get GFRIEND Dresses for the girls and GFRIEND Sailor Uniforms for the guys! 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DpWEfEA.jpg[/img]
That’s all for now folks~
See y’all in-game~

notes.title: Enjoy a Harmony Festival in the Summer While You Learn Photography and Start a Brawl!
notes.notes:
Hey, hey adventurers~! How’re y’all doing? Enjoying Rose and all of her paths? We’re sure you’re having the time of your lives. Guess what! Even though we’ve rolled out Rose’s paths, we still have a bunch of events and activities coming your way! Elrios will never run out of things to do, yo! We’ve got the Summer Harmony Festival for everyone, a new game feature for you to try out, a new pvp mode, and many more including new Item Mall thangs! So don’t forget to log-in tomorrow to find out what I’m talking about!

Summer Harmony Festival
Elrios celebrates the summer with swimsuits and ice creams! Our heroes are out in the sun and having so much fun! 
•	Summer means swimsuits and in Elrios we’re giving away 1 Day swimsuits to our heroes! Just log-in for 10 mins to receive a Summer Harmony Festival Celebratory Swimsuit Exchange Ticket to get one of two swimsuit types for each characters from Ariel.
•	Get your free Summer Harmony Festival Ice Cream! And when we say free we mean it’s 0 ED. It’s time to hoard that ice-cold goodness!
•	Every day during the festival, players will receive a Harmony Festival Buff that increases attacks, give +10% exp, and give discounts for repairs. How wonderful!
•	During this time, rewards in Shelters, Henir’s Time and Space, Gate of Darkness and their relevant quests are doubled! So why dawdle when you can earn double?

New PVP Mode: Brawl
Challenge yourself in this new PVP mode where the objective is to use items provided in the map to defeat your opponents. It takes mad skills and crazy strategies to win this one! 
•	Win Brawl once to get 2 Luriel’s Extreme Megaphone (7 Days) and a Fight! Title.
•	Win the Brawl 3 times to get even better rewards like Luriel’s Secret Potion, Elixir Random Cube to get a random boost potion or elixir and a [Cobo] Champion’s Coin which you can use to exchange with for usable items or accessories.

Elrios Studio
Admire the scenery, admire your characters, pose and take a shot! Release your creativity with the new Elrios Studio feature. Unlock new maps when you complete quests. Try it out tomorrow!  

Phoru Card Event
The Phoru Card Event is back! Pick a Phoru Card from the mini-game at the Item Mall to exchange for fantastic rewards. But don’t get discouraged if you happen to pick a Banthus Card, they’re still very useful when you exchange them with Ariel! Checkout this simple Item Mall mini-game that’s returning tomorrow! 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Rose is sight to behold! Dressed in her Wedding attire, she walks down the aisle sweetly but with a touch of danger. Don’t wait for her to be a runaway bride, grab hold of this hot item tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6R5OGYj.jpg[/img]

Rose takes her obsession with Nasod technology to another level. Summoning them isn’t enough, now she wants to wear them. Give Rose what she wants, complete the Nasod Battle Suit set from Rose Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/a748j4g.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, you lovely adventurers!

I’ll be seeing y’all in game~

notes.title: Rose Last Path Rolls Out! Plus, Checkout the Mystery Item Mall Item!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! Brace yourself, many wonderful things are here! Metal Heart and Optimus included! At last, Rose’s last path arrives! Get ready to go all-out with guns blazing and robots marching to guarantee the destruction of those who oppose you! Muahaha! 

Also, just so you guys know, the Heroic Dungeon Mode is here to stay. So for those players who are trying to be hardcore, just remember, you’re not hardcore, unless you live hardcore! And what’s more hardcore than this new dungeon mode? Nothing. That’s what. Unless you have a metal heart.

As always, there’s new stuff at the Item Mall that we know you’ll definitely love so don’t forget to check it out. If you don’t come to the Item Mall, the Item Mall will come to you.

Metal Heart & Optimus Events
Machines will rise and take over with Rose in charge! Defeat your enemies as you become the robot summoner, genius mechanic. Join the events to get more rewards!
•	Get Luriel’s Ice Burners once on a weekday and once on a weekend for two weeks! 
•	You’ll get a Metal Heart: Destiny Cube and a First Job Change Promotion Cube if you’re a Rose character that’s level 14 and jobless! Inside these cubes are very helpful items to get you started as a Metal Heart!
•	Prepare for Weekend Fevers throughout the event duration! You’ll get the 300% 3 hour boost the moment you log-in so there’s really no time to dilly-dally! 

Heroic Dungeon Event
Dun-dun-DUN! Here’s a challenge coming your way. Are you prepared to take this dungeon mode on? 
•	If you’re level 80 and up, you’ll get Heroic Invitations daily on the weekday and double on the weekend so you can keep “visiting” the dungeon mode.
•	Successfully finish the Heroic Dungeon to get rewards like the [Cobo] Heroic Dungeon Support Cube and the [Cobo] Hero – Savior’s Equipment Cube.


ITEM MALL GOODIES

Elsword and the gang are serving tea to the baddies. No sugar. But more than two lumps. Dress them up in Classic Maid and Servant attire with matching accessories!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5L1Mgow.jpg[/img]

More beach wear for Rose! Give her a stunning summer look that’s sure to stun enemies and take their breath away! Watch out for Rose ELS Beach Wear!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/A8USUnr.jpg[/img]

Controlling the elements to gain power is no easy feat, but with the help of Miracle Alchemist, Rose becomes energized and can beat enemies easily! Start collecting the pieces of the set!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7wEDGrT.jpg[/img]

And that’s all fo—wait a minute! What is this? What on earth could this be? A Bunny? Well, cat lovers this is definitely not for you, that’s fo’ sho’. Want to know? Check this mystery item out the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RTzn5gH.jpg[/img]

Again, that’s all for now folks! Be sure to check out items and join the events.

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Rose’s Last Path is on its Way! Plus, New Stuff at the Item Mall before the Summer Ends!
notes.notes:
Hiya adventurers! The end is near! For Rose’s job paths at least. We’re rolling out her last job path next week and it’s going to be extremely exciting! We’re gonna keep our traps shut for now but the last job path has something to do with machines. That’s it, that’s all the hint we’re gonna give out for now. You just have to patiently wait for next week to arrive! And just so we can keep your mind off this update, we’ll distract you with new stuff from the Item Mall. So go check out some new Item Mall goodies. Go, go on! 

NPC Vacation Event
Hey, our NPCS need a little R&R too especially in the summer! During this event, the NPCs will be giving away fun rewards for helping them out while they’re on vacation~!
•	Just log-in and hang out wherever you please for 10 minutes or more to get an NPC Costume Cube and an NPC Skill Cut-in Random Cube! What could be inside? Well, you’ll have to wait to find out!
•	Check out the Bulletin Board and get an NPC quest! Receive a Gift Pack after you’ve completed the quest!

Item Mall Goodies

Rose is an angel in the devil’s clothes. Literally! She may not have gone completely dark side but she wears the Archdevil’s threads for power. Complete your Archdevil set from Rose Ice Burners!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ltuFpHb.jpg[/img]

Now that you’ve got a complete beach party set with Sailor and Marine Beach Wear and Beach Chair, the time is right to start a beach party in the middle of the town square! Head on to the Item Mall tomorrow to get your own beach set!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/EEyHSuz.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/coZNOD1.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, brave adventurers!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Heaven Opens the Path to Divine Destruction with Valkyrie & Freyja!
notes.notes:
Hiya adventurer! We know you know what’s up so we’re just gonna say it straight: Rose’s Valkyrie & Freyja paths come out tomorrow! Yes, we have a feeling that you’re all excited to try it out but what’s a few more hours of agonizing wait, right? We’re also starting phase 2 of Eltrion’s raid where you sneak into his chamber and you try to destroy him. Keyword: try. But you still get all the sweet loot! How did you get into the chamber? Magic! Probably. 

Remember to check out what we have in store at the Item Mall for you lovely folks! It never runs out of things, it’s just a bottomless pit of goodies!

Valkyrie & Freyja Events
*cue Ride of the Valkyries* Judgement day is upon the wicked creatures of Elrios. Take heed or this Goddess of War incarnate will smite you! But if you’re not evil, then you can relax and join the wonderful events we have for you!
•	Free Ice Burners! When you log-in once on a weekday and once on a weekend receive 1 and 2 Luriel’s Ice Burners respectively.
•	If you’re a jobless Rose level 14 and below and roaming Elder Village then you will automatically receive Valkyrie: Destiny Cube (7 Days) and a First Job Change Promotion Cube to help you get started!
•	Enjoy 3x EXP when you log-in on the weekends! The boost will last for three hours every day after log-in from Friday to Sunday so plan ahead!

Eltrion Phase 2 Events
Sneak into the Sky Guardian’s chambers and deal as much damage as you can before he regenerates but don’t forget to charge and recharge during the phase 2 event for more rewards! 
•	Fill up the Energy Supply gauge (found by clicking the button located above the menu buttons) Level 1, 2, and 3 by using Energy Supply Machine to receive awesome cubes containing useful items.
•	You can also exchange Energy Machine Supplies to Ariel for 5 Luriel’s Complete Recovery Potions.

ITEM MALL GOODIES

You’ve got the looks, but have you got the skill (cut-ins)? Complete your characters’ maid and butler looks with a matching skill cut-in for a more whimsical feel! Check out Classic Maid & Butler Skill Cut-In tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7Z2B2Dq.jpg[/img]

Rose may not be comfortable wearing a frivolous get-up like the Royal Blood but it’s good to indulge the Empyrean Gunner once in a while. Watch out for this regal set from Rose Ice Burners.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/WN5zGHv.jpg[/img]

Rose is still battle ready even when she’s about to sleep! Let Rose slumber in comfort in her new Lovely Night Pajama set! Get it from the Item Mall tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Xr1Ttys.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now brave adventurers!

See y’all in game!

Yes, we have a feeling that you’re all excited to try it out but what’s a few more hours of agonizing wait, right? We’re also starting phase 2 of Eltrion’s raid where you sneak into his chamber and you try to destroy him. Keyword: try. But you still get all the sweet loot! How did you get into the chamber? Magic! Probably. 

Remember to check out what we have in store at the Item Mall for you lovely folks! It never runs out of things, it’s just a bottomless pit of goodies!

Valkyrie & Freyja Events
*cue Ride of the Valkyries* Judgement day is upon the wicked creatures of Elrios. Take heed or this Goddess of War incarnate will smite you! But if you’re not evil, then you can relax and join the wonderful events we have for you!
•	Free Ice Burners! When you log-in once on a weekday and once on a weekend receive 1 and 2 Luriel’s Ice Burners respectively.
•	If you’re a jobless Rose level 14 and below and roaming Elder Village then you will automatically receive Valkyrie: Destiny Cube (7 Days) and a First Job Change Promotion Cube to help you get started!
•	Enjoy 3x EXP when you log-in on the weekends! The boost will last for three hours every day after log-in from Friday to Sunday so plan ahead!

Eltrion Phase 2 Events
Sneak into the Sky Guardian’s chambers and deal as much damage as you can before he regenerates but don’t forget to charge and recharge during the phase 2 event for more rewards! 
•	Fill up the Energy Supply gauge (found by clicking the button located above the menu buttons) Level 1, 2, and 3 by using Energy Supply Machine to receive awesome cubes containing useful items.
•	You can also exchange Energy Machine Supplies to Ariel for 5 Luriel’s Complete Recovery Potions.

ITEM MALL GOODIES

You’ve got the looks, but have you got the skill (cut-ins)? Complete your characters’ maid and butler looks with a matching skill cut-in for a more whimsical feel! Check out Classic Maid & Butler Skill Cut-In tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7Z2B2Dq.jpg[/img]

Rose may not be comfortable wearing a frivolous get-up like the Royal Blood but it’s good to indulge the Empyrean Gunner once in a while. Watch out for this regal set from Rose Ice Burners.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/WN5zGHv.jpg[/img]

Rose is still battle ready even when she’s about to sleep! Let Rose slumber in comfort in her new Lovely Night Pajama set! Get it from the Item Mall tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Xr1Ttys.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now brave adventurers!

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Empyrean’s Goddess of War Is Coming Soon to Elrios! Plus, Check Out More Costumes for the El Search Party!
notes.notes:
Hiya adventurers! Happy Belated 4th of July! How did you guys spend your Independence day? Did you spend some of it with Elsword and the gang? We know you had a blast! It was so nice seeing everyone at the Anime Expo! It was such a memorable day for everyone and we hope you had a great time interacting with us and the El Search Party. Even if some of you guys weren’t able to join (because of reasons, I presume), we hope you enjoyed our Social Media activities. 

Rose’s third path is almost here. She’s preparing to smite the evil out of Elrios and ultimately the Empyrean lands for everlasting peace! Watch out for it! As always, there’s so much to look forward to this week in Elsword. Don’t forget to check out the Item Mall for the latest fashion pieces!

Come Get Your School Supplies!
The pen(cil) is mightier than the sword! And in Elrios the pencil is the sword, the staff, the gun, the bow, etc. Find out how you can get this cool weapon costume when you log-in to play!
•	Log-in for 10 minutes to get [Cobo] Honor Student’s Pencil Costume Cube. Open the cube to get [Cobo] Honor Student’s Pencil Weapon.
•	Clear dungeons within your level range two times and get Trace of Hard Studying which can be exchanged for a stronger, better [Cobo] Lucky Honor Student’s Pencil Weapon or 5 Mana Elixirs.

El Mission!
If you’re finding it harder to level up and you don’t feel like doing the grind, the El Mission is an easy way to level up!
•	Complete 5 missions in each stage to level-up and receive awesome Mission Clear Boxes! 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Rose is ready to clean the streets of Elrios with the Royal Maid outfit. She’ll get rid of the baddies and clean up their mess! Collect the pieces from Rose Ice Burner tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5TVxbmg.jpg[/img]

The mighty falcon grants the Demon Duo powers to soar high! Watch as the majestic pair claw their way to victory! Get the Gold Falcon pieces from Luciel Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZbhcGNG.jpg[/img]

Ara, Elesis, and Add are out and about in the summer as they get another beach look. It may be a 2010 design but classic looks are timeless! Watch out for the 2010 Summer Beach outfits tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sqmSpv3.jpg[/img]

Step back in time when school uniforms are simple and, well, uniform. The minimalist design conforms to strict Elrios school rules for maximum studying advantage! Get the Retro Uniform Costume Suit package tomorrow at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rKEM4Zj.jpg[/img]

That’s what we have in store for this week. Don’t forget to log-in tomorrow, adventurers~

See y’all in game!

notes.title: Bloodia and Crimson Rose are Out for Blood. Plus, Check us out at Anime Expo this Weekend!
notes.notes:
Hey, hey adventurers! Are you psyched for Rose to head down a bloody path? We’re not sadists but we’re very excited to see Rose turn into a cold-hearted (not really) assassin. Her specialty is making her enemies bleed with her chain gun blade and that’s just one exciting thing to watch out for tomorrow! We’re pretty excited for a lot of things this week and we want you to be too! So we’re bringing in a bunch of items from the Item Mall so you could check it out and feel as excited as we are!

Anime Expo
Get ready to play your manga this July 1st to July 4th at the Los Angeles Convention Center! Anyone gearing up to go to this week's Anime Expo is welcome to join us at our lovely booth. Visit and interact with us and our awesome El Search Party cosplayers. Don't be shy, just say hi!

You’ll also get an exclusive Anime Expo title for your characters when you sign-up/check-in during AX! Awesome!

Canada Day & 4th of July
Happy Independence Day USA and Happy Canada Day, Canada! Elrios joins you in your celebration with a simple but awesome event! 
•	Get an Ariel’s Firecracker Cube from Ariel when you clear dungeon within your level range.
•	Use your Firecrackers found inside Ariel’s Firecracker Cube 10 times to complete Ariel’s quest and you’ll get a permanent Firecracker Accessory as a reward!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

It’s a timey-wimey, wibbly-wobbly set provided by Elrios’ very own Time and Space Lord, Henir. Get the Henir – Lord of Time and Space Ice Burner from standard Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qclgcd2.jpg[/img]

Rose is made even stronger by the sun’s power and obliterating everything in her path would be a walk in the park! Collect the pieces of her Salvatore Solace set tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IM5uMB8.jpg[/img]

Ara the Exorcist, Elesis the Demon Hunter, and Add the Priest. Whodathunk? Well, they might just be roleplaying but they certainly hit harder than before! Check out their Fantasy Costumes when they come out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5V8BkF2.jpg[/img]

If you’ve always wished for a pet that never grows old, then we have something you’ll love! The Guardian Wolf Jr. will be a puppy for eternity but never underestimate what this little guy can do! And then we have the Guardian Wolf, perfect for people who don’t mind having a big strong wolf following them around. Check out these epic pets tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/L6QN51W.jpg[/img]

And, we’ve got more stuff for Rose! Our Empyrean Gunner transforms into an alluring but very deadly looking Cheshire Cat with her Rose in Wonderland Costume. She also gets her very first skill cut-in for more exciting fight scenes!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/s42hzjI.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Dpcla1m.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks~

See y’all in game and don’t forget to join us in AX!

notes.title: Rose’s New Path Will Get Bloody + Loads of Costumes and Customizations at the Item Mall!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! How’s it going? How are you liking the Heavy Barrel and Storm Trooper so far? Are you enjoying Rose in all her explosive, nuking glory? We know we are! We’re sure you already know what path is coming next for our Empyrean Gunner, but for now, keep enjoying the Heavy Barrel and Storm Trooper because soon Rose will traverse a bloody path. It’s almost here!

Hear ye, hear ye! Calling all the skilled level 80 heroes of Elrios! If you’ve felt dungeon running has gotten a bit monotonous (especially for the max level peeps), then we’re upping the ante by giving you guys a new dungeon mode for an extra challenging run. Check out the game tomorrow to find out if you’re skilled enough to tackle it.

Artists! You only have until today to finalize your designs because the Dream of Halloween Design Contest ends tomorrow. Remember that entries submitted after the deadline will not be accepted. Goodluck~! 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Control your sodium, friend! No need to be as salty as the sea when you lose your battles. Luciel’s Salvatore Denif will give the Demon Duo the power to face their enemies! Collect the set from Luciel Ice Burners!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0gRjWfa.jpg[/img]

What doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, right? Rose totally agrees. Clothe Rose in death’s armor, Thanatos, for an even more menacing Empyrean Gunner. Complete the set from Rose Ice Burners!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/VlvtoNi.jpg[/img]

If you’re ready for a broody night out, then this costume set is totally for you! The Gloomy Night Costume Package & Accessories Package is perfect for silent walks in the cemetery and picnics in a mausoleum! Watch out for this gloomy costume at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lJuGPzr.jpg[/img]

Walk, walk, fashion, baby.  Elsword and friends lead a double life as heroes in the morning and super models at night. Slay the competition with winning moves from the new Model Pose Motion! Available tomorrow at the Item Mall.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/phkitRX.jpg[/img]

Watch out for these wonderful items and more tomorrow!

That’s all for now, folks! See y’all in game!

notes.title: Start Blowing Up Enemies with Rose's First Class Path: Heavy Barrel & Storm Trooper!
notes.notes:
Hiya, adventurers! If we had to make a guess, we think you already know what’s coming out tomorrow, right? Right? Right?! Well that’s just half of what we have in store for you guys and gals tomorrow! So what else could be happening tomorrow? Lots! But first, here’s a little reminder about the Dream of Halloween Design Contest; it ends next week. Yep, next week. How time flies when you’re trying to be creative. But keep calm, you still have a week to drain your brain of its creative juices and blow our minds with your designs.  

As mentioned, many things will happen tomorrow so don’t forget to log-in to join the events. And there’s always new stuff at the Item Mall so don’t forget check ‘em out tomorrow!

Rose 1st Class Path Event
Get ready to burn and blow-up stuff like never before! If you like your characters like how Michael Bay likes his movies, then you’ll love Rose! Explosions, fire, and heavy machinery all around (lens flare not included)! 
•	When you’ve successfully transformed into Heavy Barrel or Storm Trooper, leveling up will give you an extra 50% exp so you could level up again! Neat!
•	Get a Luriel’s Ice Burner Cube once on the weekday and once on the weekend for two weeks for a total of 4 Luriel’s Ice Burners for the duration of the event. Rose will get a Luriel’s El Search Party Officer Ice Burner while the rest will get a standard Luriel’s Ice Burner.

Enhancement Event!
If you ever felt like it takes you much longer to defeat enemies or they’re beginning to hit harder (muh HP!), you might want to look into enhancing your equipment.
•	Log-in to the game for 10 minutes and get 2 Heavenly Blessed Weapons, 2 Heavenly Fluorite Ores, and a Heavenly Restoration Scroll to get you started!
•	There will be a Secret Dungeon Equipment Exchange happening tomorrow so prepare your Secret Dungeon stuff to be upgraded!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Rose looking so dignified and official with the El Search Party Officer Set, yo. Collect this set through Rose Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/1qFKxS3.jpg[/img]

Rose is ready to join the gang for a Summer getaway! Dress her up in her Checkered Summer Look Costume and start having fun in the sun! Get the package tomorrow at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qGihbC9.jpg[/img]

Eyes eyes, baby! Rose gets a pair of Red Eyes for that menacing demeanor, and a pair of Chic Eyes for that dead pan look. The Demon Duo also gets a pair of Red Eyes that spells destruction to anyone who gets in their way! Check these customizations out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jw7b18Z.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/b88x5fX.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now!  Remember to check in tomorrow for rewards and new events!

See y’all in game, folks!

notes.title: A Storm is Coming so We Got You More Stuff for Rose!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! How are you liking Rose so far? Are you enjoying her rapid moves and smooth gun-slinging feats? High five if you shouted a resounding yes to both! We are loving Rose and her Empyrean epicness as well. But of course it doesn’t stop there; prepare to have your minds blown (and everything in your general area too) because Rose is about to get more epic in the coming weeks. We guarantee that she'll start raising hell in peaceful Elrios – not that a little hell raising isn't already happening. A more powerful Rose is coming soon, but for now, enjoy the Empyrean Gunner as she is! We also have a lot of costumes for Rose and for other characters coming in tomorrow, so don’t forget to check the Item Mall out!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

The temperature in Elrios is rising rapidly as Rose takes on a devilish form with the hot Ignition Caligo set. Collect the pieces from Rose Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XDeQCnp.jpg[/img]

Dress Rose up as an Elite soldier with the Military Costume set. The only attire fitting for a heavy-hitting elite soldier such as herself. Watch for it tomorrow at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/pm8TwPn.jpg[/img]

Our three heroes, Ara, Elesis, and Add are beating the summer heat into submission by wearing comfortable clothing like the Summer Casual outfit. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nChIms8.jpg[/img]

As if the costumes were specifically made for them, the Demon Duo easily embrace the call of the dark with Dark Shadow and Pale Shadow costumes. Collect the set from Luciel Ice Burners.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/s3RrPMc.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now brave adventures. Continue leveling up and mastering Rose!

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Take Aim With Rose! Elsword’s Beautifully Lethal New Heroine
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/jL0bDDW.jpg[/img]

Today is the day we launch Elsword’s newest character, Rose.  An elite marksman, and soldier of the highest honor, Rose locks iron sights on those who’ve attempted to assassinate the Princess of the Empyrean City. 

Empyrean law mandates that each female child take a test before her fifth birthday. Those who demonstrate exceptional talent are then entered into extensive, brutal training regimen of the highest order, preparing only a select few to join an elite division of the Guard called the Imperial Garden. Those who pass will adopt the name of a flower that abides the opulent Royal Garden itself. Except one… the title of “Rose”. Rose is the title reserved for she who serves the Princess directly. To watch over and protect all Empyrean Royalty from its enemies.

The prophecy of the Great Disaster has tarnished what would have otherwise been centuries of peace. Those who divine the harrowed shadows of the coming prophecy know that its breadth transcends time and space. A rift tears reality asunder as a demon reaches from the gaping temporal maw, striking Princess Erze. Upon rending life from the demons very form, or more appropriately… emptying an entire salvo of brass into its cranium, the Royal Family knows that there’s only one option: Send Rose to strike out against those responsible before the prophecy can be fully realized. With her smarmy Combat Navigator Zero in tow, Rose traces the source of the demons to the land of Elrios, and our journey begins.       

Rose is a combat ace of the highest order, and she literally carries an entire loadout of small arms into battle. From muskets, revolvers and semi-auto pistols to plate armor popping hand cannons, Rose covers the breadth of in-your-face close quarters to long range tactical strikes with poise and dignity. Rose brings the all new ECP combat system to Elsword. ECP is a new system that enables Rose to switch between the four weapon types, utilizing a measured casting bar that upon exhausting, triggers her damage boosting Over Strike mode.     

Lock and Load!
Play For Free!
Play Your Manga!

notes.title: Smell the Scent of Roses in the Air! She’s Here and She’s Not Going Anywhere!
notes.notes:
Hiya, adventurers! After much time travelling between dimensions, Rose is so close you can smell her! If you don’t already know, June is the month of roses which is why we thought that it was the perfect month to bring Rose to the game. Don’t let her sweet name fool you, Rose is one tough gunslinger and will blow you to pieces if you cross her! You can change her guns anytime and each one has a different effect on enemies. 

If you want to get a sneak peek into Rose, then the GMs have you covered! Be sure to join the [URL=”https://www.twitch.tv/elsword”]GMs today on the Livestream at 4PM PDT[/URL] for your exclusive Rose Sneak Peek, you won’t want to miss this!

Also, New and Returning Players Rewards have been updated. We will have pets, mounts, and titles for them starting tomorrow so go wake your homies up and tell them to start playing! At the Item Mall, we’re starting to stock up on costumes and accessories for Rose so don’t forget to check those out tomorrow! 

Rose Launch
Play as Rose, the rootin' tootin' gunslinger girl from another dimension with an impressive arsenal. Get Rose-exclusive quests and rewards to get her started!
•	Once Rose reaches level 10 and up she’ll receive a Secret Tome of Growth which, when used, can help you gain one level or more depending on the accumulated experience.
•	Level up until 40 and you’ll get a +10 weapon for Rose for every 10 levels she reaches.
•	Clear a dungeon with Rose two times to receive Traces of Battle which you can use to get an Archangel Full Set (1 Day) or Archangel Ice Burners and Standard Ice Burners.
•	Players who have Rose in their parties for dungeon or are playing as Rose in dungeons will get effects and will occasionally receive help from Empyrean forces.

Ariel’s Bingo
We’re also bringing back Ariel’s Bingo with an extra layer of rewards. Now’s your chance to test your luck—shop at the Item Mall to get points to play. You might even complete the Summer Star Academy costume! 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Rose gets the Item Mall spotlight this week as we release the Oriental Mini Dress tomorrow! She’s ready to go for a walk in the park and then shoot some baddies on the way! Versatility!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MEIr7WI.jpg[/img]

In the dictionary, Empyrean means Heaven. Rose is literally sent from heaven! What’s a better clothing option for someone who’s a warrior of heaven than an Archangel costume you can get from Ice Burners? Nothing, that’s what.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HKoScwl.jpg[/img]

This may not be the Iron Throne, this may not even be a throne at all, but it’s more useful since the Chair of Dekal can actually help you destroy your enemies! Get this useful chair when it comes out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3a9Bhch.jpg[/img]

Well that’s all for now, adventurers. Prepare for a horde of Roses tomorrow!
See y’all in-game~

notes.title: Summer is Around the Corner and so is our Newest Ally!
notes.notes:
Hiya adventurers! Summer is almost here and man, oh man better prepare for that scorching summer heat! Start hording all the sunblock and get drenched in all that SPF goodness! We’ve got lots of stuff for you to do and even more stuff for you to buy at the Item Mall. Resistance is futile at the Item Mall and you know it.

Rose Name Reservations
Y’all know that Rose is just around the corner, but travelling from another dimension is no walk in the park so you’ll need to be a bit more patient. That said, you can already reserve names for your Rose characters when you log-in at 12:00am PDT later tonight (May 25th). So if you don’t want to be a “R0se1234” by the time she rolls out, we suggest thinking of creative names right now!

Costume Design Contest 
This is your chance to design costumes, mounts, pets, and accessories worthy to be worn by the heroes of Elrios! Show off your creative talent and get a chance to have your creation featured on Halloween. Find out more from the website tomorrow when we release more details! 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Holy horn on a unicorn, Batman! Lu and Ciel are unicorns! They may not be the wish granting type but they will beat up your enemies for you. Collect the Holy Unicorn set via Ice Burners at the Item Mall tomorrow and live the majestic unicorn life!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0keiPzx.jpg[/img]

Viva la Industrial Revolution! Elsword and the gang are warriors powered by machine and steam ready to explore Elrios. Dress up in Steampunk Fever found nowhere else but the Item Mall! Coming tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dVMaqmo.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks!

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Spam Your Greatest Rivals with Match Requests, Dominate the Winners Match and Test Out Newly Balanced Skills!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! We have really cool game updates coming out tomorrow and we want you to test them out! First up we revamped a lot of the character skills so you can continue to blow things up or hack and slash your enemies in a more balanced way.   There are also two new PVP modes coming out tomorrow; the Winners Match and the 1 vs 1 Match Request. Now you can invite your arch nemesis on a 1 on 1 combat anytime you want! We also have new costumes and new skill cut-ins at the Item Mall so don’t forget to check those out.

New PVP Mode Event
Join the PVP Mode Event and you’ll get to beat people up and get rewards for doing so! Errr… but just in Elsword, this doesn’t apply irl.
•	Camilla’s in a bit of a gift-giving mood and it will likely last for a while. You better take advantage of her good mood and talk to her so you don’t miss out on a Nasod Scouter tomorrow until the 24th and 3 Luriel’s Tome of Amnesia on the 25th to the 31st of May.
•	You’ll also get a Luriel’s 2nd Job Class Change Ticket when you log-in for at least 60 minutes on May 21. 
•	Win in the new 1 vs 1 Request Match Mode just once and Camilla with reward you with 2 Luriel’s Extreme Megaphone and a Fight (7 Days) Title that boosts your stats! Winning in the Winners Match will give you 1 Luriel’s Secret Potion Elixir Random Cube and 1 Luriel’s Champion’s Accessory Ticket.
•	When you become addicted to Winners Match, there will be prizes for achieving 3, 4, 5, and 6 Consecutive Kills. So go on that much awaited killing spree!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Featuring the tribal collection Wild Tribe, 2014’s 3rd Costume Design Contest Winner. Wear a winning design and feel like a winner!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/qSilHmU.jpg[/img]

Can’t get enough of your favorite character’s Season 2 art? Say no more fam, we’ve got you covered! With the Revamped Characters’ Skill Cut-Ins you’ll be spamming skills everywhere just to see your character’s gorgeous art.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8lX9ccU.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now and, again, don’t forget to try out the new PVP modes tomorrow!

See y’all in game, folks!

notes.title: Get Ready to Take Aim and Fire at Will! Plus, Wedding and Elemental Costumes for Luciel!
notes.notes:
Greetings dear adventurers! Do you like guns? Do you like explosions? Do you like nuking things? Do you wish your life was directed by Michael Bay? If you said yes to the first three questions, don’t worry we got you covered. Unfortunately, we don’t have that kind of power if you answered yes to the last question. But if you do like explosions and big guns, then this new event is right up your alley! 

Also, I don't know if it's just me but do you feel a sort of ominous darkness looming over you? It's probably my imagination but I've prepared a sack of salt and a necklace made of rabbit's foot, just in case. Hopefully these new Ice Burners and costumes from the Item Mall can keep whatever that’s coming at bay.

Take Aim, Elrios!
You can master your sharpshooter skills or you can start nuking things in reckless abandon. Either way, Elsword’s new shooting event is here to make your dungeon run more exciting.
•	Get one accessory that boosts your stats per week for the next three weeks! You can get a Battle Navigator, Shooting Glass, and an Automatic Pistol when you log-in for an hour on the corresponding week.
•	Get a Royal Guard Outfit (7 Days) if you are level 10 and above and if you can manage to hang around town for 10 whole minutes.
•	During the event, there will be a bingo game where players can win prizes for every row and column completed. Players can also get rewards for every box ‘shot.’
•	There’s going to be a weekend fever in the form of Elite Growth Elixirs and Elite Lucky Elixirs.

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Don’t skimp when it comes to your characters’ big day, especially if the characters are Lu & Ciel. Dress them up in sweet but versatile (in case they need to fight) Wedding Formals. Get the costume at the Item Mall when they come out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tFrKDUv.jpg[/img]

Dress the Demon Duo up in a non-threatening elemental get-up that can only be described as having the colors of the wind. Complete the Salvatore Ventus set from Luciel Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BG2NrIz.jpg[/img]

Enjoy tomorrow’s event, folks!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Celebrate Elsword’s 5th Year by Going to an Amusement Park and Riding a Cat
notes.notes:
Hiya adventurers! We still have the anniversary celebration this week and Elsword and friends have been posting about it in their social media. Some are really obvious and some are not so obvious. Do you have any guesses? Well we’ll just keep mum until the anniversary, but don’t worry we have events tomorrow that will most definitely hold your interest until Wednesday. And once again, we have stocked the Item Mall with things we know you’ll hijack an armored van for so check it out, but please don’t actually hijack an armored van.

Wally Land!
If your idea of amusement is being surrounded by hordes of enemies coming from all directions attacking you all at once, then this place is paradise to you! Go on, enter the fun-filled place that is Wally Land. 
•	Players who log in for one minute will get 10 Wally Land Admission Tickets. Stay for 29 more minutes and you get 1 Magical Textile Coatings and 1 Magical Textile Coatings Formula. You’ll need these to make the costumes you get from Ariel’s quest permanent.
•	Complete Ariel’s quest by Clearing Wally Land 7 times and having a Magical Textile Coatings Formula. You can give these to Ariel to get another Magical Textile Coating.
•	Inside Wally Land, monsters will drop Wally Coins¸ which you can exchange to Ariel for random costume cubes. Within these costume cubes, are 15 day costumes that you can make permanent. 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Step back in time when skilled warriors are able to do impossible fight sequences wearing long intricate, and probably heavy, clothing. With the Royal Court Dress, you’ll be able to relive that experience! Get them tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/8DwGKXW.jpg[/img]

Are you a cat lover? Well, who isn’t?! Don’t worry, this mount will turn you into a bonafide cat addict if you aren’t already. This is our most adorable mount yet! Check out Maru at the Item Mall tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bS61hHd.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now brave adventurers! 

Enjoy the Anniversary week and see y’all in game!

notes.title: Onwards to 5 Years! Elsword’s Pre-Anniversary Event and Much Coveted Item Mall Goodies!
notes.notes:
Hiya adventurers! We know you’re having fun playing Elsword but let’s be mellow for a bit. You may not have noticed the years fly by because you were having fun, making friends, raiding dungeons, killing stuff and more but Elsword Online is about to celebrate their 5th Anniversary! Tomorrow we’re doing a pre-anniversary celebration to thank you, the players, for sticking with us. *sobs* But enough of that! We’ve got new costumes and ice burners and customizations for you at the Item Mall so go on and check it out!

Pre-5th Anniversary Celebration
To thank all the players, new and old, Elsword is giving away tons of rewards! Join the celebration, you only have to log-in starting tomorrow! 
•	If you’re level 10 and up, you only have to log-in for 30 mins to receive rewards like: Luriel’s Ice Burner, Ice Burner Jackpot Cube, and Trump Bunny Snow White Costume Parts Random Cube. Whew, what a mouthful!
•	If you’re feeling up for the challenge, clear a dungeon within your level range 5 times and get a Trump Bunny Snow White Costume Parts Random Cube!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Show the world that the Mistress and Servant Demon Duo can be just as cold and uncaring as the next guy. A change in the eyes will make a huge difference. Get the Pair a pair of new Chic Eyes tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HDIjMdJ.jpg[/img]

The indestructible spirit of the Diamond Yaksha manifests in the Demon Duo’s persona. Collect the set through Ice Burners starting tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Nv2unLq.jpg[/img]

Look so sharp you give people papercuts just by staring but feel as light as air with Dark Feather and Shining Feather costumes! Out tomorrow at the Item Mall.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Nv2unLq.jpg[/img]

That’s it folks! We hope you’ll enjoy tomorrow’s Pre-anniversary event!

See y’all in  game~

notes.title: Elysion Tower, City Outskirts, and Perkisas Phase 3 headed your way!
notes.notes:
Heya Elpeeps! 

New dungeon Elysion Tower releasing, City Outskirts field ready for exploring, another Perkisas Phase available for all of you… This week is bringing a lot of new content your way! Are you ready?

Elysion just got bigger! The new field City Outskirts is ready for players to go and explore. What kind of monsters await you? Any more cute Plingchus to meet? You’ll have to wait until tomorrow to find out! Along with the City Outskirts, Elysion Tower will be opening up. The pinnacle of Elysion is where you’ll meet the final boss, Maya. Are you ready for the final battle? Could your search for the El Lady end here?

Toward Elysion! Event

To help you out with these new areas, be sure to take part in this special event and prepare yourself for what lies ahead!
•	Every day during the event, log into Elsword for at least 10 minutes and receive a Diceon Shield Piece and Moonlight Dream (Elysion) Cube. 
•	Daily Events will help you acquire items that can be exchanged through Ariel for materials and crafting purposes.
•	During the event, players who clear Elysion Tower (Hard Mode) will have a doubled chance to acquire a title! 

Perkisas Phase 3!!

You guys have made it! Now is the time to try and pass the final trials and defeat the King of Greed once and for all. See Perkisas as you never have before as his Nightmare Perkisas (his human form). I wish you the best of luck adventurers!
•	During the event, every player that completes the battle will receive 2 Perkisas’s Treasure Boxes (regardless of points acquired). You will also receive between 60,000 ~ 800,000 ED!
•	Loot Treasure Boxes inside Perkisas’ lair for a chance to receive some really cool items like a [Cobo] Phoru's Foot Stamp (White) or a Blessed Weapon Enhancement Stone to name a few.
•	Guilds will be ranked according to their accumulated accomplishments when playing the raid. Rewards will be in the Mailbox on the next maintenance day so be sure to keep playing!

ITEM MALL GOODIES
Just because you are out on the battle field doesn’t mean you still can’t look just as sophisticated and posh as ever! Start collecting the Velder Academy Knights set from Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hk7fPvX.jpg[/img]

See you in game guys~!

notes.title: The Spirit of Elrios has come to bless the land! Plus, Uniforms and New Ice Burner for Luciel at the Item Mall!
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers! How do you like Elysion so far? Have you gotten to know Yuno and Nono a little better? Explored the fields and dungeons yet? Battled the mighty bosses of Elysion? And more importantly, have you reached level 85 yet? If you’re not 85 yet, there’s no need to worry your purdy little heads because there’re plenty of things to do so you can reach that level cap easily!

Hello PVPers! Just a reminder that PVP Season 4 Events ends tonight! There’s no time to waste if you want to complete these events! Sleep in the Arena if you must! Best of luck to all of you! Harmony Festival also ends next week so enjoy those unlimited Harmony Festival pies while you can. This week we have the Elrios’ Spirit Event! We also have new things at the Item Mall so be sure to check those out!

The Spirit of Elrios Event
Be #blessed by the mighty Spirit of Elrios and let it guide you to be stronger and faster so you could vanquish your enemies with one punch… or two. 
•	Receive Spirit’s Blessings when you log-in for 10 minutes. You can collect and exchange them with Ariel for very useful rewards.
•	For three weeks during the event, you’ll encounter a unique monster every week which has a chance to drop rare loots. These are monsters Uniring, Dark Hameling, and Living Armor. Watch out for these in fields and dungeons.
•	There are two new Arena type matches available only during the event! Both of them are very exciting and a lot of fun! Capture the Flag and Leader Battle will test your teamwork to the limits! No rage quitting allowed or you may have just led your opponents to victory.

ITEM MALL GOODIES

It’s back to school for Elsword and the gang, except for Luciel since they’re busy with Overlord stuff, but the rest is ready to get their learning on or at least look like it. Velder Academy Uniforms are the best kind of battle uniforms money can buy. So go ahead, try it out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/MGFI0nO.jpg[/img]

Step aside, peasants! Make way for your Overlord and her trusty liege! Luciel: Royal Blood is a very fitting attire for these underworld nobles. Start collecting the set from Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZHMYSI2.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, don’t forget to join the event and get to 85!
See you all in game adventurers!

notes.title: Step Inside the new map, Elysion, and reach the new level cap!
notes.notes:
Hiya Elpeeps! How’d you guys like our April Fools’ gimmick? We had fun coming up with all sorts of shenanigans and loved how this turned out. It had the complete set-up with a trailer, and the website was made to look as if it’s a real, legitimate major update. We had a blast and we hope you did too! Be sure to watch out for next year’s shenanigans!

Moving forward, we have a lot more new content for you, brave adventurers! Read on to find out what’s up tomorrow and don’t forget to browse the Item Mall for new stuff and thangs!

Elysion
Enter a brave new world where technology and robots rule! The search for the El Lady may even come to an end. If you want to find out then enter the new map and prepare yourselves for new adventures ahead! Tomorrow!
•	Meet the new NPCs, Yuno and his cute friend Nono. They might end up doing more than sell your basic needs.
•	If you’re level 10 and above and you log-in for 10 minutes, you’ll get a Transcended Key Code Title and Dekal’s Accessory Cube.
•	And players who get to level 85 during the event will receive an Elrios Hero Recognition Cube. It contains very awesome things but you’ll have to get it to find out!

Level 85 Cap
Just when you thought you’ve reached the highest level, we’ve gone and raised the cap! Prepare for the challenges that Elysion brings because being 85 is when life begins at Elrios.


ITEM MALL GOODIES
Your name may not be Mina Harker but Vincent is an adorable pet vampire that you’d actually want stalking you! Plus, he brings his own coffin! How cool is that?

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9r0lwMH.jpg[/img]

Step aside, peasants! Make way for your Overlord and her trusty liege! Luciel: Royal Blood is a very fitting attire for these underworld nobles. Start collecting the set from Ice Burners tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9ftunif.jpg[/img]

Suit up and dress up in the whimsical fashion of nonsensical Wonderland. Because of whoever thought of playing cards as clothing items must be a genius, right? Checkout Elsword in Wonderland for Luciel Costumes when it comes out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HDDjt2O.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now, folks! Don’t forget to join the events tomorrow!

See y’all in game~

notes.title: Start a Fight and Get Ready to Explore New Lands!
notes.notes:
Hiya Elpeeps! Breathe in some more of that spring air because it’ll be spring for a while. Yay! Or Boo! The month’s about to end but we have a lot of new and exciting updates and events for you. There are a couple of new costumes at the Item Mall so be sure to check those out as well. 

PVP Season 4 
Been itching to just go out there and start a fight with someone? Well, don’t do it! You’ll get arrested and stuff. Here in Elsword, you most definitely can challenge anyone, take it to the Arena and start some good ol’ fashion rumble! Especially now that we’re about to start a new PVP season.
•	Before you begin, you should know that the rankings will be reset tonight. It gives everyone a fair chance to fight, claw, kick, slice, or blast their way to the top.
•	Camilla from Cobo is a bit extreme what with her strict conditions to get the title of PVP Master. Of course, it’s no biggie for caliber players such as yourselves.  Just win 1,000 Official PVP fights! Psssh easy!
•	Well, even if you can’t, if you’re level 10 and above, just spend 10 mins in game and you’ll get a 1 Day PVP Master title.

New Map Pre-launch Event
Expand your horizons! Literally! That’s what the whole continent of Elrios is going to do next week. Are you ready for the opening of the map? Probably not, because we’re raising the level cap along with it! But fear not; join the pre-launch events and starting tomorrow we will get you ready for the actual launch. 
•	When you log-in for 10 minutes, players will receive a special weapon which increases players’ damage and speed in dungeons.
•	There’re also a bunch of level up events where players can easily gain exp and reach level 80!


ITEM MALL GOODIES

Look at this stuff, isn’t it neat? We still don’t think your collection’s complete. But don’t worry we’ll fix that! Because we’ve got the stuff you love to have! 

Love Luciel? Love Navy uniforms? We do too! Prepare your grabby hands because tomorrow the Hamel Navy Officer Costume comes out!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Sqplt2V.jpg[/img]

Butterflies come fluttering when spring rolls in and what better creature to take inspiration from? Dress up in a butterfly inspired ensemble with the Butterfly Fantasy Costume and complete the look with a Butterfly Fantasy Skill Cut-in.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PY3HcEa.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rOmcfhr.jpg[/img]

What’s interesting about this set is that it wasn’t designed by an in-house designer! This set was designed by PiKA, a talented artist who shares her work on her Pixiv account. You can view her art, specifically the Butterfly Costume, [URL=” http://www.pixiv.net/member_illust.php?mode=medium&illust_id=52488003”]on PiKA’s account here![/URL]
So to all of our aspiring artists out there, perhaps one day your work also could be featured so keep practicing!
Excited yet for this update? We sure are!
That’s all for now! See y’all in game!

notes.title: Celebrate the Harmony Festival with Free Pies and Free Stuff!
notes.notes:
Heya Elpeeps! Spring has sprung and a new season has begun! Some of you may still be looking for a sign of spring or you may be experiencing a little too much sun. Either way, you can safely go back to your computer before you strain your eyes. Phew! Now, here at Elsword there’s none of that dangerous spring sun burning your eyes. You can enjoy spring and all its activities at the comforts of your own home. We also have something Angelic at the Item Mall for tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/JuPEbmT.jpg[/img]

Harmony Festival
Celebrate the joy of a peaceful co-existence with your friends, your guild, and everyone else in Elrios. We have some activities that we know will pique your interests.
•	Celebrate the Harmony Festival by wearing the traditional festival garb of Elrios. Receive the full Harmony Festival 30 Days Costume when you log-in during the event tomorrow!
•	We’re also giving away Harmony Festival Accessories every week for three weeks!
•	Who doesn’t like pie? Everybody loves pie! That’s why all alchemists in the game will be giving away Harmony Festival Pies during the event. By giving away, I meant they cost 0ED so start hoarding all the pies!
•	Logging in for at least 10 minutes guarantees a Harmony Festival Ticket which you can use to exchange for items through Ariel. Stay logged-in for an hour and you get more tickets and Harmony Festival Gift Boxes. Doing festival related quests will also give you Harmony Festival Tickets.
•	The Harmony Festival also guarantees Doubled Content Rewards from Secret Dungeons, Henir’s Time and Space, Gate of Darkness, and all their relevant quests. 

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Listen ‘o ye creature of the mortal coil, the angels bestowed upon the earth their most prized treasures: Seraphim – Holy Angel Accessories. Art thou fair mortal worthy to equip the treasures of heaven? Find out tomorrow!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/HOKQHAX.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now~ See y’all in game!

notes.title: Perkisas is Back for Spring Break! Plus, Check out In-Game Events and Item Mall Goodies!
notes.notes:
Hiya Elpeeps! Spring is here which means Spring Break is just around the corner. Some of you may have already even started vacationing, yay! Just so you don’t get bored, we’ve got a lot of activities happening tomorrow in-game so make sure you join them because they promise awesome rewards. We’ve got new sets at the Item Mall so be sure to check that out as well. 

Perkisas Phase 2
It’s finally here! Tomorrow! It’s dragon hunting season as the 2nd phase of the raid begins! Instead of just “going at it,” we have events to help each player do their best at the raid. 
•	During the event, every time you complete a raid mode you can get twice the number of Perkisas’s Treasure Box. This means more loot for everyone!
•	Players can also get accessories like the Mini Ballista, Mini Ballista – Dragon Watcher, and the Ripped Perkisas Wings when they join the event, collect, and exchange the necessary materials through Ariel.
•	Guilds will be ranked according to their accumulated accomplishments when playing the raid. Rewards will be in the Mailbox on the next maintenance day so be sure to keep playing!

Balance Revamp
After the character revamps we’re shifting our focus towards balancing the dungeon and pvp/arena skills of each character.  It wouldn’t be much fun if everybody’s OP in the Arena, right? The Balance Revamp’s rewards are a fun way to gauge if you’ve enjoyed the Balance Revamp or if you want more.
It’s time to test drive your characters’ new skills in dungeons or in the arena!

Easter Events
Instead of just looking for eggs this Easter season, we also want you to destroy them. That’s right, destroy all the Easter Harpy Nests you can find and you’ll get a reward to exchange for an even better reward! The reward is an Easter Harpy Jr. Costume Suit! How sweet is that? 

Refer A Friend Reminder
Have you been checking your referral interface lately? If not, then I think it’s time to do so because Refer A Friend ends today so be sure to claim your rewards!


ITEM MALL GOODIES

There’s no doubt that we’re always bringing you the hot stuff that would make your friends green with envy. Take this new Ice Burner: Ignition Caligo, for example; it’s super hot and extra intimidating.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zJ2UL9r.jpg[/img]

Lu & Ciel channel Spring with a floral display. The Demon Duo welcomes the new season with Waltz of the Flowers Costumes.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tpHvA0M.jpg[/img]

Why did the Harpy Jr. cross the road? To peck your eye out for taking its costume, of course!  The Fancy Easter Harpy Costume Suit comes out tomorrow for hatchlings looking to be extra fancy.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Zx5dpFm.jpg[/img]

Enjoy your Spring Break, everyone!

See y’all in-game!

notes.notes:

You still have a few more days to qualify for the Add & Luciel Sweepstakes if you haven’t been playing them yet. It’s so simple plus, you can win some Elsword swag especially Add and Luciel figures!

This week, we have a new mount for you and one epic event coming soon.

Perkisas Phase 2
We’re excited to announce that Perkisas Phase 2 is coming very soon! You can finally test your mastery of your character’s newly revamped skill sets in the next phase of this epic dungeon raid. Can you and your friends slay this mighty incarnation of greed a second time?
 
ITEM MALL GOODIES

Did you know that blue flame burns hotter than red? That’s why we consider the Phantom Steed our hottest ride ever, both figuratively and literally! Get it tomorrow when it comes out at the Item Mall!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lC8egCS.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now! Be sure to check out the website for more information regarding events and announcements~

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Elsword’s Last Character Revamp for Season 2 is HERE! Plus, Tons of Things at the Item Mall
notes.notes:
Hiya Elpeeps! The all-new Add, Lu & Ciel are about to be revealed! So just hang tight for now and get your characters ready. If you haven’t heard yet, please be advised that the maintenance has been moved to Thursday, March 3, 2016 for this week only. After this, we will likely return to our every-other-Wednesday maintenance schedule as usual, unless otherwise announced.

Add/Luciel Revamp Event

Our terrifying three, Tracer and Demon Duo, are going to be revamped! This will be the last character revamp for Season 2 and just because they’re last doesn’t make them less special. In fact, there seems to be more going on this week!
•	Once again, and for the last time, REVAMP CUBES~! Every time you open the box it gives you free stuff so it helps out Add and Luciel in their journey to 80! When you open the box playing as either Lu or Ciel, both characters will receive the promotional costumes! 
•	Of course, you won’t be able to open the boxes if you ain’t levelin’ so start grinding on the weekends for Weekend FEVER!  OH YAS!
•	For one week, when you log-in for 10 minutes as any character, you’ll get a 15 Days Ignition Weapon Costume. Log-in the next day as a different character and you’ll be able to get a weapon costume for this different character! You don’t even have to be level 10 to get the weapon! You can also get a New Dual Magic Stone Random Cube when you log in for 10 minutes. 
•	For two weeks, until the end of the last revamp, when you log-in for 30 mins you’ll get Luriel’s Special Magic Stone Random Cube and a Red Crystal Fragment. When you’ve collected 5 pieces of the fragment, you can exchange it with Ariel to make your Ignition Weapon Costume permanent!

NEW AT THE ITEM MALL 

Add and Luciel get their very own El Search Party Officer Costumes. They finally get a turn at the official look, so you better start collecting Grand Ice Burners starting Thursday!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/s7pH4uX.jpg[/img]

You can start planning out your idol group and gathering groupies! Become a pop icon with the Idol Package!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PH4Qe09.jpg[/img]

The Demon Duo emulates the bringer of death with Thanatos found in Ice Burners. Start collecting and bring on the pain!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PQe9Br5.jpg[/img]

Get a companion that’s sort of like you! Or acts like your favorite hero. This Special Edition Mystic Pet will mimic any of our heroes depending on which pet you get. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4h5c5ZX.jpg[/img]

Check out these new items and more at the Item Mall this Thursday!

See you all in game, folks!

notes.title: Check out the all new Ara and Elesis. Plus, Get Rewards When You Refer A Friend!
notes.notes:
Elsword’s next instalment of their Season Two update series with Ara and Elesis – a unity most lethal!

Elsword has paired two of the most prominent, beautiful and seductively savage playable characters in Elsword in the latest Season 2 update with a full-featured makeover that promises to deliver a lethal dose of excitement and unadulterated metal. 

Everything from character concept and illustration to functionality and effectiveness have been overhauled and refined to bring these lovely ladies to the fore and level any argument about the fact that these lovely ladies have come to teach the boys club how to wreck the competition and Fight Like A Girl! 

As with all Season 2 character updates, the Skill Tree revamp includes new character functionality basics, character intro and primary skill upgrades.  Players can learn EVERY skill automatically by reaching the skill-appropriate level and players’ no longer need to choose between skills!  Additionally, Ara and Elesis’ revamped basic attack combos bring a whole new world of dynamic (and hurt) to each Job or Class advancement. notes.notes:
Heya Elpeeps! We reveal Ara’s and Elesis’ revamped forms tomorrow and I know that everyone’s been waiting to play these feisty females! But we also have tons of events happening tomorrow that you definitely wouldn’t want to miss (becuz rewards). The Item Mall is stocked with new things like GIBs for Ara and Elesis, and costumes for Lu & Ciel so don’t forget to check ‘em out!
Revamp Event for Ara & Elesis

Our Red Knight and Nine Tails are ready for a major transformation 
tomorrow! Play as them and get tons of rewards. If you do, you instantly qualify for another special event!

•	The Reward Cube for Ara/Elesis gives you a promotional costume in commemoration of the girls’ revamp for every 10 levels starting at level 20.
•	Opening those Reward Cubes are going to be a breeze when you play on the weekends because there’s Weekend FEVER! Get 2x EXP when you play as either Ara or Elesis on the weekends and you’ll be catching up with higher level characters in no time! And anyone teamed up with Ara or Elesis during dungeon runs will get additional EXP! 
•	There’s a log-in event that gives you a Blue Crystal Piece when you go online for 30 minutes. Collect enough pieces and you can exchange it with Ariel for consumables or a rare Weapon Costume Cube!

Ara & Elesis Maniac Sweepstakes!

Don’t just play for 30 mins as Ara or Elesis, play them both for a minimum of 2 hours each (total 4 hours) and you’ll automatically qualify for the Sweepstakes! 

Refer-a-Friend

Get your friends to play Elsword and you will be handsomely rewarded. Consumables and a rare mount are part of the bounty. Get them to level up their characters and there will be more rewards! Don’t miss this rare event!

ITEM MALL GOODIES

Ara and Elesis get a turn at looking absolutely official with the El Search Party Officer costume. Pieces are found in every Grand Ice Burner Package so start collecting them now!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/I57gCsa.jpg[/img]

Be an extra intimidating opponent and raise a little hell when you dress up Lu & Ciel as Dragon Knights.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/O6B0JyU.jpg[/img]

Serve some good ol’ fashion coffee and toast and maybe beat up the opposition on the side as Lu & Ciel get their very own Sweet Waitress and Sweet Barista costumes.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/kPG78Ud.jpg[/img]

See y’all in game folks!
