notes.title: Time Tracer Arrives! Level Boost to 35 for 1 Week!
notes.notes:
Hi Elpeeps! If you could travel back in time and change your past, would you? Add leads a tough life after his family was killed for researching the forbidden secrets of the Nasods. With the hopes of changing a tragic part of his life, Add advances as the Time Tracer to do just that. 

Plus don't miss out on Level Boosting Time Tracer to 35 instantly!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/sZ9KrXIl.jpg[/img]

The Story

The temporally displaced Add tries to find a way back to his own time, with the hope of changing the events that led to his misery. With great effort, he finally figures out the time travel equation. To implement it on his Dynamos, he only needs the right material—a unique mineral he manages to steal from the Ponggos in Altera. Now the Time Tracer, capable of moving through time and space, Add directs his attention to finding an energy source that will let him make more accurate time-space calculations for his ultimate journey home.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IP4NOEpl.jpg[/img]

Time Tracer’s Features

•	Nasod Armor Mode - Overlimit System (think 2 MP bars that assist each other).
•	Space and Time Traveling abilities.
•	Snazzy eye-patch!
•	Resurrections by turning back the clock

The Moves and Gameplay

Time Tracer has a major advantage which essentially gives him 2 MP bars that work off each other with his passive skill Overlimit. With this you are able to toggle between Configuration and Dissolution Mode to manage your resources.

Here’s a look into how Time Tracer can keep himself ready to toss out skills constantly by keeping up his MP and DP.

Configuration Mode (Awakening): Consumes DP instead of MP and returns some MP depending on the skill that was used.
Dissolution Mode (Non-Awakening): Consumes MP instead of DP and returns some DP depending on the skill that was used. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/nuyiP8fl.jpg[/img]

Having two MP bars does allow you to have the resources to toss out many skills, but there is still one more barrier to tackle and that would be cooldowns. The great thing about being a master of time and cooldowns is that it’s almost a given that you can affect them in some way. To synergize with ample resources, Time Tracer has a skill called Seal of Time which lowers the cooldown of not just you, but all your allies. Combine all the factors listed above together and you’re looking at total annihilation.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/oa8NSUIl.jpg[/img]

If there’s one thing to know about Time Tracer, it’s that once his special actives start rolling, you can expect him to keep the momentum going!

Level Boost Event

Plus… Here comes your chance to boost your Add up to Level 35 for FREE! Just go to any nearby village or a resting area between fields and wait for the pop-up menu to appear. Click the Level Boost button, and presto! Boosting your Add also comes with an exclusive Level Boost Cube containing an enhanced weapon and armor set to help get you started. That’s just one of the many benefits of course!

Item Mall Goodies

With Add’s release comes a new Ice Burner - Diamond Yaksha!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9f6qI7rl.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Soon: The Last Master of Darkness
notes.notes:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! One week to go before we introduce the last job path of the Masters of Darkness series. Ready yourselves for Dark Tracer, the height of mAddness! Just after being flung forward to the present when his obsession, the Nasod race, had already fallen, Add may soon be able to follow his desire to go back to a time he knew—back when the Nasod race flourished and everything was as it should be. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4qP81k4.jpg[/img]

Find out what it’s like to have the advancements and complexities of science at your disposal. Prepare to trounce foes with time-and-space defying tricks, including summoning spatiotemporal bodies of super vibrating atoms to hit enemies to submission. One of the Dark Tracer’s skills I look forward to the most is one that lets you undo death in battle by going back to a specific point in time. No resurrection stones? No problem! Be there when Dark Tracer arrives next week!

Item Mall Goodies

Now on to new stuff coming in this week! The new pet Marionette arrives at the Item Mall after midnight tonight. Looks can definitely deceive because this is no mere doll… it’s a powerhouse!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/gpbl6QH.jpg[/img]

Also watch out for Waltz of the Flowers Costumes for Add and Elesis. What do you think about these two having this dance? I bet it’ll be a refreshing sight. :-) 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LDipBXr.jpg[/img]

One more thing before I go: Show up for FREE Supplies from COBO! For a full week starting tomorrow, play 30 minutes or more each day to get an awesome support item from your adventurer supplies company. The first one is a random 7-day mount! Plus more rewards to be earned from completing the Cobo Special Missions. Don’t miss out!

See y’all in-game!

notes.title: Let’s All Welcome Grand Chasers!
notes.notes:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! As many of you may have heard, KOG Games’ Grand Chase service will be closing soon. This is sad news for us and especially for the many players and fans of the well-loved forerunner of Elsword Online. In light of this, we also have some pretty big news. Starting tomorrow, we’re having a wonderful in-game event to welcome Grand Chasers who played in KOG Games’ NA server, so that they may find a fitting new home in Elrios. :-)

How do you, true-blue Elpeeps, figure in this? Well, you can be part of the welcoming committee. And of course, you get free goodies, too! Right off the bat, you get a Welcome Grand Chase title to help the cause. You also get to earn Link Up Coins that you can collect and exchange for awesome items—find out by visiting our special guest GC NPC, Rita. You might even get to craft free pets, full costume sets, a Skill Slot Change Medal, Ice Burners, Fossil Readers, and more. Sound good? Get in the game starting tomorrow for your chance at some of the most mind-blowing rewards!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/XJhdYw8l.jpg[/img]

Item Mall Goodies

Your standard Ice Burner system gets a new costume set. Glacial thaws out and makes way for Hamel Navy Officer. Awesome costume for sailing off to a sunshiny destination!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/NhUHm0Pl.jpg[/img]

While there will be a special Cobo event for sampling a new service, the Nasod Welding Costume Suit and Accessories will be available at the Item Mall. Do these look familiar?  Tip: You can craft these, too!  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SusWcb6l.jpg[/img]

Finally, are you missing some parts of old Ice Burner sets, particularly Archangel or El Search Party Officer? Good news! These legendary costumes return by way of Cobo Costume Boxes. These work in a similar fashion to Ice Burners, but even better—there’s a costume box version for each character, so any costume piece that comes out will be for the character you picked. Isn’t it great?! 

*Pieces received from these boxes cannot be traded*

[img]http://i.imgur.com/OVaFDbll.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Vengeance is Now Yours with Crimson Avenger!
notes.notes:
What would you do if all of your comrades were lost in battle? Would you stop at nothing to avenge them? The Dark Knight ascends to greater powers fueled by Vengeance as the Crimson Avenger!!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/l0kyotml.jpg[/img]

The Story
Being ambushed by Demons and hardly being able to defend herself, Elesis loses all of the knights that have fought at her side in Fieta. She is able to survive by absorbing energy from the Dark El confiscated by Amethyst, but unfortunately she loses some her sanity. Despite the haze that looms in her mind, one thing is absolutely clear… She will stop at nothing to get her Vengeance. Demons beware…

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LuARxQwl.jpg[/img]

Dark Knight’s Features
•	New Hyperactive Fate Smash!
•	New skills to combine with the Blood Hit System.
•	Instead of Elesis’ usual Red Eyes, they are now Amber colored.
•	Newer even MOAR smexier costume… ;-)

The Moves and Gameplay

Some of you may still be new to the Dark Knights Path and Crimson Avenger, so here is a recap on the Blood Hit System: When HP is above 20% her special actives take 20% of her HP and deal 40% more damage. When she is below 20%, Blood Hit has no HP requirements. This still applies to CA’s new skills and combos.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/mBlF21gl.jpg[/img]

>>Z X (X) Hold combo is CA’s most powerful combo. That extension deals massive damage, opponents are paralyzed and cannot Mana break or escape and each and every hit can activate elements or any on-hit effect in general.

Passives Skills although not as flashy as Actives or Special Actives are super important. For the PvP enthusiasts Condemnation is a passive that makes comboing an CA up close incredibly undesirable as she is able to break out of combos and deal great damage all at the same time.

Eve isn’t the only one with the power of the Fist… Assault Strike can prevent opponents from Mana breaking in PvP, by using this skill along with CA’s >>Z XX combo extension you can render opponents helpless and no options to escape. >:-D

[img]http://i.imgur.com/YgkKZurl.jpg[/img]

An impressive way to slay your enemies… Destroy them all with the New Hyperactive Fate Smash! Elesis charges up and slices the entire map with Dark Energy. *.*

Item Mall Goodies

Lunar New Year’s is coming up! Check out the new Shiny Qipao Costume Suit!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/UMhhsD4l.jpg[/img]
Channel your inner DOVAHKIIN! Hue… Fly around Elrios with the new Ascalon!!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/In3ma3ml.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Dark Knight Arrives! Level Boost to 35!
notes.notes:
Elesis, beautiful, noble, strong… just one of the few words we can describe the Red Knight. But what happens when being righteous isn’t enough?! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZodPsUpl.jpg[/img]

Elesis turns to the dark side as the Dark Knight to defeat her most treacherous enemies. 


The Story
Lord Wally, Elder’s oppressive leader, has been exploiting the power of the El for quite some time. Elesis, as the Red Knight has attempted to stop him, but all of her efforts have been thwarted due to Wally’s possession of Nasod Power.

Luichel, Elder’s town accessory merchant, advises Elesis that the virtuous path isn’t always the most effective and that sometimes one must handle evil with brute force. With Luichel’s assistance, Elesis is able to overthrow Wally’s troops. Elesis now understands that she must turn to the path of darkness in order to defeat the enemy. Elesis from then and there continues her fight as the Dark Knight.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/5kUAjqMl.jpg[/img]

Dark Knight’s Features
•	Utilizes HP to deal greater damage on certain actives and special actives.
•	She’s able to drain the life out of enemies.
•	Her attacks are stronger when low in health.
•	Clothes are noticeably form fitting and smexier… ;-)

The Moves and Gameplay

It’s all about HP consumption with her Blood Hit System. When HP is above 20% her special actives take 20% of her HP and deal 40% more damage. When she is below 20%, Blood Hit has no HP requirements. To offset HP loss, passive skill Overflowing Blood recovers HP when injecting enemies 5 times with evil energy. Overflowing Madness increases in MP recovery when reaching a certain threshold of HP. The lower your HP, the higher the MP recovery.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/3IV6YY4l.jpg[/img]

Dark Knights passive Dark Force has a paramount role in her gameplay style which changes the effect of the chivalry system. When Gale mode is activated moves assist with HP Recovery. When Annihilation is on, Annihilation attacks are strengthened.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/6HpNSdal.jpg[/img]

As far as the MOAR flashier 300 MP skills, some of them cost additional HP the longer you charge, but the damage is noticeably greater.

Level Boost Events for Elesis Dark Knight

Boost your Base class Elesis to Level 35 instantly from January 28th to February 3rd


Item Mall Goodies

And for goodies in the shop we have new pajama costumes for Elesis and Add! 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/xEzjRxel.jpg[/img]

Plus the new Evil Tracer set for Elesis!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Hv47L6yl.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Want Your Own Foxy Pet?
notes.notes:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! So, how about that nine-tailed pet? Revel in the ancient mystery this week in Millennium Fox’s Calling. In this Elsword Online in-game event, the Millennium Fox chooses to journey with you. Will you accept? It’s not that simple, though. If you prove yourself worthy, the pet will stay with you for good! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Vtsc2i3l.jpg[/img]

Here’s a quick summary of steps to make this happen with Zero K-Ching:

1.	Get the Millennium Fox’s Hairpin. Play for 10 minutes to receive this pet summoning item. Right-click to equip the Millennium Fox as your pet for 15 days.
2.	Get the Weak Millennium Fox’s Soul. Play for 60 minutes to receive and keep this in your inventory for now.
3.	Complete the quest, Millennium Fox’s Soul. Acquire the item called Millennium Fox’s Soul by handing the Weak Millennium Fox's Soul and 70 Fragments of Millennium Fox's Soul (from clearing dungeons in your level range) to Ariel. And at the same time… 
4.	Bring your pet Millennium Fox’s Affinity up to 100%. Keep playing while this temporary pet is equipped until it reaches 100% special status. Be sure to feed it with Millennium Fox’s Orbs from Ariel!
5.	Apply the Millennium Fox’s Soul. Right click on this item while the Millennium Fox pet is equipped, and it’s yours to keep!

Think you can do it? Gather up your Elpeeps and make this a fun group quest! As an alternative, you can get the cash version of the Millennium Fox’s Soul for just 400 K-Ching. Afterward, once you’ve succeeded in making the event pet permanent, you might like to take it up a notch—get better stats, a roomier pet bag, and even an adorably sinister look with the Awakened Millennium Fox’s Soul for only 400 K-Ching!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/KWpr6VCl.jpg[/img]

Plus, don’t forget to check out the new Curious Fox costume suits!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/N0gWN8ql.jpg[/img]
 
Watch out for more details in Elsword after the patch this Wednesday!

notes.title: Phantom Foxy ~ New Class Asura!
notes.notes:
We talk a lot about Eun, Ara’s Nine Tailed Fox spirit companion… but have you ever thought what Eun actually looked like? The appearance and power of Eun becomes more noticeable in Little Specter’s new class, Asura!!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/vHJJLdBl.jpg[/img]

The Story

“Ara finally tracks her brother down in Feita, but to her sheer dismay, the brother she once knew has become the notorious leader of the demon army. Aren does not recognize her and even worse, Ara witnesses the great evil acts he is now capable of doing. The young lady is devastated, and yet a voice kindles a little hope—that of the spirit of the nine-tailed fox Eun. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Hlb0APwl.jpg[/img]

The fox spirit persuades Ara to accept it completely, so that the martial artist may grow even stronger and overcome all her troubles with the help of its otherworldly powers. Doing so will defy her ancestors’ tradition of exorcism, but in Ara’s anguish, she could see no other way to prevail but to embrace the great specter. And though Eun’s intentions remain hidden, the fact that it has never caused Ara any harm in all their time together is enough to convince her. notes.title: Get Foxy with NEW CLASS Little Specter
notes.notes:
It’s time to get super foxy with Ara’s new Job Class Path Little Specter! Ara becomes more in touch with her supernatural side to Exorcise Demons. Let’s hop right to it!!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/mPSZjxMl.png[/img]

The Story

Ara continues the search for her brother Aren/Ran… But in the meantime she is also in pursuit of finding a way to free Eun, the ancient Nine Tailed Fox who saved her in the past, in appreciation for saving her from the demons who invaded her village. The seal to trapping Eun in her hairpin was made using her family’s age old art of exorcism. However, her family was annihilated by the demons before she could learn to master this art.

Meeting with Echo the alchemist, Ara learns about a device that can project the memories of Eun. She sees a vision of how Eun was captured in the hairpin and from this she learned the secret exorcism arts her family performed to create Eun’s seal. Thus she became known as the Little Specter.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ThVGWA1l.jpg[/img]

The Features of Little Specter

•	Brand New Exorcist Path
•	Little Specter is the first and only class in Elsword with two different colored eyes
•	She can enter Eun mode with 1 bead as a three tailed fox, 2 beads as a six tailed fox, 3 beads gives her fox ears and nine tails
•	Assets… *COUGH* are noticeably larger compared to her other classes… Hue… <333
The Moves and Gameplay 

Little Specter features some lightning fast and elusive moves along with claws and ghouls from the depths of hell. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/dQLWMyyl.jpg[/img]

Discordance lets her slice past enemies once, slice back to where she started then cut through once more in the blink of an eye.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/hDa7d8ul.jpg[/img]
Specter Walk allows Ara to enter the shadows and turn invisible. While invisible Ara won’t flinch and she will have an increase to her movement and jump speed. On top of this, she can pass through enemies and curse those she passes through with a defense reduction debuff. 

Item Mall Goodies

Elpeeps can get dressed up in the Spring Academy Uniform. Check out the cute little fox on Ara’s beret!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/P03bk2wl.jpg[/img]

Cleaning up the demon invasion in Elrios is hard work, but you can do it in style with the new Royal Maid Costume for Ara.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wmPNIe7l.jpg[/img]

A new mount just in time and in theme for the Holiday Season. Meet Senarhl the ice crystal reindeer. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/U2pC5Wel.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Elsword Profession System
notes.notes:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! A new feature arrives in Elsword Online tomorrow. In addition to your character-specific Job, you can now choose a Profession! The Profession System allows you to pick one of 3 talents when you reach Level 40. You can be a Treasure Hunter, Blacksmith, or Alchemist. How do you know which one is for you?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/bkgbWHjl.jpg[/IMG]

First, if you want all the undiscovered gold all over Elrios, then Treasure Hunter is the perfect match for you. As a discoverer of hidden bling, you will chance upon some treasure chests when playing dungeons. These hold Golden Accessories, Ancient Gold Coins, and more!

Meanwhile, if you’re into making better and better armor and weapons using the Enhancement function, then you might enjoy becoming a Blacksmith. This gives you access to Premium Enhancement (up to +3 at a time) and Dismantling (better chance to get Mystery El Shards, Magic Stones, and  Magic Amulets), plus produce random enhanced equips using the Mysterious El Anvil.

However, if you’re really all about mixing and Magic Stones, then you’d make a great Alchemist. Craft exclusive consumables such as Giant Stone Apples and Epic NPC Cards, and get access to Premium Enchant/Socketing for amazing additional stats on your equips. 

Similar to your battle skills, you can increase your capability in your chosen profession. How? Why, with practice of course! Profession Level 10 is the goal. Tip: Watch out for a special item that will let you switch to another profession for a limited time. Get it tomorrow!

Item Mall Goodies
Attention, accessory enthusiasts! Lots of new accessories will be delivered to the Item Mall tomorrow, too. Take your pick from fun new mufflers, eyeglasses, eye patches, weapon guards, eye-catching effects, and even some additional bear items. Check them out and reinvent your look!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/hoZ5LnVl.jpg[/IMG]

Finally, Add’s Ice Burner returns with Dragon Knight! 

 [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ntNLJBXl.jpg[/IMG]

See you in-game tomorrow!

notes.title: NOW LIVE : Party Hard and Raid Like A Boss!
notes.notes:
Today Elsword launches into the holiday season with some massive and mech’d out events.  

Eve’s friends throw her an awesome Birthday Event! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/SadhkbRl.jpg[/IMG]

For starters, you can check out the exclusive Elsword NA in-game quests and events. KOG Games will also be exhibiting some amazing new Eve character illustrations, prizes and a premier Nasod Queen tribute video that has never been seen anywhere else in the world. 

Check out the video here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h0eycCYdQLM

They will be giving away over a thousand dollars in Eve-Themed prizes and merchandise. 

From In-game K-Ching, life-Size Eve Pillows, Eve USB drives, Elsword 2015 calendars, Eve coffee Mugs, and more, 1163 players will win. You can’t go wrong with Elsword Swag and K-Ching!

Check out all of the sweet prizes:
http://en.elswordonline.com/eves-birthday-sweepstakes/

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/HVf8ZFyl.jpg[/IMG]

But wait! There’s more… For those end-game players who aren’t into cake, how about a Raid unlike anything you’ve ever seen before?  

Drabaki, The Warden of Darkness, is Elsword’s new Raid Boss. Drabaki rends the very ground beneath him as he tears towards our heroes. This is a Raid Boss encounter that allows up to a remarkable 12 players join in to fight Drabaki together! Sounds easy right? On the contrary! You have to bring your “A” game. Though you may take Drabaki on with a party of 12 players, you only have 12 minutes to destroy this gargantuan monstrosity or lose. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/4ljahtSl.jpg[/IMG]

Oh! Did we mention that he was huge? Drabaki’s epic coils, flaming purple poison and tree-sized bladed tail are large enough so that all twelve players are getting hit from all angles; it’s hands-down, the toughest fight in the game.
 
The rewards are epic. Drabaki has a small chance of dropping the very rare Jewel of Drabaki; an awesome +9 Weapon. As well, players who defeat Drabaki will receive a Title with some wicked stats, a Raid Boss Cube with Random prizes, high level crafting items and more.   

Check out the video here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GqtsfjwLbnA

Party down with Eve and the Elsword crew, or declare war against Drabaki, the biggest and baddest Raid Boss in Elsword history. 

The Nasod Queen beckons ~ You better Mechanize!
Play Elsword. Play your Manga.

notes.title: New Raid Boss Dungeon + Eve's B-Day
notes.notes:
Did you think that Eltrion was the worst of your nightmares in Elrios? Well you are dead wrong… From the hometown of Ara, Fahrmann’s Peak, lurks a beast banished from heaven. Drabaki!! A snake-like guardian with a wicked temper. Stack up on those resurrection stones…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/HVf8ZFyl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Drabaki’s Origins[/b]
Drabaki is a snake who was banned from heaven and possesses the ability to return. Legends say that the snake will turn into a serpent and finally will return to heaven as a dragon with a special gem it holds in its mouth.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/4ljahtSl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Fahrmann’s Peak Raid Boss[/b]
The Gate of Time opens a new door to a brand new Guardian who dares you to challenge what lies beyond it. You and 12 of your fellow Elpeeps have 12 minutes to defeat Drabaki or you will lose.

Drabaki presents newer challenges for players. Eltrion is more stationary and gives more clear indicators of where he will attack. On the other hand Drabaki’s snake like body is harder to avoid as it covers most of the map, however, with a little experience his moves become easier to track and predict.

In additional to knocking players out Drabaki dishes out some pretty powerful attacks including a giant black hole that sucks players in. Gewd luck…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/RALHxFBl.jpg[/IMG]
 
[b]Item Mall Goodies: Salvatore Solace Elesis! [/b]
Elesis finally catches up in the brand new Ice Burner Costume for Salvatore Solace. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/9BpvFWpl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Eve’s Birthday Party Bash Continues[/b]
The party goes on! We have so much to cover in honor of Eve’s 3rd Birthday on Elsword! (Okay so technically she’s thousands of years old) but she’s 3 in-game hee hee~  Take on some Birthday quests and you will be able to craft your own special Eve Crown. Cute huh?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/HNipm3kl.jpg[/IMG]

Outside of the game join our 10,000 Likes Event. Tell your friends about the Birthday happenings and ask them to enter as well. We’re revealing never before seen exclusive artwork of Eve and her party celebration!! Plus we’re giving out these exclusive limited edition Eve Birthday Mugs and otns of K-Ching!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cSXLoO0l.jpg[/IMG]

Enter right here: 
https://www.facebook.com/Elsword/app_137541772984354

notes.title: New Teddy Bear Dungeon + Goodies
notes.notes:
[b]Luriel’s Nightmare Event Dungeon[/b]
Ariel has recovered from her nightmare episode, but unfortunately, poor Luriel’s now the one having bad dreams! Having been the source of Luriel’s teddy-bear-turned-evil, Ariel tries to rescue her from the nightmare and needs your help. Find your way into the event dungeon to beat the wicked teddy bear named Slow.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/lOsyufKl.jpg[/IMG]

Even looking all mad and dangerous, Slow still kinda looks like all he needs is a hug—a giant one, no less. But that’s no reason to go gentle on the monster, especially because you’ve got to defeat him to get those Nightmare Marbles, for which the NPC Ted will trade you some useful items. You can also receive Slow’s Treasure Chest as a dungeon reward!

[b]Slow’s Vision Weapon[/b]
Spend 30 minutes in-game to receive a free and oddly cuddly weapon. When you’ve gathered enough Nightmare Marbles, you can upgrade it to have stat effects!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/CFD2qfdl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Item Mall Goodies: Assemble Your Own Band of Bears![/b]
Come on, let’s all dress up as teddy bears! Are you ready for all this adorableness? It’s a Teddy Bear party: costume suits, accessories, pets, and last but definitely not the least, Teddy Bear mounts! These mounts will not be available thru Fossil Readers, so be sure to grab them from the Item Mall while you still can! I’m sooo looking forward to being carried by a teddy for once and not the other way around. :D

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/rLG09Rgl.jpg[/IMG]


[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/sMss1VSl.jpg[/IMG]

What’s more, a new costume theme will be introduced tomorrow—it’s the dark and lavish Goth Loli. Look how gorgeous, and how Eve’s face is a little different—all charming, colorful, and mysterious at the same time. And see, even if you choose this for Eve over all the teddy bear goodies, you’d still have toy bears for drones. Can’t escape them! Get the set, ‘kay? 

 [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/FkfiNpnl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]More Happenings: Countdown to Eve’s Birthday[/b]
Speaking of Eve, we’ll be celebrating her birthday soon! Can you believe it’ll soon be 3 years since the Nasod Queen first graced us with her presence? So let’s make her proud—play as early as tomorrow for your part in the preparations and receive some advanced party favors. We’re also cooking up a fun community event!

See you all in-game tomorrow!

notes.title: Get Whimsical with New Costumes
notes.notes:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! How was your Halloween? This year’s traditional candy-and-costume affair may be over, but the cosplaying just goes on and on in Elsword. Besides, we have a few more outfits to present before the year ends. This week, our newer El explorers catch up with some beloved costume themes. Have a look!

[b]Grace Fairy for Elesis[/b]

We love it when Elesis puts on something dainty and colorful. Forget the notion that she’s a rough-and-tumble kind of knight—this young lady sure can rock it! Grace Fairy pieces will be available through Elesis’ Ice Burner.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/X8UcJ0ul.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Add, Ara, and Elesis join ‘Elsword in Wonderland’[/b]

Dress up for a place where it’s always tea-time and there’s plenty of room at the table. Try on Add’s King of Hearts, Ara’s Card Soldier, and Elesis’ Dormouse costumes.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/JOuEzQcl.jpg[/IMG]

Find all these at the Item Mall after midnight!

notes.title: Play as Mastermind - Add's New Class
notes.notes:
Who needs muscles when you can make others fight for you!? Especially if they are Dynamo drones. It’s mind over body and wits before hits with Arc Tracer’s new 2nd job class Mastermind!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/grr4QCp.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]

As Add’s enemies grow stronger in battle so does his concern for his Dynamos ability to keep up. In Add’s eyes the Dynamo’s capabilities should be able to function more like the android Nasod drones. After searching the Altera Core and Feita, he finds just the instrument he needs to expand and fully control his weaponry.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/wffyiPfl.jpg[/IMG]

With his new invention found in the battlefields of Fieta he creates his tech known as the Mastermind. With this, the weapon moves as an AI according the commands of its owner.

[b]Mastermind’s Features[/b]

One of the most attractive features of Add’s new class is his full usage of the Dynamo Factory, with 4 modes. Each custom Dynamo creating huge amounts of damage… especially Shooting Chaser. A skill so horrible and devastating every other PvP player you are up against will be throwing their keyboards at their screen. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/mg8XfxUl.jpg[/IMG]

Add also receives 10 MP each time when switching modes which can be quite advantageous for PvP players. Maybe Add’s new class should be called EVIL Mastermind… Because that’s truly diabolical.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/oLFSbsol.jpg[/IMG]

Have you even been hit in the face by a rubix cube? This hurts a lot more… Continue Mastermind’s reign of destruction with Apocalypse. Much like Code Empress’ Ferdinand, this is a summoned AI that attacks opponents for you. What makes his skill even crazier are its homing attacks so you cannot outrun it.

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]

Brand new IB set Dark Shadow plus Add gets his new Arc Devil costume.
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/fmkpn3H.jpg[/IMG]

The reaper pet will be arriving tomorrow only a few days before Halloween!
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/pNwYJpH.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Enter Ariel’s Nightmare – Halloween Dungeon
notes.notes:
Halloween horror escalates! Locating Erilot was just the beginning, Elpeeps. Soon you must face the terrifying troublemaker in the event dungeon, Ariel’s Nightmare! Find out what’s been scaring Ariel sleepless in there…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/huPwKnXl.jpg[/IMG]

First, you’ll have to fight some ghostly guards, which seems pretty easy if you can defeat them fast enough. But once they’re defeated, the nightmare warps you into another beast to face mimics of some very familiar adventurers. Awooooo…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/IgzARi3l.jpg[/IMG]

Finally, face the creature responsible for Ariel’s troubles. The nightmare ends if you defeat the right one.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/CdbTgg1l.jpg[/IMG]

Along with this Halloween dungeon, the limited edition costumes from Halloween Monster’s Souls return, and the pieces for Ara, Elesis, and Add are in! You can earn a Halloween Monster’s Soul by conquering Ariel’s Nightmare. For those who are not familiar with it, the Halloween Monster’s Soul works much like Ice Burners—it gives out a random prize from a list of useful items and featured costume pieces. Start collecting the costumes early tomorrow!

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]
While the Halloween dungeon reward item randomly gives out a piece of any character’s Halloween costume, the Shiny Halloween Monster’s Soul from the Item Mall may turn out Halloween costume pieces for just the character you’re currently playing. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/J2y8uB8l.jpg[/IMG]

For a limited time, you’ll also find a new edition of Ara’s Ice Burner in the Item Mall. Nine Tails will soon steal the spotlight decked in the magnificent Salvatore Solace outfit. Collect the set!

Get in as soon as tonight’s patch kicks in!

notes.title: New Class Path: Add Arc Tracer Arrives!
notes.notes:
Here he is... Add’s highly anticipated Arc Tracer Class! The wait ends NAO!  Time to crank up the gears because Add totally geeks out by building his own drones to do is dirty work!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/0vCi4hrl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]

Add is getting tired… in order for him to return to the past he requires a great amount of El Energy and gathering the resources himself is proving to be a real chore. Add decides to alleviate this by programming his Dynamos into energy gatherers. With drones becoming more intelligent they can gather el energy and assist him in battle.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/sMzlLLxl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Arc Tracer’s Features[/b]

Arc Tracer specializes in long range combat and specifically with targeting.  A core skill to use is Drone Activator. Once in use will fire a plasma missile at a target but it will also leave a marker. Launching Rushing Drones or Magnetron will have these drones seek out the target. Arc Tracer’s path enables you to use the Dynamo Factory… but you’ll get stronger use out of it in the next advancement.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/qPjghM2l.jpg[/IMG]

Want to put a little more PIZZZAZZZ in your attacks?! Arc Tracer’s special actives are powerful especially if you wanna wipe out mobs quick.  Add summons 2 tracking drones that will seek out enemies even from a great distance.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/SnqRTmDl.jpg[/IMG]

And if you are looking spam high power laser blasts… look no further. Just point at your target and they are just a blast away from death with Panzer Buster.

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]

What’s this…? Red Dragon Jackpot Cube?! 

Everyone gets to wear Red Dragon accessories for a day! Log in once during the event with your Lv. 10+ character and stay in game for 10 minutes to receive a Red Dragon Accessory Full Set (1day).

Get up to 100 Ice Burners and the material to craft your own Red Dragon Accessories!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/dI4Klqil.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Masters of the Arena - PvP Character Balancing
notes.notes:
It’s here Elpeeps! Become a Master of the Arena in PvP Season 3. This update is pretty darn huge with a massive overhaul of all classes and characters can easily fill a college textbook! But we will give you the main gist with some visual examples from a few of the characters!!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/l92u7Fel.jpg[/IMG]

But for all the nitty gritty details check out the microsite: 
http://en.elswordonline.com/masters-of-the-arena/

[b]Full Character Balancing [/b]
To help improve gameplay experience all characters will receive improvement in all aspects of combat, which can be broken down into 3 sections (Combos, Actives and Special Actives). Of course there is so much more to this update as you all will see.

[b]Improvements to Combos[/b]
Comboing can be tricky but with S3 improvements you’ll see that combo changes become easier to perform and more useful. Interlinking combos becomes more streamlined. For example, Raven’s Reckless Fist combo (>>^ZXX) doesn’t launch enemies into the air but shoves them back a little which makes continue a second combo sequence that much easier to perform.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/U3Y7Uqcl.jpg[/IMG]

And for more visual aesthetics, Aisha’s Void Princess loveable bat Angkor makes an appearance in her (>ZXX) which also gives you an added Dark Ball at the final X making it easier to Catch opponents.

[b]Improvements to Actives[/b]
Actives become multifunctional and versatile. For example, Siege’s missiles pierces once but it’s possible to hit the same enemy twice for double damage. It has increased range and damage over the old Siege Shelling and has all of the properties of a projectile like not needing to be in range of a target to fire off shots.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/PiuzG7wl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Special Actives[/b]
There are quite a few special actives that receive improvements. But I would like to cover one purely based on favoritism and that is Code Empress. Oberon and Ophelia are Eve’s servants and she summons them in her actives and special actives. Once you summon they attack and leave. This time they stick around longer when performing Surface Cutting and Electronic Field and will fight for their beloved queen for over 10 seconds.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/FxvQleFl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

This week’s ItemMall Update is pretty awesome… New costumes, new mounts and new accessories! Track down evil doers in style with the new Devil Hunter Costumes. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/12xkuDol.jpg[/IMG]

Our newest mount is the Sacred Fox Mount! It looks especially great for Ara. Flame attacks and foxiness is freakin’ awesome.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/VCBMkEfl.jpg[/IMG]

Be a spectacle in these fabulous spectacles!! Stay nerdy with new eyewear.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/k6Di7cYl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Eve and Aisha: Core Release and Memorize Systems
notes.notes:
This week’s update comes with 2 new exciting systems for Eve and Aisha. All of the characters of Elsword Online have unique systems for attacks and skills, some of which are activated in Awakening Mode. Now finally Eve and Aisha can benefit from these systems as well!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/TxpZOE7l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Eve’s Core Release[/b]

The Queen of Nasods powers up with Core Release. Eve’s Core is activated in Awakening Mode. (The more beads the higher the level of the core). This will be indicated by the color change from blue to red. The Core can be charged up by performing hits and combos for more powerful attacks.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ekC6ITcl.jpg[/IMG]

The core defends Eve with Core’s Shield when enemies attempt to hit her while inactive. This decreases damage by 75%. When the shield is up, hitting X or Z will cause her to teleport backwards.

The core also attacks with Core’s Laser. This activates with certain actives/special active skills (but only is released if you hit your opponent. The Core’s Laser is strongest when in Awakened Level 3, dealing splash damage on mobs.

Lastly when the core is deactivated the remaining power will be spent towards HP/MP recovery. Pretty cool huh?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/YWJTiOBl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Aisha’s Memorize System[/b]

Put those memorization skills to the test. Our adorable little magician’s new system enables her to memorize most of her Actives and Special Actives. Hit the skill you wish to memorize with a maximum of 3.  The default key to use the skill is V.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/e1AElARl.jpg[/IMG]

Saving skills sort of acts like insurance and you can even use the same skill twice in a row (one from memorize and one from the original cooldown). Skills however in Memorize only deal 70% of the total damage. Also since setting the skills already consumes MP, the skills deployed using the memorized slot will not consume the original skill MP cost. 

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]

Elesis gets her newest Ice Burner Set with the Royal Maid! <3

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/JNeh5Rfl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Add’s Newest Job Class – Lunatic Psyker!
notes.notes:
Psychic Tracer is taking it to whole new level of crazy with his new 2nd Job Class and it really packs a punch! Get ready for some epic brawling and fist fighting with Lunatic Psyker!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/eOuUnRql.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]

Add is power hungry, so naturally this drives him to look for other methods of improving his Nasod Armors particularly the type of energy he uses. He come across Adel of Altera village and advises Add that the Altera Core is a good example of how a large amount of energy is stored. Add upgrades his Dynamos but unfortunately they require a stronger power source. Again with guidance from Adel Add ventures to Fieta where a battle with demons took place leaving a negative source of energy. With assistance from Lento, Add convert’s the dark energy into Moon Stone, which gives him the power source he sought and finally perfects his Nasod Armor.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/hT93gV7l.jpg[/IMG]

Add’s notoriety dubbed him the name Lunatic Psyker, a harbinger of destruction that destroys all in his path.

[b]Specialties and Features[/b]

Like Psychic Tracer, Lunatic Psyker relies heavily on the Dynamo Point System, Add’s Awakening Mode. Once activated players can unlock extra combo moves that toss enemies in midair and throws them. However, in LP’s case you can punch enemies up to 20 times! In addition his other combo enables you to punch enemies back and forth 6 times which can be especially useful for mobs.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/U1Z9knkl.jpg[/IMG]

Also LP is great for bringing enemies towards him. Some of his Special Actives drags enemies enabling Add to finish them with a final blow. One such move is Dooms Day, LP’s Hyperactive Skill. With electrical pillars created by his Dynamos, Add sucks enemies into a swirling tornado and annihilates them!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/aKtcAi3l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]New ItemMall Goodies[/b]

There a few new things from the ItemMall for your Add! First, Add is getting his new Ice Burner for Arch Angel! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/3i5y3vkl.jpg[/IMG]

Plus check out the new Pirate Set for Ara, Elesis and Add. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/3i57Bo1l.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Rena's New Attack System - Nature's Force!
notes.notes:
Hi, Elpeeps! It’s almost here—Rena’s new attack system—and it’s about to change her game. It’s our adored elven ranger’s turn to get her own special power gauge. Woot! Nature’s Force is the new way for her to deal jaw-dropping damage by consistently using her basic attacks and skills. Here’s a short list of the basics. All who play as Rena get this new system by default, so pay attention!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/J0e10k4l.jpg[/IMG]

> Dealing 6 hits using basic commands charges up 1 unit of the NF gauge, equivalent to 1 orb. 

> Rena can charge up NF for up to 5 orbs.

> A special buff is set off once 3 or more units of NF are filled up. The buff affects movement speed, MP recovery, and damage reduction.

> Certain multiple-hit combos that land squarely on the target will use up an NF orb to release additional damage. How would you like to deal 370% of your average physical and magical attack as additional damage? I’d like that very much, thanks!

> Particular skills of Rena’s will now deal additional damage when they land on the target, using up a set amount of NF in the process. Isn’t it great to have a boost to Rena’s already amazing powers, such as Siege Mode?

> There you have it! Watch out for Nature’s Force after maintenance and start mastering this new system with Rena!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/qUobAXwl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Battle for Ereda Island[/b]
Oh yeah, you get to try out your NF chops in a new location as well! Ereda Island opens up to Lv. 40+ players who have also cleared Altar of Dedication in Feita. Here you must side with either Velder’s Red Knights or Hamel’s Guardian Knights, and get involved in a race for control over some rumored hidden relics (read: loot!). ‘Cause what’s an adventure without a little rivalry between knights?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/6qOS2rol.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Three words: Elesis Ice Burners. Get them tomorrow and start collecting both versions of Diamond Yaksha for our daring damsel! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/nsK6J4Yl.jpg[/IMG]

Plus have a smashing summer with new tennis costumes for Add, Elesis, and Ara!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/2kca8bGl.jpg[/IMG]

Nature’s Force is the new way for her to deal jaw-dropping damage by consistently using her basic attacks and skills. Here’s a short list of the basics. All who play as Rena get this new system by default, so pay attention!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/J0e10k4l.jpg[/IMG]

> Dealing 6 hits using basic commands charges up 1 unit of the NF gauge, equivalent to 1 orb. 

> Rena can charge up NF for up to 5 orbs.

> A special buff is set off once 3 or more units of NF are filled up. The buff affects movement speed, MP recovery, and damage reduction.

> Certain multiple-hit combos that land squarely on the target will use up an NF orb to release additional damage. How would you like to deal 370% of your average physical and magical attack as additional damage? I’d like that very much, thanks!

> Particular skills of Rena’s will now deal additional damage when they land on the target, using up a set amount of NF in the process. Isn’t it great to have a boost to Rena’s already amazing powers, such as Siege Mode?

> There you have it! Watch out for Nature’s Force after maintenance and start mastering this new system with Rena!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/qUobAXwl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Battle for Ereda Island[/b]
Oh yeah, you get to try out your NF chops in a new location as well! Ereda Island opens up to Lv. 40+ players who have also cleared Altar of Dedication in Feita. Here you must side with either Velder’s Red Knights or Hamel’s Guardian Knights, and get involved in a race for control over some rumored hidden relics (read: loot!). ‘Cause what’s an adventure without a little rivalry between knights?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/6qOS2rol.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Three words: Elesis Ice Burners. Get them tomorrow and start collecting both versions of Diamond Yaksha for our daring damsel! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/nsK6J4Yl.jpg[/IMG]

Plus have a smashing summer with new tennis costumes for Add, Elesis, and Ara!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/2kca8bGl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Raid Boss Dungeon - Eltrion!
notes.notes:
Meet Eltrion, the guardian and protector of the City of the Sky. If you are feeling that the toughest bosses in Elsword are no match for you then prepare for a rude awakening. Eltrion is and will be your toughest opponent in-game. You have 12 minutes to defeat him or you lose!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/MujVRD7l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]How Do I Fight Eltrion?[/b]
In order to fight the raid boss you must enter the Gate of Time. This only is open after collectively a certain number of monsters in the fields of Hamel or Sander are defeated. Each Raid Dungeon accommodates a max of 12 people. Of course many rooms will be available to accommodate more players who dare to enter. Flaking out of the dungeon is not the best idea if you decide it’s too much for you… you won’t be able to get back into the Raid Boss Dungeon for 20 min.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/izFhFAFl.jpg[/IMG]

Eltrion loves to spam his lazorz. But if you time yourself correctly and learn to predict his moves, you can avoid dying a lot less! He covers a lot of ground so just be prepared to do quite a bit of dodging and make sure to stock up on res stones. You will need them.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Wfo9cnKl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Rewards for Defeating Eltrion[/b]
Eltrion the Iron Guardian’s Core is a rare find but if you do receive it is a +9 Iron Guardian’s weapon for your character. If you contributed enough damage to the boss you can receive a cube to open up some awesome finds including a +9 Amulet! GASP!

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]

New animal Cosplay Costumes for Ara, Elesis and Add! Add is not amused…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ztRu24Hl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Unleash the Psychic Tracer! – Take Elsword’s Newest Character Add to the Next Level
notes.notes:
Add’s maniacal obsession with Nasod technology has driven him to further his research to the point of absolute brilliance. He succeeds in assembling a Nasod Armor prototype that seamlessly conforms to the wearer’s physique. Though weaponization of his armor is inconsistent, conclusion of a successful test allows Add to engage his enemies on a level never seen before... With nothing more than his mind, Add commands the newfound Nasod Armor to obey every thought, even defying the laws of physics.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Awse6nEl.jpg[/IMG]

With the maddening realization of how close he is to unlocking the secret of the Nasod design weighing heavy upon his mind, Add’s curiosity grows, and he’s inspired to continue towards his path of complete mastery over Nasod Technology.


At level 15, players can choose either to complete the in-game quest or purchase the 1st Job Change Item from the shop to unlock Add’s 1st Job change, Psychic Tracer.  As Psychic Tracer, Add’s attack logic becomes extremely aggressive utilizing the Nasod Armor to extend combinations and unleash electrifying effects to dish out direct damage that is rivaled by none other. If combos aren’t preferred, players can use spells like Pulse Cannon, Quake Buster, Dynamo Configuration - Desolver, Conqueror and many more to obliterate your opponents from a distance.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ojZQScil.jpg[/IMG]
 
The Psychic Tracer’s invention, the sophisticated Nasod Armor can be activated while Dynamo Configuration Mode (DP mode) is on. To use this feature, learn the passive skill called Nasod Armor Mode - Battle Gear. This enables Add to extend his combos with the Nasod Armor commands and skills. It also decreases DP use and enhances Nasod Armor command damage while DP mode is in effect.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/E33yHtUl.jpg[/IMG]

As Psychic Tracer, the best defense is an unforgiving, relentless offense. Take Add to the next level. Play Elsword. Play your Manga.

notes.title: Add’s 1st Job – Psychic Tracer!
notes.notes:
After 1 week of Add’s release we are updating with his anticipated 1st Job Class Path—The Psychic Tracer! (1 week can feel like an eternity, but wipe those tears of anguish because now you’ll be able to advance).

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Awse6nEl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]

Add takes it to the next level with his Nasod Dynamos through his research.  He becomes successful in assembling a Nasod Armor prototype that conforms to the wearer’s physique. Although there are a few kinks that Add needs to work out, he concludes it as a success and continues on his path to improve his Nasod Armors.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/E33yHtUl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Specialties and Features[/b]

Now we can see where the DP Mode System really shines. Psychic Tracer focuses on the usage of his Nasod Armors and in this particular class path he relies heavily on his Dynamo Configuration Mode (DP Mode). While in this mode players can activate a combo extension and enhance certain skills. It also decreases DP usage and enhances Nasod Armor command damage while DP mode is in effect.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ojZQScil.jpg[/IMG]

Moreover, Psychic Tracer’s play style is highly based on beatdowns packed with punches and kicks. Some of his skills include homing attacks as well.

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]

And a few shop goodies to tease for tomorrow’s update! Look the part of a researcher in the new Add Scientist Costume and conjure up the powers of fire and darkness with the new Fire and Dark Hameling!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/tZAQXf5l.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Playable Character - Add!
notes.notes:
Add is the newest ADDition to the Elsword Character lineup! And quite the character indeed… As the Twisted Tracer Add his an odd and eccentric personality. Alright he’s just downright kooky! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cz5nWa1l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]
Add has had a very troubled past. During the war, his family was caught performing forbidden research attempting to create a humanoid Nasod. As a result they were annihilated and Add was sold into slavery. During his escape he fell into an Ancient Library which contained texts containing vast knowledge on the Nasod race. Spending much of his time reading these texts he eventually makes his escape by creating the Nasod Dynamos from spare parts of Nasods. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/erF0dh4l.jpg[/IMG]

But isolation can take its toll and as a result Add became mentally unstable and he develops an obsession for finding Nasod Codes. Add soon discovers that the library’s time distortion had sent him far into the future when the Nasod race had already fallen. He soon learns that a sentient Nasod still exists… Eve… and he begins to stalk her waiting for the right moment. 

[b]Specialties and Weapons[/b]
The core concept of Add’s character is that he takes on the persona or a mad scientist/mechanic and as the builder of the Nasod Dynamos. Dynamos help Add with his movement enabling him to float and cruise all while assisting his ability to channel electrical currents. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/NEKFLxJl.jpg[/IMG]

Add’s movement and combo system is extremely fluid and transitioning from close to long ranged attacks is a snap. Many of his attacks are homing so aiming is not necessary. 

Add always looks like he’s having some much fun killing stuff…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/aZzEN0pl.jpg[/IMG]

We often say that Elsword characters can perform endless combos… but Add really takes the cake on this one. His ZZZZ ^X combo resets the knockdown counter on his opponents. It’s not full proof of course but darn near. There is so much you can do with his base class alone.

[b]Dynamo Point Awakening System[/b]
The one thing that truly sets Add apart from all of the other characters of Elsword is his Dynamo Point System. Add is able to go in out of his awakening mode as much as he pleases as long as his DP gauge is sufficient. Of course DP has a cooldown of 5 seconds. When in DP mode, you immediately harm surrounding targets, and you earn a bead in the DP counter. These beads are used to boost certain skills in DP mode.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/jw2K9bMl.jpg[/IMG]

Damage is increased by 20% in DP Mode. Awakening potions and Party Fever will increase DP but will not force you into Awakening Mode. 

DP mode is more visible in combos when Add advances to other classes and will give him an extra combo extension. (We’ll cover that when the time comes).

[b]Item Mall Goodies[/b]
Style up Add with the new El Officer Ice Burner and Holy Unicorn Set coming in tomorrow’s patch!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/KvPPlerl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Hyperactive Skills!
notes.notes:
[b]The Ultimate Power - New Hyperactive Skills![/b] 

This week we bring you a highly anticipated content update! Hyperactive skills! What are Hyperactives? They are the ultimate skill that you can unlock for you character.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/LVyv87Ql.jpg[/IMG]

[b]How to Obtain Hyperactive Skills[/b]
You must have a level 65 character in-game in order to use the skill. You can visit Glave to begin your quest to earn the skills or you can choose to skip the quest and grab it from the ItemMall.

[b]How to Use Hyperactive Skills[/b]
Each job class on Elsword has a unique Hyperactive skill. In order to utilize Hyperactives you will need El’s Essence. This can be obtained by opening identified El Shards. Each time you activate your Hyperactive skills you consume 1 El’s Essence. 

Not only are they super flashy, they are super destructive! Easily wipe out mobs and do a high amount of damage against Bosses. The cooldown period for Hyperactive skills is 180 seconds but the wait is worth it.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/uvB6rHZl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]

New costumes for the ItemMall! World Cup Soccer Costumes and Elesis is Battle Ready in her new Nasod Battle Suit.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/VIz1tLXl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Incoming! Skill Note System Revamp
notes.notes:
Hi, Elpeeps! How was your 3-day weekend? Hope you didn’t miss out on the exclusive Memorial Day events, but if you did, hey, it’s only Tuesday and we’ve got more in store for you this week!

After maintenance, get in the game to try the enhanced Skill Notes! You know—those valuable bits of skill savvy that let you reinforce or even modify certain skills you already have. Check the Elsword Online website tomorrow to find out more details!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/02OUO6El.jpg[/IMG]

Watch out for these goodies tomorrow!

notes.title: Elesis 2nd Job Classes Arrive!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/FlOUpY4l.jpg[/IMG]

The wait is soon over! Get ready to advance your Pyro and Saber Knights to Elesis’ new 2nd Job Classes. Which path will you choose to take?! Will you be the Dancer of Flames or command the battlefield as the Leader of the Red Knights?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/UHvFnkcl.jpg[/IMG]

And in other big news…. On May 4th we will be celebrating our 3 Year Anniversary of our service to North America! It’s truly been amazing and time seems to just fly by! We’ll have some fun activities planned for this real soon!

[b]Play as the Dancer of Flames – Blazing Heart[/b]

It’s time for Pyro Knight to really hone in on her fire conjuring skills! Elesis continues her search for the demon scar. Elesis begins to struggle with her powers despite the use of the gloves Echo provided her. During her adventures she meets Allegro in Fieta in which he discovers fire energy emanating from her heart. Allegro tells Elesis that a legendary warrior once controlled the element of fire at will. With Allegro’s assistance Elesis eventually learns to control her flames freely and becomes the Blazing Heart just as the warrior of the legend.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/7ILtBaHl.jpg[/IMG]

As the Blazing Heart you perfect your skills as the ultimate flame warrior. Time to set everything on fire!! Heart is her ability to perform endless combos. While running alternate pressing X and Z Elesis will shoot out flames while jumping over enemies.

Many of her moves do quite a bit of damage to mobs and have heat sinking abilities. For the lazier pyro maniacs, Blazing Wing and Blazing Dance works well doing lethal damage and auto targeting enemies. In addition to these skills, you can even conjure flaming swords and fire walls. Super fun!

[b]Play as the Leader of the Red Knights[/b]

Beautiful, lethal and awe inspiring are just a few words to describe this breathtaking class. Elesis becomes the ultimate commander of the Velder Red Knights. During her pursuit of Scar she hears of Fieta being attacked by the demon invasion which prompts her to prepare for battle. With no clear winner of the war she realizes she cannot fight alone and she builds an army of Fieta and Velder Knights. With a loyal army she becomes the Grand Master, a decorated warrior and defeater of demons.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/uO83sOBl.jpg[/IMG]
As the Grand Master you continue to refine your skills with the Claymore. Best move ever… THE JUGGENAUT BUSTER!! Spin and twirl destroying all enemies in your path!! All of Grand Master’s fire strikes are precise and refined!

…and as a commander of the battlefield you can strengthen yourself and your party with War Prelude all while damaging surrounding enemies.  

[b]ItemMall Goodies[/b]

Elsword’s biggest nemesis Berthe becomes your cute new companion… D’aww! Berthe’s demon raiding days are over…Nope this little guy won’t be trampling you or RAWRing at your 250 MP Skills in the Alter of Dedication anymore. Plus new Arch Angel Ice Burner Costume set!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/KmmaYgyl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Hamel Secret Dungeon + Revamps
notes.notes:
New Hamel Secret Dungeon

The Young Guardian Prince of Hamel, Chung, at long last is reunited with his fallen father. Unfortunately it is not a happy one. Helputt, the once noble leader of the Seiker Clan and protector of Hamel has been corrupted by the demons that imprison him. With knowledge of how to purify Dark El, for unknown reasons Helputt went missing only to be found in the Temple of Trials. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/OZtrdDxl.jpg[/IMG]

Temple of Trials – New Secret Dungeon

Venture into the Temple of Trials! A fitting name for a very long and challenging dungeon… ;-) In this dungeon you will confront Helputt in his corrupted form and battle 3 Guardian Bosses… Guardian Knight, Guardian Magician and some familiar faces… shadow versions of the ElGang! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/eBbmNqFl.jpg[/IMG]

Each time you defeat these bosses you will earn special buffs making your run through the Temple of Trials easier. In addition to buffs the Water Priestess will bless you to reduce the damage you receive from enemies.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/SKjjan4l.jpg[/IMG]

Secret Dungeon Revamps

We didn’t forget about the others! With 4 Secret Dungeons out already it’s time for an update! Secret Dungeons equipment will probably become one of the most sought after gear in-game. Level requirements for Secret Dungeons can only be entered by those who are level 60 -70. New monsters have been added with higher HP as well.

One Bethbite Conquers all! Bethbites have finally been made into one kind and they can even be earned though quests! Luto’s Secret key will now replace all tickets to secret dungeons as well. Yay for streamlining!

New ItemMall Goodies

It’s Spring time and you can look the part while attending school in the new Spring Star Academy Costume! I seriously want to hit Chung so hard because he looks so darn cute in the Easter Bunny Costume! This is an all-in-one suit. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Uo1xZ7ll.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Elesis 1st Job Classes Arrive – Pyro and Saber Knight
notes.notes:
To slash or to burn? That is the question… and it really depends on your style of play! Race your Elesis to level 15 and complete the job change quest to become a Pyro or Saber Knight.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/axsSTaFl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Pyro Knight – The Path of Fire[/b]
She’s red hot and can’t be stopped!! The Pyro Knight path focus on the power of conjuring fire and channeling it through her sword. She specializes in close to mid-range combat, however, her fireball combos give her a surprising amount range. Plus she strikes a good balance between greater physical and magical attack powers.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/zlcHoqIl.jpg[/IMG]

Another good note is Pyro Knight’s various AoE skills. It’s incredibly effective when trying to eliminate mobs…and Eternal Fire is just plain awesome…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/1Ffw7jIl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Saber Knight – The Path of the Claymore[/b]
If you’re going for a more elegant class… look no further. Elesis’ Saber Knight is specializes in honing the claymore. As a noble Saber Knight you are more melee oriented and your abilities tilt in favor of high physical attack and defense with a greater amount of HP. You still have fire magic but it’s more refined and controlled.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Sd9ORQll.jpg[/IMG]

Much like Elsword’s notorious Armageddon Blade is the Sword of Victory! Giving you tons of reach against enemies and dealing a great amount of damage.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/m1ZAcUEl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Events for Elesis' First Job Classes[/b]
And as far as the event goes for the New Job Classes, everyone who completes their 1st Job Change during the event is encouraged to take a fighting power assessment test with Allegro. Finish the quests and you could earn special item packages for your Elesis! Including some very useful skill rings. ;-)

Check out the events here: 
http://en.elswordonline.com/2014/04/elesiss-next-step/

[b]New ItemMall Goodies[/b]
More costumes for all you fashionable Elesis players! New Orange-Aid and Lime-Aid Costumes! And if you are looking for something a little more chill and relaxed then grab the new Casual Costume! ;-)

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/AJ3Pkscl.jpg[/IMG]

Gotta love those female character releases! Elesis finally makes her crossover to Elsword Online as the noble Red Knight. For a long time Elesis of Grand Chase has always been speculated to be the sister of Elsword but now it is finally confirmed!! Oh you guys are good…

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/lANTVoGl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]The Story[/b]

After a long absence from training of her own, Elesis returns to Ruben Village bringing her teachings to her little bro Elsword. During a training session Elesis and Elsword come face to face with Scar, Captain of the Demon World, who has come for Elesis’ head. 

Being the fearless knight that she is, she stands her ground and defeats Scar with the help of Elsword. After the demons retreat, Elsword is left wounded.

While Elsword recovers at home, Elesis becomes anxious. Now realizing that the demons are becoming an even bigger threat, she decides to leave again in order to seek them out and protect her brother. While she does not know when, Elesis eagerly awaits the day she can reunite with her little brother.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/IsmHqVBl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Playing as the Red Knight[/b]

Elesis wields the claymore and is the first female melee character of Elsword. In addition to mastering the sword she is fully equipped with fire attacks. You may see some similarities between Elsword and Elesis, but guess who he learned all his moves from?! His big sis of course!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/MYfWM44l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Chivalry System[/b]

Much like Elsword’s Way of the Sword, Elesis has the Chivalry System to maximize her skills. The gauge is filled depending on which type of skills you use. The Chivalry gauge is filled inversely. Using Gale skills consumes Gale points and pulls the gauge toward Annihilation, while using Annihilation skills consumes Annihilation points and moves the gauge toward Gale. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/879BSrzl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Aura of Gales Stats[/b]

- Movement and jump speed increase. 

- A special effect takes place after every 5 hits, which increases awakening charge speed by 5% and MP by 25%. Effect duration lasts 5 seconds.

- Knockdown is reduced by as much as 40% for Gale combos.

- MP consumption of Gale skills is reduced.

- Gale skills cool-down time is reduced by as much as 75%.

[b]Spirit of Annihilation[/b]

- Annihilation skills and combos get 100% critical rate and disregard defensive moves. Knocked-down opponents suffer the skills’ full effects.

- Holding down Z or X allows Elesis to deflect enemies as they attack and go into mana break that consumes the Chivalry gauge instead of MP.

- Combo attack damage is amplified by 1.5x

[b]New at the Item Mall Tomorrow[/b]

With Elesis’s arrival comes with new gear! Two new Ice Burners hit the ItemMall for our Red Knight. Check out the Dragon Knight and El Officer Set for Elesis.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/cZPDWeUl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Character Soon - Return on the Red Knight
notes.notes:
The Red Knight has been away from home for some time, but she’s coming back to Ruben Village very soon. She’s the next playable character in Elsword Online! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/XTSAqVLl.jpg[/IMG]

The Red Knight is agile and skilled at handling a claymore, a heavy, average-sized sword. Oh, she can be quite intense—she channels energy into fire! How well does she fight? Hint: If Elsword’s got the chops from early on, then it’s because of her teachings. What can I say? This gal is a pretty big deal, and her destiny looks like it will be the stuff of legend. I can’t wait to see her in action!  

Get in the game tomorrow and join the countdown to the Red Knight’s arrival! Participate in the run-up events once the game is back up, including the limited opportunity to name your Red Knight early, the chance to call upon the Red Knights Captain in the dungeons, and the exclusive quests to earn loads of swag!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/nve3lmCl.jpg[/IMG]

Along the way, you can be selected to receive a Conkor Mousepad, Cronos Headset, Theron Mouse, or 1,000 K-Ching. Waaaaant! 

Give us ‘em likes and enter here: https://www.facebook.com/Elsword/app_143103275748075

[b]New at the Item Mall Tomorrow[/b]
Why sting like a bee, when you can sting like a ruthless scorpion? Check out the newest mount, which you can purchase straight off for a limited time—no fossil readers needed! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ndttYL2l.jpg[/IMG]

What’s more, blooming new costumes arrive for springtime. Watch out for these at the Item Mall after maintenance! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/oI6YKYyl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Take Back Sander - New Dungeons and Level Cap
notes.notes:
Leveling has never been easier than before! We are introducing a EXP Table Reduction! Excited? We sure are… and just in-time to because as you know, with new dungeons means new levels to cap to. We take you to the final showdown of Sander… the Elgang versus the Succubus Queen Karis!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/zHTgPfcl.jpg[/IMG]


Check out the trailer here: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CNo0lUz_6nU

[b]Sander Part 3 (Two New Dungeons) and Level Cap Raise[/b]
Oh where oh where has the Anudran gone!? The Elgang tirelessly search for Sander’s Priestess of Wind and her captor… the evil and voluptuous Succubus Queen Karis! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/bbgjJKKl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Sandtilus[/b]
Under the control of Karis the giant Behemoth the Ancient Guardian the El has awakened with the Wind Priestess inside. Utilizing the Caluso Tribe’s Wind Powered Ships you must stop the beast from destroying the City. Your mission is the kill the beast with the Air Ship‘s guns. Defeat the Succubus Queen and save the wind priestess.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/JPBrdR7l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Heart of Behemoth[/b]
Once Behemoth is brought down and you have rescued the Wind Priestess Karis escapes. But you wouldn’t let a villain like her off the hook so easily would you?! You must travel inside the bowls of Behemoth (gross huh?) and locate Karis who is hiding in the heart of the beast. There you will face Karis in her true demonic form. Bring her down because you are Sander’s last hope!! Take back Sander!!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/6tKehlYl.jpg[/IMG]

Last but not least, cap it up as you can reach Level 70!!

[b]New Fields to Explore (Sandtilus Grave and Behemoth Crater)[/b]
Visit two new sites in the vast deserts of Sander. Battle the Trocks and demonic foes in these massive fields!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/43fpIfIl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]New ItemMall Stuff (Doctor’s Set)[/b]
The dungeons of Sander are quite challenging and some of you are going to need medical attention after being beaten down by monsters. Dress the part in these new Doctor Costume Sets!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/WPhM527l.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Marriage System ~ Fall in Love with Elsword!
notes.notes:
Hi, Elpeeps! Valentine’s Day is almost here, and boy have we got the game update of the season. For both the loved and lovelorn alike, your dreams of virtual romance are about to come true with the all new Wedding System! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/uudzTNJl.jpg[/IMG]

Many of you have been talking about fantasy match-ups among members of the Elgang—Elsword and Aisha, Rena and Raven, and so on. After tomorrow’s maintenance, you can finally make it happen in-game with a formal ceremony presided by 1 of 3 NPCs, complete with wedding gown and tuxedo, invitations, cake, and bubbly! It’s also a chance for the couple to hold a special ceremony with your friends and even your entire guild in an exclusive in-game venue. Celebrate your love!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/C6zHa13l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Get Paired Up[/b]
So, how do you get married in Elsword? You and another player have to become a couple first (Characters must be opposite genders!). One of you needs to get the Couple Ring from the Item Mall for 500 K-Ching. This lets the bearer ask the player he or she desires to go steady, and once the couple request is accepted, you two are officially an Elsword Online couple. You can check your couple status under a new tab in the Community window.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/5NGCvsxl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Walk Down the Aisle[/b]
Ready to pop the big question? Then go shopping for a Wedding Package at the Item Mall! Choose according to your desired location between Ruben and Sander Wedding Halls. A wedding package includes a Wedding Ring, Wedding Hall item, and invitations. Here’s what you need to do next: 
> Propose marriage 
> Invite guests 
> Wear the 30-day wedding clothes (Check the mail!) 
> Go to the wedding hall with your partner and guests, and get married! 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/F7IY3mjl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Wedding System Rewards![/b]
Unless you already got a special someone you can be coupled with, it may not be so easy to get someone to agree. But once you do get coupled, the rewards and perks are pretty awesome. For instance, how does a weekly reward cube sound? Also, you get a couple’s skill called Extreme Heavenly Love, which recovers HP and MP for both partners. 

And when you get married, you can even share a reward cube and some cake and bubbly consumables with your wedding guests! Then the couple’s skill becomes Lv. 2 and you get even more perks, such as the married couple-exclusive Summoning feature, and Wedding Anniversary Titles you can earn down the road. 

Are you inspired to make your virtual relationship happy ever after? Get hitched in Elsword soon after the update, or at least try it out with the wedding system launch events tomorrow!

[b]Valentine’s Day Event Dungeon[/b]
Helen’s husband is missing, but that does not stop her from making chocolate for him this Valentine’s Day. Help her by making a delivery in the event dungeon, Operation Valentine. Don’t worry—you sure can get your hands on some sweet treats, too. Check it out after the maintenance!

[b]Skill Balance – FREE Full Skill Reset[/b]
A massive skill balance update is also included in this week’s patch. To mark the occasion, everyone gets a full skill reset for FREE! 

Be sure to get back in the game early tomorrow for all these and more! Happy Valentine’s Day!

notes.title: Yama Raja - Unleash Hell with Ara's 2nd Job Class
notes.notes:
[b]Unleash Hell’s Wrath with Yama Raja[/b]

The beautiful Yama Raja, Ara’s new 2nd Job Class, arrives and we are sure many of you have been waiting for what seemed like ages. She’s definitely an eye pleasure but more importantly she’s an extremely fun and versatile class to play as! So let’s hop into this week’s update regarding the Ruler of Hell.

[b]The Story[/b]

Ara is constantly in battle against the demon forces and she believes this is the only way she’s ever going to run into her long lost brother Aren, who is still under the influence of demon power. Adel of Altera is aware of Ara’s weariness and gives her new hope by training her to refine her demonic powers. Shortly after she earns the title of Yama Raja - ruler of the underworld.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/xXf04Sil.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Master of the Rakshasa Arts[/b]

Compared to Little Devil Yama Raja holds more versatility and power when she fires her spirit orbs. At the same time she is able to absorb and steal the souls of her enemies. But one of Yama Raja’s most powerful and flashy combos is the Rakshasa Arts which unlocks a secret move known as Purgatory. Like with Little Devil this is a series of special actives, only this time it’s not activated with a combo.

My suggestion is just to set the first special active on one skill slot and hit it four times. In this respective order the skills activated are Soul Reaping, Energy Burst, Spear Prison and Soul Escape. Purgatory is then activated after this series. Although “expensive” in terms of using energy you do regain it by performing the move on enemies.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/JtWb3jvl.jpg[/IMG]

Besides Purgatory our favorite move would have be Energy Void. Materialize a giant spirit orb sucking your opponents, the longer you hold it the greater the damage… but it will cost you energy. ;-)

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/h1wwcrHl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]New Foxy Pet – Meet Shiho and Naho[/b]
New versions of the 9 Tail Fox Pet will be here! Each of these pets deal up to 200% of your average physical and magical power with foxy nail attack. Fox fireballs heat sink on enemies dealing 550% of your average physical and magical power with a chance to burn with Shiho and aging with Naho.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/W1i1epKl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Ara Little Devil Arrives - Harness the Power of Demons
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/sSki2IGl.jpg[/IMG]

Ara Little Devil Arrives - Harness the Power of Demons

An Elpeep class favorite of Ara is finally here! Ara chooses the path to fight evil with evil so let’s get right down to the details of our newest little heck raiser, Little Devil!

[b]The Story[/b]
Ara is still in the search of her brother Aren and destroying the demonic force within him. Luichel the accessory merchant of Elder village senses Ara’s desperation to achieve this goal. She gives Ara a book of dark magic to utilize the evil powers from within, but she will have to sacrifice the noble abilities she inherited from her clan.

Now Ara embarks on a dangerous path of harnessing the powers of demons in order to find her brother Aren. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/iPDudKVl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Master of the Wolf Arts[/b]
Play style is really switched up with Little Devil. Instead of utilizing your spear you will be firing energy spirit orbs. Quite a few of Little Devil’s Special Attacks require management of Spirit Energy which makes her mix of combos and Special Attacks a new challenge.

Unique to Little Devil is the Wolf Arts. If you have dabbled with Little Hsien’s Dragon Arts then learning the Wolf Arts should be a piece of cake. The Wolf Arts is performed with a basic hooked combo and a sequence of special attack moves activated with Wind Wedge, Wolf Claw and Wolf Fang which releases the Killing Howl Move. ::insert Wolf Howl here::  ;-)

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/oIc6mozl.jpg[/IMG]

No need to overload your skill slots with all of the attacks! (Of course if you want to use them separately I won’t stop you hee hee~) Just place Wind Wedge in your desired slot and tap 3 times after the >>zz or zzz hook combo is completed.

Our favorite move would have to be Infernal Circle. Fun to spam and very flashy.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/qc3xHU6l.jpg[/IMG]

[b]New Patissier Costumes[/b]
Have a sweet tooth and into confectioneries! You’re in luck, we have these super cute costumes now available in the ItemMall!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/2OyPIJsl.jpg[/IMG]
