notes.title: A Little Pre-Event - Ara's New Job Class Path
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/c91PsvIl.jpg[/IMG]

Hope you had a good MLK Day! It’s countdown time once more, because we are just about one week away from the arrival of Ara Haan’s 1st Job in a new class path. Let us give you a little introduction to what will become of our young, svelte warrior.

In the new class path, Ara chooses the ominous way, perhaps lit only by the fires of hell. However, instead of turning completely evil, she uses the demonic powers to defeat the demons themselves. Talk about giving the vile creatures a taste of their own medicine…

[b]A New Secret Skill to Learn[/b]
Just like Little Hsien and Sakra Devanam, the upcoming class path will have the capability to learn an amazing secret skill. Keep an eye out for the skills of the Wolf Fang Arts—the base character Ara can already get the one called Wind Wedge. When the time comes, learn them all to unlock the special move! 

[b]Heretic Phoru’s Challenge[/b]
Join the pre-launch events tomorrow! Find the Heretic Phoru and defeat him to earn useful items, whether you’re playing as Ara or another member of the Elgang. Find out how you can get free special consumables, an EXP Boost Medal, El Tree Seeds, and high-grade magic stones!

[b]A New Eastern-Inspired Costume for Ara[/b]
The sweet, petite Ara looks smashing in the Oriental costumes. They go on sale tomorrow!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/WlYiByYl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Mount System and Level Cap Increase
notes.notes:
As some of you may know we have some exciting things coming up in this week’s patch! Sander Dungeons Part 2 arrives plus new to Elsword, the MOUNT System!

[b]Sander Part 2 (Two New Dungeons) and Level Cap Increase[/b]

The Elgang still has yet to retrieve the Wind Priestess and the pursuit still continues! You’ll find that many of the villages in Sander have become corrupted. 

Making your way down Trock’s Lair and Caluso Tribal Village you will run into the dungeon bosses or the village chieftains. When defeating them, each will provide valuable insight on the whereabouts of the Wind Priestess.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/xmUcGrBl.jpg[/IMG]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/O2B1sbql.jpg[/IMG]

Plus Level Up your character’s to the highest cap thus far LEVEL 67!!

[b]Mount Up with the Mount System[/b]

New to Elsword are mounts! These bad boys aren’t just for Cruising with Style! They attack as well. We’re introducing 3 along with the system to help you tear through dungeons and fields. 

[b]Some Basic Benefits of Mounts[/b]
> Move 25% faster when aboard a mount.
> Experience boosts in physical and magical defense, elemental resistance, and HP recovery.
> Each mount has Special Stats and attacks that does different amounts of damage.

[b]How to Get a Mount[/b]
In order to obtain mounts you will have to utilize Fossil Readers (much like the Ice Burners). HOWEVER, for a limited time you can skip all of that and grab exactly which one you want from the ItemMall until January 21st!! So take advantage of this!!

[b]I WANT ONE FOR FREE!![/b]

In our Ride Like a Pro Event you have the opportunity to ride the mounts and get some much needed practice! Login on 1/18 can get to ride all three! Become a pro rider by completing quests and you get a mount of your choice for 15 days!

…and with any sweet ride you are going to want to know the stats! So here they are!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/DOiAjE5l.jpg[/IMG]
[b]Moby Chariot RT[/b]
•	Attacks: Ground and Midair Charge
•	(Up to 500% of Average Physical + Magical Attack Power)
•	Special Attack: Muti-Missiles (300% from Explosion)
•	Buffs: Iron Body and Power Booster

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/OUPBCI4l.jpg[/IMG]
[b]Cockatigle[/b]
•	Attacks: Beak Jabs, Laser Beams, and Tail Whips 
•	(Up to 336% of Average Physical + Magical Attack Power)
•	Special Attack: Flint Energy Bolt (261%) 
•	Buffs: Superior Breed and Strong Legs

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/Yx5nBQDl.jpg[/IMG]
[b]Ancient Phoru[/b]
•	Attacks: Fireballs and Explosions 
•	(Up to 400% of Average Physical + Magical Attack Power)
•	Special Attack: Mega Flame Breath (506%)
•	Buffs: New Evolution and Mysterious Dash

notes.title: Ara's New Second Job Class - Sakra Devanam
notes.notes:
The Punisher of Shadows: Sakra Devanam

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/EDT3ldNl.jpg[/IMG]

It’s almost 2014 Elpeeps and during this New Year’s we’re bringing you an exciting and much anticipated content update for Ara Haan lovers! Enter the Punisher of Shadows – Sakra Devanam, Ara’s new 2nd Job Class.

The Story

Ara throughout her experience through battle soon realizes that even the most kindred of hearts can be easily corrupted by the powers of the Dark El. A prime example of this is her Brother Aren (Ran) who she continues to look for.

During her journey in Fieta, Ara becomes the Punisher of Shadows, meaning she lays judgment (and a can of whoop tush) on the demon forces, thus bringing justice to Elrios. Witnessing the efforts of Ara’s strength, the spiritual nine-tail fox Eun proclaims her the new title of Sakra Devanam—‘the legendary god that ruled the heavens’- and granting her heavenly powers to boot.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/vrXAWT6l.jpg[/IMG]

Master of the Tiger Arts – SD’s New Moves

Benefits! So becoming Sakra Devanam has some major improvements that Little Hsien does not have. My favorite… The Tiger Arts… Rawr… which is much easier to perform than the Dragon Art Combo. All you have to do is press about 4 special attacks in sequential order.

Suggestion! It gets even easier… Put the first skill (Rock Smash) in one of you SP slots and hit it four times… Done. You learned quickly young grasshopper, for you have mastered the Tiger Arts.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/NzGKjy9l.jpg[/IMG]

More perks? Yes there is. Another favorite of ours… Auto block attacks with Quicken Guard. But don’t fritter your SP points as we have… ;-)

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/TDTTg3Pl.jpg[/IMG]

ItemMall Goodies

And after partying hard on New Year’s you’re going to have to crash out… And why not do it in style? New Pajama Costumes arrive in the ItemMall. Sleep Tight Elpeeps! Plus bronies can enjoy this new accessory from an event!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/p6UoPMwl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: New Character Ara Haan Arrives!
notes.notes:
Howdy Elpeeps,

Finally after much anticipation from our players Ara Haan our newest character to arrive is here. 

[b]The Story[/b]
Who is Ara?! For such an adorable and optimistic gal life hasn't been too kind to her. Ara is the daughter of a respected warrior family that has guarded the spirit of the Nail Tail Fox. Her hometown is located in the northern Fluone continent. If you guys are familiar with Ran from Hamel’s Halls of Water you will realize that he is actually her older brother, Aren Haan. Unfortunately he was corrupted by Dark El and was transformed into Ran who led an army of demons back to their village and slayed anyone in it including her family. 

When all hope was lost our little hero finds a hairpin with the Nine Tail Fox’s spirit, Eun, inside which helped saved her life and vanquished the demons. Together with Eun, Ara must find the missing El to set Eun free and locate her brother.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/MzWRnGWl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Ara’s New Features[/b]
Ara is a marital artist who specializes in the spear. She performs an array of long range attacks that are lightning fast. If you guys are a fan of “Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon” you will find this class quite fun to play as. Ara defies gravity by walking on Air which make gaps in dungeons a piece of cake. NO MOAR FALLING IN THE UNDERGROUND GARDEN!!

Ran out of MP? It’s NP~ You can utilize Spirit Energy Skills instead of MP moves. Plus Ara’s new awakening mode is awesome! She transforms herself into Eun. *o*  Gasp!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/uOBnWqgl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Ara’s 1st Job Class – Little Hsien[/b]
Ara realizes that in order to find her older bro she’s going to need to get stronger. In this class you will find that she learns a new technique called the Secret Dragon Arts. Timing is everything with this move… and it’s a challenge to master. But after good practice it becomes muscle memory. By performing a series of Special Actives a new a secret move is performed. Ara launches herself into the air and pounds the crap out of enemies into oblivion. Good stuff!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/zgR6Gbbl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]ItemMall Updates[/b]
And to get in the Christmas Spirit with this cute Captain Rudolph Costume Suit and Ara’s Christmas Costume. So many more updates for the ItemMall but you will have to wait until tomorrow to see them.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/nHAL14al.jpg[/IMG]

~Cuddles :-DDD

notes.title: 9 Tails and 9 Days Left Until a New Hero Arrives!!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/VfS4VKzl.jpg[/IMG]

What Does the 9-Tailed Fox Say?

Not like with the ordinary fox, you’ll find out for yourself the answer to this puzzler real soon, as well as what the magical being looks like or does in battle. We are just a few days away from the arrival of a new character in Elsword Online. The countdown begins!

The force of one nine-tailed fox named Eun manifests through a young lady who, at a time of danger, found the hairpin where the spirit resides. The 17-year-old girl may look innocent, but wait ‘til you see her skill with the spear! Her abilities are balanced between ranged and close-quarter combat, while the spirit of Eun shows when she’s in awakening. Swiftness and the ability to use spirit energy are her gifts.

Are you excited as we are?! Check out the Elsword website to learn more about her and join the countdown by participating in pre-launch events after midnight!

[b]9 Tails and 9 Days Left[/b]

Show your support for 9 Tails by joining our Facebook Likes event. Reach the Likes goal by 12/18 and all who joined will receive a one-day 50% EXP Boost Medal! That would help you so much when you start playing the new character… ;) 

Enter here: https://www.facebook.com/Elsword/app_112813808737465

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/nk7HoFxl.jpg[/IMG]


[b]Tails Aplenty Starting Midnight[/b]

In anticipation of 9 Tails, you will be able to purchase these 3 tails bundled for just 1000 K-Ching!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/RR8WT0dl.jpg[/IMG]

Also, in one of the quests, Ariel will reward you with a nine-tail accessory if you bring her what she asks. See Eve looking all glamorous with it. You like?

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/SpcM0y7l.jpg[/IMG]

After midnight, the Christmas Party Santa Hat accessory becomes available by itself in the Item Mall, and so will the new Christmas Knit Beanie. But right now, you can already grab the exclusive bundle of 2 fully evolved pets, Snowman and Arctic Hunter Peng! Aren’t they adorable?! Get them!

notes.title: A New Hell Unleashed - Gate of Darkness Dungeon
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/xPSaCqrl.jpg[/IMG]

Do you have any idea what brand new hell is coming to Elsword Online tomorrow?! That’s right—a new and more challenging Gate of Darkness arrives! Here are 7 things you must know:

New goal: Defend and destroy. You must destroy evil’s gate while protecting your allies’ portal from the waves of enemies.

Different entry. The only way to get into GoD is to defeat a boss in a regular dungeon or secret dungeon in Feita, Velder, Hamel, or Sander. You don’t get a chance to go every time, so always be prepared for when it happens!

Fresh horde of baddies. You’ll face a lot of them here, including giant ones, and there seems to be no end to the horror.

Allies take your side. Fortunately, you can have up to 3 giant monsters fighting for you, one at a time.

NPCs fill in. It’s okay if your friends can’t go with you to GoD, because Lowe, Lime, and Penensio will come to your aid and round out your party of 4.

Monsters for your quick slots. Your existing consumables are rendered useless here, but instead, you can choose from 3 friendly monsters to summon every 15 seconds and a potion you can use once every 60 seconds. If you equip a certain accessory, the potion is changed into an ally monster, too.

Enhanced rewards. Special drops, consumables, Wyvern’s and Ancient Wyvern’s accessories will have changed a little, but still exclusive to GoD, and still pretty awesome.

Moreover, event quests and crafting activities will be up to give you a taste of the awesome GoD swag. I can tell it’s going to be gruesome and loads of fun, so rest up tonight for a fresh start on dungeon runs tomorrow!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/52lHe8hl.jpg[/IMG]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/yGyL3fWl.jpg[/IMG]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/szXDJerl.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Holiday Party Outfits[/b]
Your new Christmas Party costumes arrive tomorrow! The package even includes a cute little Santa Hat. Check them out at the Item Mall.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/1yyS298l.jpg[/IMG]

notes.notes:
Hey there, Elpeeps! We are about to enter the final week of the Halloween main event. Don’t forget to play the Halloween Banquet Room on October 31st to face Pumpvalanche! This is the one day you get to keep playing until you’ve earned a boss accessory, so bring all your pumpkin-stopping combo moves! notes.title: Elsword Item Revamp!!
notes.notes:
Hi-ya, Elpeeps! Enjoying the Halloween preparations so far? We’re looking at a pretty important game update arriving in less than 24 hours. You can expect the way you handle items to reeeally change when it kicks in. Here are some Item Revamp highlights.

Switch from Old to New

After this update, wearable items found in cubes and drops, and crafted in equipment shops get a makeover. Those armor items limited to certain characters or job classes will instead become usable to all; meanwhile, weapon items’ class limit will be dropped. Imagine—the one set of your favorite equipment may be usable to multiple characters on your account (if bank sharing is enabled, of course). Isn’t it cool?!

Also, the affected items you already own will now be tagged old, and those items can be exchanged for their new versions through Ariel for a limited time. Of course, there’s a way to get rewarded for doing this, too. ;) Don’t forget to check the events!

Don’t be shy. Identify!

Any new wearable item you acquire will likely be unidentified. What does this mean? Well, only that its additional effects are not assigned yet, and you will need to identify it for a certain cost in ED to be able to use it. The assignment of additional effects is randomized. I find it pretty exciting, especially because there’s a way to revert back to the unidentified state and try again for better stats. Check out the events on how to earn Luriel’s Blessed Time & Space Scrolls just by hanging out in-game and completing quests.

+11 Enhancement Event

A rare opportunity to have the toughest weapon and armor yet. Ready your favorite set!

The Sprite of Halloween…

…is alive and flying! New cute pet alert! Say hi to the Halloween Pumpkin Fairies.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/UgmKw21l.jpg[/IMG]

There’s also a potion that can make one of them appear in place of your current pet, but the creature must love you so for it to take effect. Halloween’s suddenly not so scary—it’s even taking a pretty magical turn. ;)

Watch out for these and more, including some very special Item Revamp Promo Packages. Have fun playing Elsword!!

notes.title: Halloween Dress Up Party!!
notes.notes:
Halloween is coming to Elrios and this month will not disappoint. In this week’s patch we bring you a poop load of events!! Are you player who would rather make their costume rather than just grab one from the shop?! You’re in luck. If you are a Halloween Fashion Designer you can earn an in-game title just for logging in-game! ;-)

Plus you can craft your very own costume in-game by completing a couple of quests. Of course Halloween would be nothing without a few new costumes…

Topping it off with cuteness with Rena’s adorable bat hat!

notes.title: Turn It Up with Tactical Trooper!
notes.notes:
We are now approaching the finale of Elsword Online’s Transformation Evolution series. Crank up the excitement for Chung’s new 2nd Job, Tactical Trooper!!! We’re doing our best to keep from crying—‘cause of all the awesomeness!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/MdKgi29l.jpg[/IMG]

Moving up from Shelling Guardian, Chung gets even better at his specialty as the Tactical Trooper. With enhancements brought by the Disfrozen Portal, he gets more ways to enter Siege Shelling mode. Even better, he’s now able to turn the Destroyer around and deal more explosive shots from its back—with a separate shot counter, too!

Chung proves even more that he’s all grown up—he is quite reliable, in fact. With the skill Tactical Field, he deals damage to targets caught in it while sharing a buff effect to allies standing in the aura. Using this, his ammo stores are refilled as well.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ASAc9cll.jpg[/IMG]

Yet another astounding addition to Chung’s abilities is Mortar Fire, where he sets a series of automated mortar hits after a marked target. The automation frees you up to deal more of the active combos.

I’m not telling you everything about Chung’s new skills here, so prepare to explore and find out for yourself. Just imagine the possibilities when you get tactical! Don’t forget to check out the events! This week’s awesome loot includes 3 pieces of a character card randomly picked from among the six Evolution classes. Get them just by staying in the game for an hour!

Show up in Elrios for all these and more after tonight’s maintenance update. Enjoy!

notes.title: Field Bosses Arrive!!
notes.notes:
Better develop a taste for surprise, because the Field Bosses are coming to get you! 

By now, you must find the Fields pretty easy to handle… but things are about to change! Starting tomorrow, there’s a chance a new threat will show up whenever you hunt monsters in these infested areas. Are they perhaps curious about the adventurers who have been beating up their weaker pals? Take a look at some of them. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/BoorMo2l.jpg[/IMG]


You should know what could trigger a gnarly field boss to appear: the more you beat up the ordinary field monsters, the higher the chance of a field boss suddenly showing up. There’s at least one type for every region from Elder to Hamel. I’ll go as far as saying their mugs are pretty familiar, but they’re not quite the same. ;)

Maybe they’re easy to avoid if you just move fast enough, yet we all know awesome rewards are usually dropped by the toughest monsters. Also, every player on the field with you can take a shot at the field boss, so you may crush the gruesome beast pretty fast. Just be sure to deal enough damage to it to be able to grab the drops, too! Ready or not, Field Bosses start rocking up after the update!

We also have new items arriving at the Item Mall!

 [IMG]http://i.imgur.com/E8QiHvql.jpg[/IMG]

The back-to-school season is just the beginning of even more fun. Members of the Elgang represent their student clubs at Velder Academy with new uniforms!

Last but not least, do you always wonder how much MP your rival has during a match? Wonder no more—these new goggles will tell you!

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/3CT1Sqjl.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Eve's Code Battle Seraph Arrives!!
notes.notes:
With only less than a day away Eve’s brand new Code Battle Seraph class is coming!! Who is skipping school tomorrow to change classes?! Just kidding kids, stay in school! Haha~ 

Code Battle Seraph takes the laser wielding power of Code Electra to the next level complete with two new modes for laser attacks. Reactive Mode generates an optical force field allowing the electrifying beams to home in on targets at the cost of reduced damage. In contrast, Fusion Mode fuses her three other special modes together for intensely devastating beams that travel farther, home in on targets, and can strike enemies twice.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/9Va6p4Dl.jpg[/IMG]

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/a2YtHo8l.jpg[/IMG]

Once Eve mastered Code Electra, the queen of a lost robotic race looked for a way to upgrade her abilities. Her search even drove her to confront the Nasod king for the final piece of an advanced code. However, the greatest trial still lay ahead. Just as she completed the code, it began to malfunction. After debugging, she realized the code was conflicting with the emotional bonds she had formed with Elsword and his team. She chose to delete all of her emotions so she could restore glory to the Nasod Kingdom as a Code Battle Seraph.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/6yXgcXcl.jpg[/IMG]

Check out our Exclusive with Ten Ton Hammer here: http://bit.ly/1dDLuGz

notes.title: Veteran Commander Class Comes to Elsword
notes.notes:
Raven has received a brand new class, Veteran Commander.  

Becoming a Veteran Commander makes Raven a walking arsenal, with more weapons and skills than ever before. Trouncing foes like a nuclear reactor in meltdown mode, the latest class adds even more fire-based attacks for the onslaught.  As a Veteran Commander, Raven retains his signature ability to overheat attacks – supercharging them while damaging himself.  With this evolution, he adds stronger abilities to his “overheat” mode, making him nearly unstoppable.  

If that weren’t enough to get you decimating foes as Raven, we're welcoming the new class with a special in-game offer. Level up as Raven for a chance to win awesome prizes, including virtual currency and a special limited edition Elsword USB drive/bottle opener! Click [url=http://en.elswordonline.com/2013/08/the-mercenary-chiefs-ward-raven-leveling-challenge/]here[/url] to learn more.

notes.title: New Class Available - Elsword
notes.notes:
Kill3rCombo has just revealed the next in a line of transformation Evolution classes, the Night Watcher. As Elsword’s first female swordsman, she wields her legendary blade with grace and poise. No longer just an elite Trapping Ranger, Rena has evolved to become a leader in battle. With a lighter magical sword, she is able to execute faster melee attacks than ever before. By combining her swordsmanship with her trapping and archery skills, she is a truly terrifying figure on the battlefield.


The Night Watcher’s story begins with a mission for the elite elven force, the Night Savers. This group, which focuses on assassination and intrigue, had recently recruited Rena as a Trapping Ranger. While investigating a kidnapping in Altera, Rena found herself locked in combat with the ruthless and gargantuan King Nasod. Though Rena’s blade was shattered in the fight, she managed to defeat the evil King. After the battle, her blade was reforged not as an assassin’s dagger, but as a long and powerful sword. With Rena’s new strength, she emerged as a great leader and the stalwart guardian of Elrios.


To keep up to date with everything going on in Elsword daily, visit ElswordOnline.com and keep watching the official Facebook page here.

Elsword is Now Available on Steam


Elsword is a free-to-play, online action RPG that uses classic side-scrolling beat ‘em up gameplay mechanics and deep customization to bring a unique manga experience to life.

In Elsword, you star in your own comic book while experiencing all the excitement of a massively multiplayer online game. Get ready for fast-paced gameplay, stunning animation, and epic bosses. Whether conquering hordes of enemies in dungeon runs or showing off your skills in the PvP arena, Elsword is the most intense free-to-play action RPG to date.
